summary:
A Philosophical Discussion of Worms is a Kinetic Visual Novel that explores two characters, Vynder and Ophiel, as they navigate cohabitation in a strange, unfamiliar house when they don't speak the same language.

When Vynder awakes in a house he doesn't recognize, with nothing but the clothes on their back and a hazy memory of what had happened, they search for a way out. Finding endless hallways and a library filled with books.

He is alone in a house with nothing but a ghost to keep them company.  But even the ghost wont stick around long enough for Vynder to talk to. 

---

When Ophiel awakes in a house they don't recognize, tucked away in the far corner, navigating dim corridors in search of anything  to pass the time.  Secret passages and locked rooms greet them at every turn.

They are alone in a house with a ghost that haunts them around every corner, always finding them in every twisting passage they take, calling out to them, but they never listen.

Ever wondered what it’s like to be chased by a dominant yandere demon? Well, this is the game! Welcome To My Domain is a psychological horror game with a unique retro-anime visual style, where you solve puzzles to escape the demon’s clutches.

“You can’t run — he can appear anywhere.”

Ever wondered what it’s like to be chased by a dominant yandere demon? 

Well, this is the game!

Welcome To My Domain is a psychological horror game with a unique retro-anime visual style, 

where you solve puzzles to escape the demon’s clutches. 

The story’s protagonist, Emily, is summoned to the castle of demon Lazare for one chilling reason: his obsession with her. Will Emily break free, or remain trapped in the castle for the rest of her life? Only your skill decides if she escapes… or remains forever.

FEATURES

An overpowered hunter vs. an ordinary protagonist – you're fast, but he appears where you least expect him.

Tight spaces and blind corners – every turn is a gamble, every shadow a threat.

Short, intense sessions – no filler, just pure tension from start to finish.

Character creation – experience the characters how you like them.

A harmless-looking world vs. psychological horror underneath – the calm never lasts long.

Retro game style vs. modern anime aesthetics – nostalgia twisted into something unsettling.

A Game of Chaess is "Monty Python meets Tolkien on a Chessboard". Defeat waves of black pieces in this asymmetrical chess game to stop the Lord of Darkness! The rules are simple, but the game gets harder and harder. Only the most fooli- eh fearless players will succeed!

Once upon a time in a square world far, far away a retired White King was enjoying his life... UNTIL THE LORD OF DARKNESS DISTURBS THE PEACE... AGAIN!!

In A Game of Chaess, you embark on a heroic and ridiculous quest to stop the forces of evil for once and for all. Each level throws a new wave of Black chess pieces at you. Survive the onslaught, level up, advance to the next kingdom, and push back the Darkness one board at a time.

A Game of Chaess features asymmetrical play: white plays standard chess, one move at a time. Black's pieces move in a fixed order and movement pattern and Black moves all of it's pieces, every turn. Also they must capture if they can.
Black's goal is to capture the White King. White's goal is to capture all pieces to advance to next level.
Capturing pieces grants the player experience. When you level up, you can deploy reinforcements that join the quest.

Tutorial - learn the game rules quickly by playing levels with a teacher

Story Mode - progress through the levels and kingdom

Survival - survive endless waves and set a record on 4 different difficulty settings

Zephyr Cloud is a cozy simulation game about care, building, and lighthearted adventures. Funny little creatures called Zephyrs live on your floating island: they grow, develop, make friends (or enemies), learn professions, and even raise new generations. summary:
A bite-sized rage platformer that teaches you the rules... then betrays them.

RageByte is a minimalist rage platformer that teaches you the rules…

then quietly changes them.

Inspired by classic unfair games and modern precision platformers, RageByte delivers brutally short, handcrafted levels where learning the rules is the real challenge.

The idea is simple:

Each Level fits on one screen.

Each challenge lasts seconds.

And every small victory makes you just a little more suspicious.

You will be trained. 
Rewarded. 
Punished. 
And then immediately betrayed.

(It builds character.)

Just when you’re feeling confident, the game politely reminds you that too much confidence can be a mistake.

WHAT TO EXPECT:

Bite-sized, single-screen levels 
Fast retries, instant feedback, no wasted time.

Precise, responsive platforming 
Deaths are frequent, but never random.

Deceptive layouts and intentional misdirection 
Every trap exists for a reason.

Evolving and recombined mechanics 
Spikes, portals, looping boundaries, rhythm-based platforms, mirrored movement, hostile overlays, and more.

A system-driven world 
Technical chunk names, software metaphors, and a game that feels increasingly aware of the player it’s testing.

Minimalist terminal-style presentation 
Glitchy visuals, CRT-inspired feedback, and beeps, boops, and mild electronic panic.

Plenty of perfectly clippable moments 
Ideal for streams, challenges, and watching someone else lose their composure.

DIFFICULTY

This game isn’t unfair. 
It’s just… creatively dishonest.

Some players will breeze through it. 
Others will question their life choices.

Both outcomes are intentional.

(Rage responsibly.)

"Learning is the real mechanic  and it will be used against you."

VOXEL SHOOTER MAYHEM

GunSlaw VR is a flexible free-to-play online multiplayer VR shooter featuring a wide variety of voxel-based gamemodes. Engage in PvP combat with realistic gun mechanics in destructible environments where you can build your own defenses!

MODDABLE SERVERS

GunSlaw VR allows users to host servers and write custom plugins in Python to create unique gamemodes for players to enjoy.

Sandbox TDM

Turf Wars

Destroy The Monument

Search & Destroy

The classic FPS gamemode where teams alternate in taking and defending bomb sites with player respawns disabled.

In your turn pick one of your dwarfs from your campfire and place them on the outskirt city tiles in the first spot to the left of the chosen tile and take ALL visible actions in this tile AND take damage to remove fire tokens, if another player places their dwarf in the same tile they may perform less actions than you. Once all of your dwarfs are out you retrieve them all and start from the bottom again.

 Possible actions a tile can have (usually around 2-3 actions):

Get a Gem

Spend Gems to forge a weapon card

Spend Gems to advance in the knowledge track

Perform a ranged attack

Fight a monsters on the same tile

Grant a success hit on a attack

Retire a card from your deck

summary:
A 4v1 asymmetrical horror where survivors escape by solving shifting puzzles. Use always-on proximity voice to manage sanity, but speak too loudly and the monster will find you.

Enter the Dead 4 Now universe.

You wake up inside a capsule. Experiments begin. One of you becomes the monster, and the rest must escape. This is a 4v1 asymmetrical horror where winning is not about outgunning anything; it is about thinking clearly under pressure and solving the way out.

Every match reshuffles the stage. The level layout and puzzle flow are procedurally generated, forcing you to adapt, communicate, and improvise. You can solve objectives alone, but survival is rarely a solo plan. Injuries matter. When a teammate goes down, you may need to carry them back to healing capsules before the monster finishes the job.

Your voice is always on, and it matters. Proximity voice is mandatory and calibrated for whispering, speaking, and shouting. Talking steadies your mind and reduces the distortion of sanity, but loud voices reveal your position. Shout to trigger a short adrenaline surge, boosting movement and interaction speed, then pay for it when your voice gives out and you start coughing, struggling to coordinate with your team.

If the monster consumes a downed survivor, it steals what made them dangerous: their Perk and Quirk. Those stolen traits stack for the rest of the match, turning each elimination into momentum the survivors can feel. That snowball threat is why survivors hesitate to leave anyone behind.

Escape if you can. Because in this lab, being found is only the beginning.

Segments is an atmospheric horror presented in the format of a set of independent video recordings.

Each segment is a separate incident recorded on camera by a person who encountered abnormal activity.

The records have their own designations and are accompanied by background information:

date

period

place of discovery

and a brief description of what happened.

All events are reproduced in the first person and presented without interpretation — exactly in the form in which they were recorded by the camera operator.

Segments is perceived not as a single story, but as an archive of documented cases of an unknown nature.

GAMEPLAY

The gameplay is limited by the perspective of the operator's camera and focuses on observing what is happening.

Each segment lasts 5-7 minutes and is a completed recording containing:

recording of abnormal activity

changes in the environment

visual distortions

the appearance of unknown entities

Player:

has no influence on the development of events

has no interaction tools

cannot counteract what is happening

His role is to review and relive the material that has already been recorded.

summary:
Helmet Head is an action-roguelike with a 2D souls-lite combat style. Build your strength on each run by finding weapons, helmets, upgrades and items in randomly generated environments, and use them in clever ways to defeat your foes! Death wipes the slate clean. Keep learning, never stop fighting!

Souls-Lite Combat

Helmet Head is an action-roguelike featuring a 2D souls-lite combat style inspired by titles such as Dead Cells and Hollow Knight.

The game combines traditional 2D souls-lite combat mechanics (like various weapon movesets, pogo attacks and a dodge-roll) with an elemental damage type mechanic. Certain damage types, such as fire, bleed or ice, will stack on enemies when they take damage. This damage can come from various sources and when stacked and combined in certain ways can trigger a chain reaction for big damage! The more you stack, the more damage you do!

Explore, Loot and Upgrade

Explore randomly generated environments on each run and bolster your strength by finding weapons, helmets, upgrades and items.

Each melee weapon can be upgraded individually. Upgrades are placed in slots, which activate sequentially from left to right with each hit. You will need to find the right combos and sequences to get the most out of your build!

Death and Progression

Helmet Head features a perma-death mechanic where each death ends the run and resets your character. There is no meta-progression in this game for you character, you will start each run at the same level of power. However, you can expand the general item pool with new weapons, helmets and upgrades by exploring the environments, discovering secrets and defeating tough enemies/bosses. 

Go Forth and Save Your Home

As the last remaining Warden of the Forgotten Plane you are tasked with bringing an end to the calamity beset upon your home. Adorned in your trusty helm, and armed with sword and bow, you must go forth and bring retribution to he who threatens even the gods themselves!

summary:
A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

The Other Order is a surreal-gothic roguelike with turn-based duels, where you build tile runs and sets to attack your enemies. You and your enemies share the same set of tiles, allowing both of you not only to build and reshape your own combinations, but also to rebuild each other’s to deal damage. Every move you make can both hurt you and strengthen your enemy’s strategy.

Combat is based on tile combinations. Chains are tiles of the same color linked in ascending number order. Groups are tiles of the same value across different colors. These combinations deal damage.

There are 54 tiles in total, shared between both sides. This means you don’t just build your own combinations, but also extend and reshape existing ones on the board — including your enemy’s.

Since both tiles and combinations are shared, any modification to the board can also benefit your enemy.

Your enemies follow the same rules as you do — but some possess mystic powers that alter the flow of the fight and give them an advantage.

In response, you can obtain special tiles that enchant your combinations. These enchantments allow you to adapt, counter enemy powers, and even out your chances to win.

- Turn-based duels built around tile combinations

- Shared tiles and shared board — every move can be used against you

- Runs and sets deal damage and shape the fight

- Rebuild your own combinations or interfere with your enemy’s

- Enemies with mystic powers that alter the rules of combat

- Enchant tiles and combinations to adapt and counter enemy advantages

- A quiet, surreal world where order is never stable

Following rumors of a land overflowing with nectar, a pair of humanoid humbugs find themselves in the domain of competitive bees and hostile wasps.

Taking refuge in a tree hollow, they encounter a new queen bee. Together they aim to build the strongest colony and collect the precious nectar, but the competition will be fierce!

Choose from 3 real bee species and 6 humbug characters, each with unique strengths and abilities.

Challenge players in dice-based competition to pollinate the land collecting resources and insect livestock.

Build hive chambers to house more bugs, gain bonuses, and improve your stats.

Acquire victory points by completing quests, growing your colony, or amassing resources—but be prepared to defend your spoils from other players and wasps!

READ THE DEVELOPPER'S NOTE AT THE BOTTOM

In the depths of an ancient tomb buried beneath the sands of the Idnan Desert, Alstan, a young nomadic warrior, has just lost his sister to a mysterious curse: the mark of the desert, a symbol burned into the flesh of those who bear the burden of the djinn.

Overcome with grief, Alstan crosses paths with a strange traveller. The latter reveals that behind this mark lies an ancient and feared being: Rahim, a legendary Djinn who has been confined for centuries in a forgotten temple. Driven by anger, Alstan embarks on a quest for vengeance.

Play as Alstan and set off across the Idnan desert, an arid and enchanting world inspired by Amazigh and Tuareg cultures. Along the way, face fallen spirits, ancient Djinns who have also been twisted by the curse.

With fast-paced combat, dynamic exploration mechanics and strong art direction, Alstan offers an immersive experience in a semi-open desert world, where every step brings you closer to the truth... and revenge. 

DYNAMIC COMBAT

Face a variety of enemies blocking your path and testing your skills and endurance.

EXPLORATION

Climb surfaces, slide across sand, and explore the most secret corners of the desert and its ruins to learn more about its history and find items to increase Alstan's power !

summary:
Turn-based card game. Raise the bar on the best poker hands you think are present out of all players' cards. Since you can only see your cards, you'll have to take a chance on the cards other players have or lie about your own cards. Bullshit or be bullshit-ed.

A game of information, guessing and lying.

Using poker hands, players declare in turn the best hand they think is present out of all the cards in play. If a player thinks the last poker hand played isn't actually present, they can call bullshit to end the round. Then, all players reveal their cards to verify whether the hand exists or not.

The loser of the round is either:

the player that got called out on a non-existent hand

the player that called "bullshit" on a hand that actually existed.

While players can only see their own cards, information from the plays within the round should help in figuring out what other players' cards might be.

But intuition can't beat blatant lies.

And a hand a player thought they lied about might actually exist using others' cards!

summary:
Create powerful builds and survive escalating zombie hordes in a fast-paced top-down roguelite where every run plays differently.

You don’t just shoot zombies -

You survive by weaving through impossible gaps as the horde closes in around you.

Undead Apocalypse: The Dawn is a fast-paced top-down roguelite where each run offers new upgrades and builds, forcing you to adapt under constant pressure.

What starts manageable quickly turns into controlled chaos, where every movement — and every choice — determines how long you survive.

Massive Horde Combat 
Over 100 zombies swarm you at once, closing every escape route and turning each run into a fight to stay alive.

Dynamic Card-Based Builds 
Choose powerful upgrades every level and shape your build as you fight to survive—each decision can make or break your run.

Synergy-Driven Power 
Combine multi-level upgrades to create devastating chain reactions. Experiment with different paths to find the ultimate survival strategy.

Persistent Meta-Progression 
Death is part of the cycle. Each run fuels permanent upgrades, making every new attempt stronger and pushing you further than before.

Focused, Intense Pacing 
Each run lasts 15–25 minutes, escalating from control to chaos and pushing you to go further every time.

For Mac Users

Runs on Intel and Apple Silicon (M1) Macs with stable performance. Trackpad supported, but a mouse is recommended.

Controller Support

Native support for Xbox and PlayStation controllers. No setup required. For input issues, set Steam controller options to "Use default settings."

Holy moly, a battle royale on your desktop! Starting with just a Hangolin, beat down enemy Critterbytes to collect their energy, an important resource for upgrading Hangolin, or buying new Critterbytes for your team, or purchasing some usable items, or obtaining some buffs to increase your combat prowess. summary:
This is an anomaly game set inside a mall. Several Jump scares. Fun little "Spot the difference game" with a touch of horror. Get it correct 10 times in a row and you win. You can consider this "Early Release" But the first store is done and if this does well I'll add more in the future :)

Welcome to The Undermall! You are trapped in a mall where you must spot the differences to gain.... freedom? Escape? Be set free? 

In this game you find yourself in front of the "Warm Subject". A nice little goth store. When you enter, study it. See what all is there, and where it's at. When you think you have it down, go through the "Green Exit" to begin. You will find yourself right back in front of the store again. BUT! this time, when you enter, something MIGHT be different. It could be a small change such as missing jewelry. It could be glaringly obvious. It might just JUMP out and scare you. OR it could be nothing. If there is any change then you go through the anomaly door (the red exit). If nothing is changed then go through the safe door (the green exit). Be careful! If you get it wrong then you're back to room 0 (which will always be a safe room for you to re study). Get it right 10 times in a row and you win.  

NOTE: There will NEVER be audio only anomalies. 

Controls are simple. Standard WASD movement, Shift to sprint, Ctrl to crouch, Space to jump, and Right click (hold) to zoom in. I've added a fun little emote if you press the tab key. 

Low, Medium, High, and Ultra graphics settings. Mouse sensitivity slider. Music and SFX sliders. 

There is a simple "Character Customization" platform you can enter if you wish to change the color and type of clothing you're wearing. I plan on expanding customization more in the future.

 There is also a "Speed Run Overlay" you can enable in the settings at any time. Let me see what you can do Speed Runners!

While there are no "Easy, Medium, or Hard" settings I would consider this a "Medium" difficulty game

Gridbound is a grid-based puzzle and resource strategy game about planning, placement, and magical optimization.

You play as an alchemist whose experiments have caused a disturbance in the flow of magical essences. Pulled through unstable portals, you explore strange locations and solve self-contained board puzzles by placing items, generating resources, and discovering powerful synergies.

Each level presents a grid where items interact through clear keyword-based effects. Some items produce essence, others boost nearby production, suppress effects, rotate over time, or unlock new board space. The challenge comes from arranging efficient layouts, adapting to new mechanics, and making the most of limited room.

As you progress, you unlock new areas, advanced items, and long-term upgrades through research. Later, you’ll discover the Forgotten Foundry at the planet’s core, where powerful trinkets can permanently alter how each level behaves.

Gridbound features a light, visual-only story told through short comics between areas, a colorful pixel-art style, and a relaxed but thoughtful pace focused on experimentation and problem-solving.

Two core resources: Lumen and Gloom

Multiple areas, each with unique mechanics

Keyword-driven systems that are easy to read and learn

Research and progression that unlock new items and abilities

Powerful endgame tools

Pixel art visuals and a whimsical fantasy–alchemy tone

Gridbound is about learning how systems fit together, experimenting freely, and watching small optimizations turn into elegant solutions.

Run: Z (hold)

Interact: C

Castle of the Winds is a classic early Windows roguelike. Set in a world inspired by Norse mythology, players explore procedurally generated dungeons near a quiet village, battling monsters, discovering magical items, and unraveling the mystery of an ancient evil. Castle of the Winds became a formative introduction to roguelikes for an entire generation of PC players, and remains a fondly remembered gem of the Windows 3.x era.

As a faithful port from the original source, you can expect:

Amazing 16 color  pixel art! State of the art effects from 1989!

Hand crafted town levels and procedurally generated dungeons! 

Dozens of magic spells to learn!  Infinite magic items to find! 

A drag and drop inventory interface that was novel at the time (mice were new back then).

A keyboard interface that supports both the numeric keypad and the classic rogue movement keys. 

A classic Windows Help File for documentation, even though I had to recreate the help engine myself.

Seriously, this is all about nostalgia.  We did add support for Steam achievements and Cloud Saves, but if you're expecting 3D art, shaders, and particle effects you're in the wrong place! 

This version of the game has been lovingly (?) recreated by original developer Rick Saada to run on modern 64 bit Windows environments. It contains both Part 1: A Question of Vengeance and Part 2: Lifthransir's Bane.

Face deadly enemies, encounter mysterious NPCs, and overcome environmental challenges as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the earth. The surface awaits. But first, you must earn it.

The game is a vast open-world exploration/adventure experience with action elements. Emphasis is on exploring and uncovering secrets, digging your way through sprawling cave systems, and discovering the many hidden paths scattered across this huge world.

summary:

This is a casual puzzle game centered around the core gameplay of "time-limited item-catching challenges". Its controls are simple yet the gameplay is intensely thrilling, making it perfectly suited for entertainment during fragmented time.

The game interface features a clean and intuitive design. The black background makes the falling items stand out vividly. The remaining time is clearly displayed on the left side, while the current score is updated in real time on the right side. With all core information presented at a glance, you can fully focus on every item-catching maneuver.

The gameplay emphasizes hand-eye coordination and reaction speed. All you need to do is swipe the screen or tap the directional buttons to move the basket at the bottom left and right, catching various items that fall randomly from the top of the screen. Different items correspond to different point values, requiring you to quickly predict their landing positions and flexibly adjust the basket’s placement.

The countdown of the remaining time is the core source of pressure in the game. Every passing second urges you to catch items efficiently—you can neither miss key items in the pursuit of a high score nor waste precious time due to hesitation. Although the game lacks complex level-unlocking mechanics, the combination of "time limit + high-score challenge" keeps you immersed in the cycle of "playing one more round to chase a higher score". Whether it’s during your commute or a short break, you can quickly start an exciting and engaging item-catching showdown.

summary:
Strap in for a feather-flying adventure! Launch your brave chicken from a barrel and soar through tricky levels filled with obstacles, puzzles, and more surprises!

Introduction

ChickaBoom was initially created during a Game Jam and has been refined and extended to a present a more complete experience. It’s a relatively short game consisting of 50 levels. The game is inspired by a barrel-themed minigame from a well-known title featuring a tie-wearing gorilla.

Gameplay

Guide a fearless chicken from barrel to barrel until it reaches the final destination. Each level begins with the chicken loaded into a barrel. With a single click, you fire it into the air, launching it toward the next barrel in the sequence.

Timing and precision are everything. Barrels don’t always stay still. Some move, rotate, or fire automatically, forcing you to adapt on the fly. Along the way, special barrels introduce new layers of control: some let you slow the chicken mid-flight, others allow you to adjust firing power, and certain barrels give you full control over the firing angle before launch.

Levels are packed with hazards that must be avoided, from environmental obstacles to tricky layouts that punish careless shots. Portals add another twist, instantly teleporting the chicken across the level and challenging you to think spatially and plan your trajectory ahead of time.

One wrong click sends the chicken flying off course but the perfect shot feels egg-cellent.

Background

Made by a Solo-Dev with love and care, I hope you enjoy the journey!

DRONES is a run-based autobattler deckbuilder where monsters are dealt from an enemy deck and every decision shapes the fate of a collapsing solar system. You choose which threats to confront, when to engage, and how much risk to take before the fight even begins.

Each encounter deals a hand of enemy cards. Discard enemies, re-order your drones, apply enemy modifiers, then engage and let your drones handle the rest. Combat plays out automatically as enemies attack your drones and your drones defend themselves.

Between waves, unlock and purchase a wide range of drones, munitions, hacks, modulators, and components, creating wildly different builds from run to run. Drone and item variance is high, so new synergies constantly emerge — experimenting with unfamiliar combos is a core part of the reward loop.

Enemy forces spread through the system, compromising planets. After several encounters, powerful bosses appear, leaving you one turn to save a planet before it's lost. Fail to plan for boss fights and your run will likely end early.

Every run is seeded with today's date — players around the world face the same system layout, enemy order, and opportunities each day.

Set in a cassette-futurist solar system where humanity is long gone, The DRONES Corp presents itself as the last guardian of a dying system. Its stated mission is restoration and balance — but its methods, motives, and hunger for your attention may not be as noble as advertised.

Officially, this facility does not exist.

Officially, all experiments were shut down years ago after an incident that is known only in fragments. At that time, during an attempt to interact with the Fourth Dimension, a rift opened. Entities entered our world, causing widespread destruction and loss of life—but the breach was eventually sealed, and the threat neutralized.

Collect the physical documents, download the data from the main computer, and exit the facility the same way you came.

Every mistake brings you closer to mission failure, and the only chance to survive is caution and careful observation.

Remnant Generation: Prologue is an exploration of a secret laboratory where every decision, every step, and every discovery carries the responsibility for the future of humanity.

This is not yet a catastrophe. But the past has already shown that the cost of failure can be devastating.

A snarky narrator, a chaos meter, and your new roommate Mia. Every tiny choice snowballs into bigger messes, sharper banter, and unexpected flirtation. Keep it together—or let the script burn for the laughs.

Content:

9 Unlockable Animations

Short Comedy Visual Novel Game

Fully Comedy 3D Game!!! with best narrator

“OOPS… THAT WASN’T IN THE SCRIPT” is a fast, joke-packed comedy about what happens when every little choice you make sets off bigger, funnier, and occasionally awkward consequences. You move in with Mia, a charming roommate who’s just as good at bantering as she is at getting you into trouble. Every decision nudges a chaos meter that tracks how far you’ve derailed the “supposed” plan. Keep things tidy and you’ll smooth over misunderstandings, calm tensions, and maybe even build trust. Lean into the mischief and you’ll unlock sharper banter, wilder scenarios, and flirtatious sparks that the narrator will gleefully comment on. Branching scenes react to your choices: who you back up, when you double down, and how much chaos you unleash.

Key features:

A roasting narrator who breaks the fourth wall and keeps score on your decisions.

A chaos meter that turns tiny choices into big comedic fallout.

Relationship and tension tracking that shift dialogue, reactions, and outcomes.

Multiple branching scenes with reactive jokes, callbacks, and payoffs for how you play.

A cozy apartment setting that evolves from orderly to “how did it get this messy?” based on your calls.

Try to stick to the script—or light it on fire for the laughs. The fun is seeing how far you can push it and what new punchlines the chaos unlocks.

summary:
A slow, meditative survival journey across a bleak continent. Carry an evil artifact, manage scarce resources, scavenge abandoned places and decide how far you’re willing to endure in a world that offers no reassurance.

The rapture came and went;
those who remained grow sick,
they scavenge in the wreckage,
seeking shelter.

Carry an ancient artifact across a desolate medieval continent.

Play as a lone traveller transporting a cursed object through a vast, abandoned world. The objective is to survive the journey, travel as far as possible and ultimately decide how to manage the burden you carry.

The game is a slow, journey-driven survival experience focused on travel rather than combat. Stamina and supplies must be managed as you traverse long distances on foot through ruins, roads and bleak terrain. Knowing when to push forward or retreat is central to progression.

Features

Slow, meditative single-player survival focused on travel and endurance

Resource management, scavenging and light stamina systems

Large interconnected world with abandoned settlements and landmarks

Minimal and readable mechanics

Atmospheric focused design

This is a game about carrying weight - literal and moral -through an indifferent world, where persistence itself is the only form of progress.

An arcade style, pixel art, boss-rush puzzle action game. Move your character up, down, right and left! Dash through enemy attacks and obstacles! Pick up objects and hurl them at the boss to cause damage! Gather enough points and unleash max damage with a powerful projectile or form!

Cyan Soul is a fast paced, action-puzzle, boss-rush game inspired by games like Cuphead and Galaga. 

In this demo, you play as a small, but cute ghost-looking dude. You can move up, down, right and left with WASD, and Spacebar for a quick dash that gives you invincibility for a moment. Watch out, if you get hit, your power-up bar takes a hit, too! 

With this demo, you choose between 3 stages:

Swamp Romp, a straightforward vine-covered swamp monster (I recommend beating this guy first) 

Cow-spiracy, which is a creepy little alien abduction (There's more to the story if you look hard enough)

Big and Hexy, where you battle a big ugly witch and her cute cat! 

Your objective is to pick up objects from around the stage and hurl them at the boss! The health bar for the boss is located at the bottom of the screen. Aim for 3 stars and the best time and score!

Keep in mind that this is just a free demo. I'm hard at work on the full game! Stay tuned!

None of the art, sound, or music assets were AI-generated.

Solar Pact is a student developed first-person adventure project that represents the culmination of our academic journey and creative vision.

You are the Guardian of the Solar Pact, an ancient alliance where every planet and civilization shares energy to keep their sun alive. For centuries, this fragile balance has sustained countless worlds. But one day, an entire star system suddenly goes silent. No signals. No energy transfers. No explanation.

Sent to investigate, you must travel across worlds, uncover what is happening, and restore the balance before the dying sun consumes everything.

Puzzles & Mechanisms 

Exploration and observation are key to solving puzzles. Interact with mechanisms, analyze your surroundings, and figure out how the environment works to unlock doors, activate systems, and move forward.  

Exploration & Secrets 

Exploration is a core pillar of Solar Pact. Every world hides secrets, hidden paths, and optional challenges for players willing to look beyond the obvious. Curiosity is always rewarded, whether through upgrades, recipes, shortcuts, or deeper understanding of the world.

The joy of designing boats and ships, nothing more, nothing less.

I’ve always loved ships and boats, tall ships, steamers, pre-dreadnought french monstrosities, I love em all. 
ShipShaper is a small, explorative ship builder I made for the simple pleasure of shaping boats and ships. You pull, push, and drag forms into place, creating everything from humble fishing vessels to tall ships, ironclads, and early dreadnoughts.

Weather the Tide is a roguelike deckbuilding survival game where time is against you in a flooding world. Only by exploring the wrecks and ruins of what came before, using every scrap available, and charting a new path with the stars, can you hope to rise above the unforgiving seas that threaten to swallow you, your people, and your ramshackle tower.  

The world you once knew is gone. Can you weather the tides?

Raise A Community

Use every scrap available to raise your community above the rising waters and ensure their survival. You will manage access to shelter, food and medicine, and raise your people’s morale by constructing new additions to your tower. Every turn brings new cards to be played: new buildings and supplies, expeditions into unknown waters, random events, and more. Your own charting of the stars can help provide just what you need, but every drawn card can also sow chaos into your well-laid plans.

Protect your vulnerable populace, because you cannot be a community of one.

Endure The Elements

A drop of water can bring life, but a torrent of it can destroy and consume just as easily. Build your tower quickly, as the rising waters cannot be bargained or bought. A dynamic weather system can bring calm waters or a raging storm to your doorstep, and it is crucial to plan ahead as best you can. Every turn could be your last, but fear not, as your discoveries carry forward into future endeavours.

While the weather can bring ruin, it also brings potential. There is hope on the horizon if you have the grit to see it.

Chart A New Path

The old world is dead, buried under an ever-rising ocean. The stars above, though? Even now, they can provide guidance on the open seas.

summary:
Solve over 100 shape puzzles by piecing together different shapes to fully cover the background! Including Pressure plates, deletion squares and locked pieces!

This game features over 100 levels with a wide range of mechanics and difficult puzzles. The levels start easier but they increase in difficulty as you get to higher levels.

How to play:

Pick up pieces and rotate them to fit them onto the background. Each level only has a limited number of pieces so you need to be careful. Nearly every level has multiple solutions, so if you don't have to worry about brute forcing for a solution.

Each level is made up of black squares which is what you need to cover to win.

There are also special squares that either hinder or help you solve the puzzle.

Special squares:

Red squares: Red squares stop you from placing a piece if any of your pieces squares are on it.

Deletion squares: Deletion squares delete the square of the piece placed on top of the deletion squares.

Pressure plates: Pressure plates hide certain squares that cover the background. You need to place a piece on top to activate it.

Some pieces may be different than others. Locked Pieces will appear in later levels.

Locked Pieces: Just as the name implies, some pieces you will be locked and you cannot rotate them. While this can be helpful since you know it starts in its final rotation. It can be pretty frustrating when the last piece would fit perfectly, if only you could rotate it.

Play Time:

Since different players will find different levels easier/harder it is hard to judge how long it will take any one player to complete the game. Play testing has shown the whole game done in only ~5 hours. Where other play tests took over an hour per level on some of  the harder levels.

Do you have what it takes to become a champion in bōnin?

Features:

Battle your friends (or foes)! In this PvP sudoku game both players run across the same puzzle board in real-time trying to be the first one the fill in the missing digits. The game can be played both online and locally on the same device.

Play on nature-themed sudoku boards. Choose if you want to play in the cozy meadows or on the relaxing beach. You can also choose between three difficulties to customize your experience.

Deal with different types of terrain as the weather changes. Rain turns dirt patches into mud pools which are difficult to traverse, while cold weather turns water into slippery ice.

Avoid projectiles and use power-ups. During a sudoku showdown pencil-shaped projectiles will rain down from the sky. It is a good idea to avoid these projectiles. The game also features several power-ups. Pick these up and make good use of your temporal advantage.

Fully customizable controls. Switch up how to move and how to fill in the missing digits. Separate control schemes are available for online play and for local play, where a single keyboard is shared.

In-game statistics. Keep track of how many digits you have correctly filled in, which board is your most-played and more.

summary:
Hollow Meridian is a short atmospheric experience about repetition, control, and quiet collapse. Interact with a mechanical system that keeps running long after its purpose has faded.

Hollow Meridian is a first-person interactive system.

You are positioned inside a confined control space, operating a large machine through incomplete information and indirect instrumentation.

Visibility is limited. 
Instructions arrive fragmented. 
Intent is irrelevant.

Targets are defined by coordinates, not description. 
Authorization procedures are required, even when redundant. 
Once all steps are fulfilled, the system executes.

It does not evaluate outcome.

There is no traditional HUD, no objective markers, and no character commentary. 
All interaction is physical and diegetic — levers, keys, switches, documents.

This is not a shooter, a puzzle game, or a test of skill. 
There are no fail states, no scoring systems, and no optimization goals.

The experience may reach a point where no further input is requested. 
At that moment, functionality ceases.

NO FURTHER DIRECTIONS AVAILABLE.

Your cards number is higher than your opponents.

The Even/Odd status of your card matches the declaring card (located on the left near the draw pile).

Your cards element (Fire or Earth) must be opposite of your enemies health card.

Quickplay

Legacy

Multiplayer

The Forgotten Nightmare Series

A classic text adventure reborn for a modern age.

The Forgotten Nightmare Series is an all-text adventure game spanning three complete chapters of interactive fiction — a love letter to the golden era of games pioneered by Scott Adams on the Commodore VIC-20, reimagined with a modern interface for today's players. There are no graphics. No soundtrack. Just you, your imagination, and a world that desperately needs to be understood.

The Story

You awaken suspended upside-down by your seatbelt inside an overturned van. You don't know where you are. You don't know who you are. The world outside is silent — strangely, unnervingly empty. As you escape and begin to explore, it becomes clear that whatever happened here was not a local event. Towns lie abandoned. People have vanished. Natural disasters, wars, and plagues are accelerating across the globe. And somewhere in the chaos, the truth about your identity — and the world's fate — is waiting to be uncovered.

Set in a post-apocalyptic future shaped by end-times events, this Christian-themed series unfolds across three interconnected chapters, each expanding the story, the cast of companions, and the stakes. As your memory slowly returns, so does a deeper understanding of what the world has become — and why.

Gameplay

This is a full free-form text adventure — not a multiple choice game. You are in control. Commands follow the classic verb/noun structure of the genre: take key, open door, use hammer on loose board. Simple to learn, but the thinking required to know which commands to use and when is anything but. Progress by exploring your environment, collecting items, and solving problems that demand genuine critical thinking

Yakshini Lokam fuses action-packed tactical gameplay with classic Indian board games dating as far back as the 2nd Century CE. Play as a family of four from Hyderabad, India who were spirited away to a magical world— just as they were sitting down to family game night! 

The game’s Sanskrit title roughly translates into English as “Fairy Realm”.

Controls

Gameplay

 The game-world consists of a series of battle arenas linked together by an overworld. In the overworld, the player controls the whole family at once. They move in single file as they explore exotic biomes and meet various NPC challengers.

When the family encounters a challenger, they are transported to a gridded battle arena, and gameplay becomes turn-based. This means the player can only control one character at a time, and must maneuver them against a squad of computer-controlled opponents until they attain victory or failure.

Just like the ancient game of Chess, victory is achieved by capturing every member of the opposing squad, while failure occurs if the opponents manage to capture all four members of the family.

Action Points

Each character’s Turn is limited by a finite number of Action Points (AP), which can be spent by the player in order to move, or to activate items. Once all of a character’s AP has been expended, that character’s Turn is over.

Once all characters (including opponents) have taken their Turn, play enters the next Round and proceeds from top of the turn order. Most battles must be won within a prescribed number of Rounds, forcing the player to strategically optimise their Turns and take calculated risks to emerge victorious.

summary:
A minimalist, brutal-but-fair precision platformer built around mechanics, movement, and flow. FewTileEffort is made for speedrunners and difficulty-focused players who want challenge without cheap tricks.

What is FewTileEffort? Well, FewTileEffort is a brutal-yet-enjoyable precision platformer. The game's focus is to be as polished and high quality as it can be gameplay-wise. In other words, it's meant to be fun for people who don't mind a little spice and rage once in a while (while having fun, of course), who crave optimization, flow, and games that offer an overall good experience, not just one good mechanic. The game is also very minimalist, but the visuals can still feel atmospheric and pretty.

The controls are incredibly simple, though: Move left and right, jump, dash with W (left and right), and rotate freely on corners, something that's actually pretty unique to FewTileEffort! Free rotation creates a flow state that lets you make jumps that'd seem impossible, scale walls, and perform other fun and crazy tech. The game hinges on teaching you with as few in-your-face tutorials as possible, essentially just tutorializing the things that need buttons to do. The game doesn't treat the player as dumb, but as intellegent and capable of discovery, as it should, which is how the rest of the game's mechanics are learnt.

However, FewTileEffort is unapologetically not for everyone. If you need collectibles, skins, or a story to enjoy a game, then FewTileEffort is almost certainly not for you. However, if you appreciate difficulty, chase optimization and speed, and love flowy, responsive movement, then FTE might just be your match. The game also isn't hard in the "haha gotcha" way, but in the "here's how you can improve" way. Some games can be fair and annoying. summary:
Devilbreath: The First Seal is a dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval frontier, where an ordinary village boy follows a hell-born mist into a dying forest to find its source—and stop it before his village is lost.

The mist arrived without warning.

It rolled out of the deep woods like a slow exhale—cold, bitter, and wrong. Crops dulled. Animals fled. People stopped sleeping. And at the edge of the village, shapes began to move where no living thing should.

You are not a knight. Not a mage. Not chosen by prophecy. You are a villager with no army behind you—only stubbornness, fear, and the growing certainty that if you turn back, nothing will remain to save.

Follow the Devilbreath. Find its source. Stop the spread.

A dark fantasy tale with unsettling moments—focused on tactics and atmosphere rather than constant horror.

Tactical Combat Built on Hard Choices

Every fight is a puzzle under pressure: commit to an action, anticipate the enemy, and survive long enough to push deeper into the mist.

Turn-based tactical battles focused on planning and counterplay

Simple, readable actions with meaningful consequences (strike, defend, risk heavier hits, and unleash dark effects)

Limited healing—potions buy you time, not certainty

Enemies that punish habits, forcing you to adapt instead of repeating a “best move”

A Small Human Story in a Dark World

Devilbreath is about what happens when the world expects heroes—and none arrive.

Meet villagers, wanderers, and figures of faith in the fog: some will help, some will lie, and some will wear kindness like a mask. The further you go, the more the line blurs between protection and obsession, faith and fear, duty and doom.

Why Wishlist

Devilbreath is in active development. Wishlisting helps you track major updates, demo availability, and the release window as development continues.

Defeat corrupted enemies

Recover their trapped souls

Return souls to restored graves

A narrative-driven psychological horror game inspired by Turkish mythology. Explore a desolate Anatolian village, uncover forbidden truths, and confront an ancient entity rising from beneath the earth. Entirely developed by a solo developer.

Set in a forgotten corner of Anatolia, this psychological horror experience draws inspiration from Turkish mythology and folklore to tell a dark, unsettling story about blood, lineage, and buried truths.

You arrive at an abandoned village where time feels distorted and silence weighs heavier than sound. Houses stand empty, roads vanish into fog, and traces of violence linger without explanation. As you explore the environment, the village slowly reveals fragments of a past that was never meant to surface.

The game focuses on environmental storytelling and atmosphere rather than constant action. Every location, object, and sound is designed to create tension and unease, encouraging players to observe carefully and piece together the narrative themselves. Horror emerges gradually — through disturbing imagery, sudden encounters, and moments where reality feels fragile and unreliable.

At the heart of the story lies an ancient mythological presence tied to the land itself. As the narrative unfolds, the player is forced to confront unsettling revelations about identity, fate, and inheritance. What begins as an investigation turns into a personal descent, culminating in a truth that redefines everything you thought you knew.

Key Features

Psychological horror inspired by Turkish mythology and Anatolian folklore

A dense, atmospheric world centered around a desolate village

Environmental storytelling with minimal exposition

Carefully paced tension, jump scares, and unsettling encounters

A dark narrative focused on identity, bloodline, and ancient forces

This is not a game about survival alone — it is about confronting what lies beneath the surface, both in the world and within yourself.

Panic Point is a first-person, cooperative psychological horror experience built around tension, uncertainty, and teamwork under pressure.

You and your team are dropped into unfamiliar, hostile locations with limited information, limited resources, and no clear sense of what’s hunting you. First-Person Immersion – Everything is seen through your character’s eyes

Psychological Horror – Fear driven by atmosphere, uncertainty, and anticipation

Exploration-Focused Gameplay – Learn environments, manage risk, and adapt

Team-Based Survival – Communication and coordination are essential

Unpredictable Encounters – No two runs feel exactly the same

Panic Point is designed for players who enjoy slow-burn horror, cooperative tension, and the feeling that something is always watching—even when nothing is visible.

summary:
Animal Gaze is a digital and VR-friendly speculative archive exhibition based on the original story of the non-virtual exhibition of the same name held in Istanbul, Türkiye, in 2023.

Animal Gaze on XR: A speculative archive exhibition

Animal Gaze is a digital and VR-friendly speculative archive exhibition based on the original story of the non-virtual exhibition of the same name held in Istanbul, Türkiye, in 2023. It contains multimedia artworks (some digitalized from physical art, some created digitally) by eleven participating artists from Türkiye, Canada and Germany. This collaboration between the Animal Gaze Project (AGP) and on-XR follows the same background story and conceptual limitations that shaped the initial project.

The idea for the exhibition emerged from the imagination of a trial titled “Crimes Against Animals,” resulting in a speculative future where non-human animals are no longer treated as “natural resources” at the service of human beings for clothing, food, furniture, entertainment, cosmetics or medicine. In this future, the history of animal exploitation has become a thing of the past. The setting is a former slaughterhouse repurposed as a permanent exhibition space; the goal is to install an archival exhibition specifically for the animals of the future. Meanwhile, the human audience of today participates indirectly in this future confrontation, looking at what animals from the future have come to see and witnessing what their ancestors have been through. Each participating artist has created at least one piece intended to serve as a record for that future archive, creating an "exhibition within an exhibition."

This speculative encounter finds its inspiration in Jacques Derrida’s reflections in The Animal That Therefore I Am. In his famous encounter with a cat, Derrida recognizes that the cat looks at him as much as he looks at her, prompting a consideration of the animal gaze, an aspect largely ignored in the history of Western philosophy

Discover a decaying world inside what seems to be a dying homonculus, use what you will find in this soon to be roten creature and try to save it or at least save yourself.....

A strange world to discover...

You are a homunculus, a being created out of despair.

Your world is a vast, living creature, now dying, too weak to create another like you.

As the last of your kind, your survival is bound to its recovery—heal the organism, or perish with it.

Guided by the remnants and tools left behind by previous homunculi, you must act quickly, as something else has already claimed its place inside.

Using everything in your power to stay alive... 

Move in first person through the creature’s interior, climbing flesh, crossing cavities, and pulling yourself through collapsing passages.

Use your lantern to reveal paths, detect parasites, and survive areas swallowed by darkness.

Manipulate sinews, tissues, and organic mechanisms to open routes, stabilize zones, and solve environmental puzzles.

Avoid parasites through stealth and timing, hiding, fleeing, and using the environment to stay unseen.

Heal failing areas of the creature to keep it alive—and keep yourself alive with it.

Enter the creature and find out why everyone says it should be felt, not explained.

Frantically cook up sandwiches and pour coffee before patrons get impatient and storm out! Endure for 10 days and an esteemed guest may arrive...

This is my first game. I began my game dev journey in November 2025 and based 8-Bit Bistro on a friend's cafe, which offers the best sandwiches and coffee in Portland, OR. He owns and operates the establishment all by himself, which inspired the concept: one person taking orders, cooking food, and pouring drinks with no time for breaks.

Serve an endless influx of customers who quickly grow impatient

Grab pastries from the display case and make coffee at the espresso machine

Refer to the recipe booklet to gather the right ingredients and throw them on the stove or in the oven

Purchase upgrades with your profits to make the next day easier

Avoid too many unprofitable days or the business may go under

Survive until day 10 for the arrival of a fateful guest

8-Bit Bistro is mouse-centric and does not natively support controllers, but a steam input profile may offer an adequate experience on Steam Deck. This game provides at least an hour of fun. Thank you for being a part of this new chapter in my life.

It has been more than a year since the University has been mysteriously lifted into the air. Trapping all of the students, professors, faculty, and anyone else who were on the campus on that day. Everyone has transitioned to living inside the bubble that has formed around the floating campus, except for one hungover student who seeks to free the campus and return home!

Search, challenge, and recruit the Guardians of the campus! The dysfunctional friend group who use their gifted powers to enable smooth operations of the remote campus. Once recruited, they provide unique abilities to your party to help explore the over world as well as engage during battle. 

Attend class lectures, or skip them and crash a frat party. Visit club fairs and explore the inner workings of the University campuses. Unearth what lies below the streets in the maze like sewers. Challenge classmates in an engaging turn based combat where you can attempt to hear them out, or solve your problems with violence.

Classbound

Experience this satirical adventure/action RPG about fixing a broken friend group! Fight off an entertaining cast of poorly-educated combatants, free your class from the floating college's puzzles, and rule the school with the power coded deep within you.

summary:
HotFix Protocol is a cooperative sci-fi action game where you stabilize a failing industrial facility. Identify critical failures, locate tools, contain physical threats, and repair systems in real-time. Coordinate with your team to restore control room-by-room before the infrastructure collapses.

Repair Systems Under Pressure

In HotFix Protocol, each mission focuses on restoring critical systems inside a failing facility.

Players enter environments where power, cooling, life support, and other infrastructure are already compromised. Objectives involve locating the problem, gathering the required equipment, and performing repairs while conditions continue to deteriorate.

Many tasks require preparation, timing, and sustained attention. Ignoring problems causes systems to regress or trigger additional hazards.

The challenge lies in maintaining control as multiple issues compete for attention.

Built for Co-op, Playable Solo

HotFix Protocol is designed as a cooperative experience. Missions often present multiple simultaneous problems that are difficult to manage alone, encouraging players to divide responsibilities and adapt to changing conditions.

There are no fixed classes or predefined roles. Players take on tasks as situations demand, repairing systems, securing areas, transporting equipment, or containing new failures as they emerge.

The game is fully playable solo, but handling every task alone increases pressure and reduces room for error. Cooperation makes recovery faster and more reliable.

Unstable Systems, Real-Time Decisions

Systems do not remain stable once they begin to fail. Power fluctuates, repairs degrade under stress, and new problems can appear while others are still being addressed.

Combat, movement, and repairs compete for attention. Teams must decide when to secure an area, when to disengage to prevent further breakdown, and when to commit fully to restoring a critical system.

summary:
Cursed Cargo is an online co-op comedy-horror where the environment is as dangerous as the monsters. Team up with up to 4 players to transport unpredictable cargo using physics-based tools. Use proximity voice chat to coordinate, but be careful the entities are always listening.

Cursed Cargo is a chaotic, physics-based online co-op comedy-horror game for 1–4 players where teamwork is not optional — it is survival.

You are not moving ordinary freight. Your job is to transport high-maintenance, sentient, and often terrified supernatural entities through unstable, procedurally generated environments and deliver them safely to an Extraction Point. If the cargo breaks before you arrive, the mission fails — and the consequences are permanent.

Core Gameplay

Each mission drops your team into a shifting labyrinth filled with environmental hazards, hostile threats, and unpredictable physics interactions.

One player must physically carry the sentient cargo. This role is asymmetrical and high-risk:

Reduced movement speed

Faster stamina consumption

Cannot use items

Becomes the primary target for threats

The remaining players must scout, defend, clear paths, manage resources, and protect the carrier at all costs.

Every fall, collision, impact, or attack damages the cargo’s physical integrity. If its integrity reaches zero before extraction, the delivery is void.

KEY FEATURES:
Cargo Management and the "Calmness" Mechanic: The cargo you carry is not just a box. It is affected by events around it, it fears, and it reacts. Use the items you find to calm it down and prevent the cargo from "losing its mind." 

Advanced Stealth and Escape: Hide from monsters in labyrinthine rooms. A new threat awaits around every corner... 

Ever-Changing Maps: Experience infinite replayability with procedural level generation that reshapes the map every time you play, ensuring that danger always lurks in unexpected corners.

summary:
A goofy idle clicker about clicking poop and collecting farts, buying upgrades, and watching numbers get absolutely out of control.

Super Idle Poop Clicker is a goofy idle clicker game about clicking poop and watching numbers go up.

You start with manual clicks. Clicking earns XP and farts, which you spend on upgrades. Those upgrades increase click power, add idle income, unlock automation, and push the game toward playing itself.

As you progress, you unlock new poop tiers. Each tier increases the difficulty in leveling up. When things slow down, you can prestige to start over with permanent boosts and climb even quicker the next run.

This is a classic idle game at heart. There’s no story, no time pressure, and no skill requirements. You can actively click, leave it running in the background, or check in occasionally to buy upgrades and move on.

Despite the name, the game is fully cartoony and non-explicit. The theme is silly on purpose, but the progression systems are solid and familiar for fans of idle and incremental games.

If you like watching systems snowball, numbers spiral upward, and efficiency slowly get out of control, this game delivers exactly that, just with poop.

Features

Clicker and idle gameplay that ramps into full automation

Thirty poop tiers that effect progression

Prestige system with permanent bonuses

Designed for short sessions or background play

Clean, cartoony visuals with light humor

Many hilarious, awkward, and disgusting fart noises

This game is designed to run in portrait (vertical) orientation only. It plays in a vertical window and does not support fullscreen. This is intentional and helps keep the UI readable and the gameplay comfortable for idle play. The game runs perfectly in windowed mode on desktop monitors.

summary:
A human made, story driven, turn-based RPG. You play as a party of 4 slimes who eat loot to power up their abilities. Distribute your loot among the slimes for maximum effect. Balance combat needs with sending loot back to complete quests.

Hungry For Loot is a story driven RPG with turn-based combat, where you play as a party of slimes. Your group sets out to gather food for your clan's winter stockpile, only to be attacked by invaders from far away. The further you go, the more you learn about these invaders and the threat they pose. Will your party rise up to the challenge? Will you be able to protect the people of the Fantastical Forest? Will Terra Copiae fall to the invaders?

You will be traveling from town to town, fighting invaders in turn based combat along the way. Your party comes from a slime clan, Limus manduco (Nense), that has the special talent to power up their abilities by consuming items. Eat loot to power up your slimes and face the threat. You will also need to balance what loot you keep, and what is sent back home to feed your clan.

The game has a mostly linear story, with optional side quests. Movement between key locations happens in a simple side-scrolling format, with random encounters and events along the way. Instead of grinding at each new town you reach to level up and buy the latest equipment, you only visit each town once, and then move on. Be sure to chat with each town's NPCs before leaving. Staying at the inn may change who is around, and what they have to say. The fights will be balanced so you are always at a decent level for the foes you are facing, and it will be up to your tactics, and item usage, to win. Difficulty settings will be in the final version, including an easy "Story Mode". We currently intend for the finished game to have around 10-15 hours of gameplay for a normal run. 

We gladly welcome feedback. Help shape the future of our game by joining the development discussions.

summary:
WHITE ROOMS is a first-person puzzle game where every room teaches you a rule... then punishes you for believing it. No combat. No reflexes. Just trust, and the moment it breaks.

WHITE ROOMS

Everything here looks simple. That’s the problem.

WHITE ROOMS is a first-person puzzle game set entirely in clean, empty, white spaces.
Each room gives you a clear objective.
Each room lies to you in a different way.

There are no enemies (maybe some).
No timers you need to outrun (a little bit of that).
No precision jumps or mechanical skill checks (hmm, maybe a bit of that too).

If you fail, it’s not because you were slow.
It’s because you trusted something you shouldn’t have.

What kind of game is this?

You walk into a room.
There’s a door (sometimes a plain white wall).
There’s usually an obvious solution.

It’s wrong.

Every room is built around a single idea:
a rule that seems reasonable, helpful, or familiar, until it quietly betrays you.

The game never explains what went wrong.
It just restarts the room and lets you sit with the mistake.

                  Feeling stressed while solving frustrating puzzles?

Features

Minimalist first-person puzzle design

One-button interaction, fixed movement speed

No combat, no reflex challenges

Rooms that play with logic, perception, time and trust

A clean white aesthetic that slowly becomes uncomfortable

What this game is not

Not a horror game with jump scares (oh yes)

Not a physics sandbox

Not a “gotcha” troll game

Not fair in the way you expect

A warning

If you’re the kind of player who likes mastering systems, optimizing routes, and getting better through repetition…
this game will actively fight you.

WHITE ROOMS is about unlearning assumptions, not improving execution.

Sometimes the safest thing to do is nothing.
Sometimes it isn’t.

Slice Art Engine is a revolutionary physics system that brings unprecedented precision to melee combat and destruction mechanics in games.

What Makes It Different?

Traditional slicing systems are fake—they swap models or use pre-defined cut patterns. Slice Art Engine uses plane-complex-mesh intersection technology to calculate every cut with 100% mathematical accuracy. Every triangle that touches your blade is tracked. Quest 2: Up to 500K voxels (collision only) or 30K voxels (with sparks, dismemberment physics)

Quest 3: Up to 1M voxels (collision only) or 200K voxels (with full effects)

Blade Strike Trace Visualization See exactly where your strikes land in real-time. Watch as the engine highlights every triangle your sword path intersects and displays the precise collision line. Perfect for developers fine-tuning combat feel or players mastering their technique.

summary:
Lines Must Cross is an incremental graph game about firing mathematical functions and earning progress when they intersect. Click to spawn lines, unlock new function types, and grow a living coordinate system.

Shoot functions. Find intersections. Earn money.

In Lines Must Cross, every click spawns a mathematical function onto a living coordinate system. When your shot intersects the target function, it generates money, the farther from the origin the intersection occurs, the higher the reward.

Intersections don’t happen by chance alone.

Expanding the grid increases the space where valuable intersections can occur. Unlocking new function types raises the chance of multiple intersections per click. Every upgrade shifts the balance between reliability, reach, and reward.

Over time, a simple graph turns into a complex system.

What starts as a single line grows into layered functions, wider coordinate ranges, and richer intersection patterns.

Lines Must Cross is a calm, system-driven game about visual math, intuition, and growth. It rewards understanding over speed and curiosity over reflexes.

summary:
A relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where flowers spread and mutate in real time. Shape their growth, clear space, and transform one pattern into the next on a colorful 10×9 grid.

Mosaic Garden is a relaxing puzzle game about recreating patterns using spreading flowers.

Colorful pixel flowers grow in real-time, slowly spreading into adjacent spaces, and sometimes mutate into new but similar colors. 

You can't place flowers directly. You can only remove them or encourage them to spread faster using your watering can.

The goal is simple:

Recreate the presented pattern on a 10×9 field

One color per tile

Flowers spread 4-directionally on their own at unpredictable intervals. When they sprout in new spaces, they may subtly mutate. Sometimes becoming exactly the color you need, exactly where you need it… sometimes not. To guide a color across the field, you'll have to carve pathways, destroying parts of your work, and carefully make room for growth.

Like a Rubik's Cube, progress often requires temporary chaos.

Each completed pattern carries over into the next level.

You don't start fresh. You transform what you've already built. 

There are no failure states and no pressure. Unless you want it.

Play slowly and enjoy the meditative rhythm of spreading color, soft ambient music, and a retro aesthetic. Or chase efficiency and optimize every movement to beat your best time.

With many levels, evolving challenges, and a built-in level editor that lets you create your own pattern templates, Mosaic Garden is a brain exercise you will surely enjoy.

name: Take off a mask
summary:
揭下面具是能够享受数十个个体间小分队战斗的战略动作RPG。 通过探险和战斗,可以揭开神秘世界的秘密,寻找隐藏的同事,挑战更广阔的地区。 在没有中间加载的情况下,沿着无缝展开的场地移动,适当地应对仅通过感情表达传达的情况,自然而然地形成属于自己的军团。 珍惜每一个队友，用最好的战斗力向"北方的恶魔"发起挑战吧。

《摘下面具》是运用由多个角色组成的大规模派对,在神秘的世界"桥"的各个角落探险的游戏。 要与新的同事见面，与不义之仇作斗争，寻找隐藏的宝藏，向"北方恶魔"进军。

玩家要操作的基本角色戴着面具，是这个世界的不速之客。 帮助语言不通的世界居民沟通的"面具"是唯一值得依靠的地方。 "假面"用这种力量准确地捕捉到周围人的感情,并给予信息。 大家看到这些后,各自掌握情况,通过自己的选择引导故事发展。

许多角色根据各自的所属、种族、价值观进行战斗、联系、结缘。 虽然有很多同事在等待大家的选择，但一次性接待所有人几乎是不可能的。 有时需要用没有特点的雅各布角色来填补剩下的空缺。 但是连他也会作为固有选择的一个分支,让人感受到乐趣。

《摘下面具》为了体验投入感高的游戏体验,追求最大限度地消除因加载或剪辑等导致操作中断的情况的多少有些实验性的系统。 16x16瓷砖尺寸的地图被加载到后台，每个地区的故事都会通过不断展开的活动获得。

虽然画面乍一看很复杂,但一次只操作一个角色,摄像机跟踪正在操作中的角色,因此,如果实际操作,就能感受到比想象中更简单的游戏感觉。 另外,因为不是RTS或模拟游戏,所以利用键盘和游戏手柄也能顺利进行游戏,所以可以轻松地进行游戏。

这是一个模拟类的游戏，你将扮演一名机器人去探索一颗星球。你可以自由地驾驶载具，使用武器攻击，以及更高级的武器；例如可控制的导弹.......在正式版中你还可以钓鱼自由建造，使用背包系统.使用工作台合成物品,和商人进行交易以及与其他玩家远程联机游玩!!!(这些功能仅会出现在正式版中测试版,开发版可能并不存在)!!!。在已实现的内容中我们尽可能将其做得细致。例如玩家需要手动打开车门，并且使用移动按键进入到车体内部，与控制屏幕互动后才可以驾驶车辆。或是可以手动打开的对冲引擎。以及可以被车辆轻松碾碎破坏掉的路灯栅栏他们在碎裂后还会熄灭。但是个人开发者精力有限，请不要有太高的预期

name: Forest Showdown：Cat Hero Battle
summary:
这是一款独特的VR游戏，让你身临其境地体验操控宠物猫在森林中游荡的乐趣。置身于茂密的森林中，你的宠物猫将与各种动物互动，展开一场惊险刺激的冒险。

游戏中，玩家的主要任务是寻找动物战斗冒险，前提是避开危险。森林中充满了各种动物，它们有的强大，有的弱小。宠物猫靠近动物时，动物会主动发起攻击。面对比自己小或者与自己相当的动物，玩家可以勇敢应战；而面对强大的动物，玩家需要理智地进行选择，千万不要鲁莽行事，避免无谓的战斗哦。
游戏设定十分独特。一方面，玩家可以通过虚拟现实技术，享受到身临其境的沉浸式体验。另一方面，游戏还添加了策略元素。玩家需要根据动物的体型、攻击性以及自己的能力，制定出最佳的行动方案。如果宠物猫在战斗中失败，玩家将失去游戏进度并回到出生点。这种设定增加了游戏的挑战性，但也为玩家提供了重新开始的机会。失败并不意味着结束，而是重新开始的机会，让玩家能够不断尝试、学习和进步。相信该游戏会给玩家来来全新的体验，快来试试吧！

操作方法：
移动：左手柄向上/向下
转弯：右手柄向左/向右
菜单：菜单键
重置：左/右手柄握键
攻击：右手柄扳机
跳：左手柄扳机

name: 大叔的山门模拟器
summary:
《大叔的山门模拟器》是一款开放世界的修仙类沙盒游戏。游戏中不仅可以体验从练气期到飞升仙界的内容，还可以管理经营你的山门和弟子，为他们的修仙之路解决各种问题，并与众多弟子一同探索大叔的修仙世界。

《大叔的山门模拟器》是一款独特的开放世界修仙游戏，为玩家提供了一个广阔且充满奇幻色彩的修仙世界。游戏中，玩家将扮演一位修仙者，不仅要经历从初入修行到飞升仙界的完整历程，还要负责经营和管理自己的山门，培养并指导弟子们一同成长。
 在这个开放的世界里，玩家可以自由探索各种神秘的地域，寻找珍稀的修仙资源，与其他修仙者交流切磋，不断提升自己的修为。同时，玩家还需处理山门内外的各种事务，为弟子们解决修行中的种种难题，确保他们的成长之路顺利无阻。
 《大叔的山门模拟器》以其丰富的游戏内容、独特的修仙设定和开放的游戏世界，为玩家带来了一段充满挑战与奇遇的修仙之旅。无论是热爱修仙文化的玩家，还是喜欢开放世界冒险的玩家，都能在这款游戏中找到属于自己的乐趣。

-建造拥有各种功能的山门建筑，壮大门派。
-招收和管理你众多的弟子，授予他们各种职位，分配任务，让他们为门派效力。
-和其他门派进行互动，或敌对或友好，甚至是宗门大战。

-在开放的山海世界中游历各具特色的场景，或采集或历练。
-遇到各式各样的NPC角色，并与他们互动。
-会遇到很多支线剧情以供你或者你的弟子去完成，并获得相应的奖励。

-游戏中会有各种技艺供你选择学习，其中包括炼丹术、锻造术、织造术等等。
-关于技艺还会有更多的玩法和内容。

-游戏内有各种内修外修功法可以学习并修炼至大成境界。
-还可以自创功法，传授弟子，让他们可以凭借你创造的绝学游历山水。
-门派中弟子间可以相互比拼功法，掌门可以设定奖品

-结交NPC角色，或友好或仇恨，打造一个拥有恩怨情仇的修仙世界。
-亲族系统，每一个人物都有自己的家族和背景关系，得罪一个人甚至可以降低整个家族的好感。
-结拜、双修、结婚、生子等等内容期待着你。

 烟鬼大叔是一名八零后游戏爱好者，《大叔的山门模拟器》是烟鬼大叔一个人独立开发的第一款游戏，这个游戏倾注了烟鬼大叔对游戏的热爱和这么多年对游戏的理解和很多想法，也许这个游戏还不完美，开发中还面临着很多技术和资金等等困难，但烟鬼大叔会坚持把游戏做下去，让它成为一个有趣的游戏。
 我知道一款游戏不可能满足所有人的喜好，但我认为只要不放弃认真去做，认真听取大家的意见和意见，我相信《大叔的山门模拟器》会越来越好玩。

name: 堕
summary:
一声——来自井中的响动，是什么人的呼唤，又是在终结后对什么怀有眷恋、不甘和期盼。两声——快门与闪光灯的杂音下，不可见的规则与谜底得以浮现于最熟悉的事物。三声——稀薄的曙光中，终于能够听见，那些生死皆不能抹去的、苦痛的怒吼。迷失的人，你还能找到返回幸福家庭的路吗？

2000年，少年张德宝在自家祖宅中捡到了一台旧相机，随之而来的神秘指引和袭击将他带入那座院中枯井。父母敬拜的慈父神像，陌生的神婆，穿红色嫁衣的新娘……然而，相比种种灵异事件，真正令他感到惶惑恐惧的，是自己正一步一步走近的、被宠爱自己的父母掩盖的家族旧事。

特殊道具：神秘的照相机和具有灵性的日记本，分别属于本作中的两个关键角色。使用它们来切换角色，用不同的视角找出掩藏的真相。

相机机制：在扭曲的颠倒空间中发掘线索。闪光灯摄影可以帮助呈现隐秘的物品与怪物踪迹，然而相对地，它也会引发额外的危险。

日记本附身机制：让神秘的力量附着并占领身体，在危机的涌动中保持冷静、从中脱身。

探索解谜：动用你的智慧和勇气在诡异的环境中拼凑碎片，补全回忆。每一个角落都可能赢藏着重要的线索，每一次的选择都影响着你离真相的距离。

沉浸式叙事体验：一座东南沿海地区的中式老宅，既寻常又陌生，而看似幸福美满的传统家庭，其背后却隐藏着令人不安的过往。你在老宅中与诡异现象的一次次遭遇，将引领你逐渐揭开黑暗与苦涩的真相。

文化探索之旅：《堕》以东亚文化与历史为根基，融入了丰富的民俗元素。嘎吱作响的木板凳、破碎的陶瓷碗、折角的书籍......在探索老宅的过程中，你仿佛能够听到那个时代的声音。

心灵深处的恐怖：《堕》的恐怖不局限于血腥惊悚的视觉冲击。老宅里的压迫感不仅来自直接的威胁，同时更源于对探索未知深渊与幻象的本能战栗。在曾被长久压制的痛苦中，感受无形巨物的悄然窥视。

自我觉醒与赋权：惊悚之外，《堕》更是一场围绕原生家庭与自我觉醒的心灵旅程。随着故事的逐步展开，德宝将触及那些埋藏在现象与往事下的文化局限与代际冲突。在穿越不可知的危险与迷雾时，玩家将伴随主人公一同探索个体的、甚至更加广泛深刻的成长与困境。

社区与支持

欢迎大家通过Discord、Twitter、小红书和微博加入Dual-X的社区，与开发团队及其他玩家互动，了解《堕》最新的开发进展，参与讨论，或提交反馈意见。你也可以通过Kickstarter支持我们的游戏开发，并获得独家实体或电子粉丝福利。大家的每一分支持都将是对我们最大的鼓励！

summary:

name: 西行乱斗
summary:
这是一款诙谐欢乐的自走棋游戏。挑选装备法宝，培育果树妖兽，组建小队大杀四方，勇敢西行！你可以选择各异的角色开始游戏，也可以参与异步匹配的排位模式与其他玩家捉对厮杀，流派超多，每局都是新体验！无数人加入了这场追逐战，弱者暴毙，赢家通吃。你会是走的最远的一个吗？

我们希望有更多热爱这类型游戏的朋友们可以参与到试玩并给出任何游戏反馈，大家的支持是团队的最大动力！感谢！
《西行乱斗》交流QQ群：205069431

据说西边有神龙，得之可长生不老，天下无敌！无数豪杰加入了这场寻宝游戏，弱者暴毙，赢家通吃。你会是走的最远的一个吗……
《西行乱斗》是一款看似休闲实则硬核、脑洞极大的卡牌自走棋游戏。培育果树锻造神兵，组合法宝构筑流派，你可以选择不同角色开始他们的冒险故事，也可以参与异步匹配的排位竞技场与其他玩家捉对厮杀。种田养猪能修仙，背包整理可渡劫，超多奇葩套路等你解锁，每一次西行都是全新的策略实验！

游戏创新地将种田元素融入自走棋模式，用种植酿造饮食买卖的逻辑包装玩法。每个阵营都设计了特色的养成机制，或养猪开吃，或种树致富，又或锻造投石、挖矿修真……养成流派与你的“种田”大法密不可分，需要利用有限的物品格规划资源的循环产出，实现收益最大化，烧脑又上头。

游戏以经典卡牌自走棋为原型，融合了背包管理要素。6大阵营、40+角色、200+道具开启排列组合狂欢！ 3个角色栏位、12个道具格，每次摆放都是场微型战略部署，需要疯狂开动大脑才能探索出技能组合最优解。构筑爱好者狂喜！

对众多家喻户晓的神话和历史人物进行重绘。画风预警，每个角色都被毕加索开了光——非常抽象，但休闲解压，只此一家，并在抽象手绘与功能传达间取得微妙平衡。怎么不是一种特色呢！

中式世界观打底，乱炖各神话体系下的妖魔鬼怪以及不同年代的历史人物。角色技能与其背景出处挂钩，并在游戏内被重新整编进了饿鬼寨、金元会、天地通、八仙班、流兵营、炼气宗这六大阵营。阎罗孟婆、朱雀饕餮、吕布貂蝉再就业；孔明碗、致富经、芭蕉扇显神通。故事模式中还有7段无厘头风格的角色漫画等你探索。

name: オモイカネ
summary:
用这款激烈的类 roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏深入探索令人上瘾的立直麻将世界。用强力的牌砌筑你的牌墙，驾驭复杂的互动，并在与神明对手的战斗中测试你的技巧。在这场充满刺激的对抗熵的战斗中，每一手都至关重要！

"思兼神"是一款立直麻将的卡牌构筑游戏，神明们将成为你的对手。

从标准的136张牌开始，将你的牌墙发展成新的形式，以达到不可能的手牌和令人难以置信的得分。通过谨慎的规划、强大的直觉，也许还有一点点运气来精通这个游戏。
更多详细信息即将公布。请考虑将"思兼神"添加到您的愿望清单中以保持了解！

summary:
《HinataFes 2026》停办公告

2026.09.02

原定于2026年9月5日（星期六）、6日（星期日）举行的《HinataFes 2026》，考量至今日为止的气象预报，决定「停办」。

虽然各界皆期盼天候能有所好转，但考量到众多粉丝将从全国各地透过各式交通方式前往宫崎，营运团队于今日进行了综合评估。
评估明日起会场的设营计划、预测可能发生的交通混乱等状况后，为以来场者、出演者、工作人员及所有相关人员的安全为最优先考量，最终做出此一决定。

包含各项退票细节等停办相关事宜，
将于明日中午过后陆续公告。

对于期待已久的各位，我们致上最深的歉意，敬请见谅。

고금제일인이자 무림인들에게 있어 재앙과도 같은 존재 ‘천마’의 등장에 파국으로 치닫는 중원.

빠르게 본래의 실력을 되찾은 ‘소년’ 천휘는, 이번에야말로 그녀를 지키겠노라 마음먹는다.

Embark on a journey to save MOONSHIRE as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

MOONSHIRE is an action-adventure game set in a non-linear world full of many challenges, and many rewards! Forced to escape your homeland due to an ominous threat, you assume the role of the Sage's Apprentice, whose goal is to find a way to save MOONSHIRE.

By exploring your surroundings and overcoming the dungeons, bosses, and battles along the way, you'll uncover exciting new items and abilities that improve your options in combat, while also opening up new areas to explore.

Uncover the mysteries surrounding the unknown threat, and make your way back home to MOONSHIRE! Your path is filled with challenges and opportunities, so arm yourself with unique abilities and an arsenal of weapons. The fate of MOONSHIRE rests in your hands...

A political-simulation watch-the-clock strategy game. Pass laws, executive orders, and deal with events, all while maintaining the balance of your nation's most important attributes. Will you manage to keep your coalition together or establish a dictatorship? Only you can decide, Prime Minister.

Become the Prime Minister of one of many nations, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. You must keep your job by balancing the agenda of the various parties forming your coalition while also ensuring that your country stays healthy through various decisions. Will you pursue free market capitalism, install a planned economy with workers at the forefront, or strike a balance between the two? Will you form a brutal police state or pursue individual freedoms for all your citizens? The choice is yours...

By approving or vetoing Bills and Executive Orders from all sects of the political spectrum, you must ensure that values intrinsic to national health, such as the strength of the military and the quality of education, maintain balanced. You also need to make sure that you're doing enough to make the people want to keep your party in power.

- 7 political parties to choose from, falling on all points of the political spectrum
- 4 nations with distinct advantages and disadvantages

Here are just a few of the things you will experience while on a hunt…

Scenes
Travel between various Locations taking part in one Scene after another to progress your story while managing your resources and welfare. Inflict injuries on the Creature while avoiding injuries yourself. Inflict enough and win the hunt. Incur enough and lose all hope.

Events
In every Scene there is a chain of Events. But not all take place. After experiencing an Event, it’s on to another Scene. Use your Items, Actions, and choices to instigate or negate Events in order to realize your plans while mitigating the risks you face along the way. 

Disasters
When tension builds, disaster approaches. If enough Tension cards are gained (by way of Events) then a Disaster is drawn. Travelers
Not all Scenes are bound to a Location. Traveling cards move about the hunt’s locations just like the hunter.
