summary:
Classic Plinko Game With New Theme and Challenge

Classic Plink Game

(No Pay - No Withdraw) Just For Fun

Play - Challenge - Custom = Fun 

Plink is a popular carnival-style game that is both entertaining and unpredictable. It is named after the distinct sound made when a small disc, often made of plastic, plinks and plunks its way down the game board.

The game board typically consists of a vertical, peg-filled wall. At the top of the wall, a player drops a disc or a puck into the game, aiming for it to land in one of the designated slots at the bottom. The slots are worth different point values, with some offering higher rewards than others.

As the disc descends, it bounces off the pegs, bouncing and changing direction in a random manner. The path the disc takes is influenced by the pegs, creating suspense and anticipation as players hope for their disc to hit a high-scoring slot.

Once the disc reaches the bottom, it lands in a slot, awarding the player the corresponding number of points. The points earned for each slot typically decrease from top to bottom, but there may also be bonus slots or special features that enhance the gameplay.

Plink can be enjoyed both as a physical game at carnivals and as a virtual game in game shows or online platforms. It combines elements of chance, skill, and anticipation, making it an exciting and engaging experience for players of all ages.

summary:
Disaster Golf is a new, fast-paced take on golf that requires you to react on the fly. Experiment with many combinations of natural disasters to navigate the golf ball through wild and diverse courses as fast as you can!

It’s a beautiful day outside. The hippos are screaming, the dinosaurs are dying, and all you want to do is play some miniature golf. You forgot your clubs, but that’s okay. Mother Nature has you covered. 

Send meteors to fling your golf ball into the air or trigger earthquakes to surge the ball forward - anything to get that sweet par.
Key Features:

Fast-paced golf! No need to wait for your ball to stop moving - hit it again as soon as you can. Disaster Golf is all about speed and getting the ball into the hole as fast as possible using any means available. Combine your natural disasters to get the fastest time!

Leaderboards and replays! See how your times stack up on each level using our leaderboards! Want to improve your times? Activate the ghost ball to see exactly how they got that speedy world record time, or compare against the world record or your personal best time in race mode!

Multiple level themes! Golf across biomes! Use meteors in the sand of a beach, suck the ball into a jungle singularity, or shoot it into the sky on a geyser of lava. Explore the beautiful worlds of Disaster Golf!

Challenge mode! Tired of choosing your own disasters? Let us do that for you. Replay any level in its challenge mode using carefully selected, preset disasters to bring about a unique way of playing. Each challenge mode variant of a level has its own leaderboard - can you devise the best strategy with the disasters you're given and take the top spot?

Hippos! Hippos here, hippos there, hippos everywhere! Looking to follow Fred's noble quest to overthrow the evil hippo god? Just here for the golf? We've got you covered either way.

Early development by Bradley University's game design undergraduate class of 2022.

summary:
This is Posthaste; fast-paced, arcade rally racing game. Delivered by a solo developer, it aims to provide a challenging yet entertaining experience to its players. 

The Fundamentals of Posthaste

Boost - Filling up over time, the Boost feature can give your car either slow or instant burst of acceleration depending on your choice, including Default (Instant), Snappy (Instant), and Burn (Slow).

Haste Meter - No matter how much boost you use, you'll always want more power. Fill your Haste Meter by drifting and driving at high speeds. With your Haste Meter full, you'll be able to initiate ProBoost. 

ProBoost - The ProBoost feature allows you to have a major 10-second speed boost, which becomes available after filling up your Haste Meter. 

Configuration - Basic configuration options for changing the Boost mode and adjusting gear ratios are available.

Car Mods - Simple modification options such as boost refill speed and lightweight chassis are included to give you an advantage which can be unlocked by driving.

Ghost Replay - Race against the ghost representation of your previous/best attempts

Other currently available content

5 Stages 

5 Cars 

10 Steam Achievements to unlock

Will you unlock the secrets and survive the CODEDOOR?

Aladdin of the Forsaken Lands is a retro rpg which offers a novel take on the classic Arabian Nights tale. Six unlikely allies will join together to uncover an ancient artifact and prevent their kingdom from falling into the wrong hands...
NARRATIVE
Aladdin is a thief and adventurer who was found near the border of the Forsaken Lands. Forced to become a prisoner, he is joined by Inaya, a cloaked woman with a hidden past, and Altair, a guardsman who watches over yet cares for the prisoners in his stewardship. ROMANCE & PARTNERSHIPS

ATB COMBAT

A "Wait ON" option can be toggled to prevent the enemy from attacking while a move is being selected, allowing the player to decide how frantic they'd like their combat encounters to be.

summary:
Escape The Pyramid offers a short action-horror experience. Try to escape a procedurally generated pyramid in the dark while making use only of sounds. Listen carefully for what you step on to avoid traps such as pressure plate mechanisms and swinging blades.

Escape The Pyramid is an action-horror game having its core based on sound cues.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

Procedurally generated pyramid rooms means each playthrough is different and it makes it impossible to find, remember and reuse a path for the next playthrough.

Sound Cues will guide you to the exit. Your footsteps will make different sounds based on the surface you step on, helping you decide whether or not it's worth going further or taking a different path. You will occasionally get close or even step on different kinds of lethal or non-lethal traps.

STORY

After an unusual sandstorm, a sand dune was swept and it revealed this large pyramid. The locals from the nearby village do not seem to know about its origin or even its existence.

The explorer within you is immediately drawn to its massive presence... as well as to the potential findings inside it. In a rush, you grab nothing but a torch and head towards the pyramid.

The main entrance will certainly be every other explorer's choice, but you want to get ahead. Behind the pyramid, you enter through a cracked open block and after a couple of dropdowns, you end up in the most distant rooms from the main entrance.

You found the deepest room inside the pyramid full of gold and other priceless artifacts. However it seems that an ancient danger is now awake.

Find the exit before it's too late.

summary:

At the collapse of the USSR, in 1991, some frozen conflicts began in its previous territory, which endures to this day. Milata split from the internationally recongnized state of Dalina, and after five months of war, it remained under control of its territory. As a country with no formal international recognition, it prepared for a eminent war for over a decade.
After a young recruit sees his whole squadron being slaughtered in the battlefields, he goes on a one-man army quest to save his homeland.

Cold Ground is an aesthetically MSX-inspired action RPG with an open world environment. With the mission to locate and kill the enemy general and to locate and destroy the enemy military aid; the player must explore the country of Milata and part of Dalina, in search of enemies to kill, POWs to rescue, and money and weapons to loot.

Start the game as a weak, inexperienced soldier, with no chance in hell to accomplish your mission; level up by killing enemies, rescuing POWs and completing one of the quests.

Minimalist pixel art graphics as a ode to the early days of computer gaming.

An open world with the missions accessible from the get-go.

Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting MMO set in a universe based on Norse mythology. Materials collected by destroying AI ships, other players, and mining asteroids can be used to upgrade your ship, with dozens of models to choose from on your journey from a small fighter to a dreadnought.

Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting looter shooter MMO with ship progression set in a universe based on Norse mythology in early access for PC and Android (Google Play).
Combat:
The game focuses heavily on ship to ship combat, allowing players to blow up NPC ships en mass and collect the loot they drop, or fight other players.

The main idea is to simplify the spaceship piloting mechanic seen in other big space titles like Eve or Elite Dangerous by locking ships and bullets so everything is on a flat plane. Not having to deal with anything moving up and down makes it possible to control a very fast moving ship, dodge bullets, and warp around like not usually seen in MMO space games.
A major decision was made early in development to not feature any kind of "Heat seeking missile" type weapons, meaning you have to actually point your ship at a target to hit them. I've never really cared for the "Locking on and firing a missile and waiting to see if it hits" type of space combat, even if it is more realistic.
Boss fights are designed to be taken on by a party of at least 2 players, and party members share EXP, encouraging team play.
Physics:
Ships are all driven by real physics, meaning when you push the forward button, your ship gets pushed forward with realistic thrust, and momentum is maintained until you press back to activate the reverse thrusters to slow down. This can be challenging to get the hang of, but it does make for a more realistic spaceship pilioting experience, and opens up ways for players to play around with the physics.
Slamming into another player will effect their movement or send them spinning off, instead of you ship just bouncing off.

You can see it too (in Russian, unfortunately). Or read on github. First is was educational project but at some point it turned into something close to Andy Warhol movies. Alone man creating videogame while time passes. But I did it (almost, soft is never complete). 400+ streams and here we are.

We're dealing with twin-stick shooter. These game features 15 levels in 5 "bioms" + 6 boss fights (god I love boss fights). There are 15 mini-bosses in 15 ordinary levels. You have some arsenal with golden classic like shotgun or rocket launcher and dash to correct your mistake or turn around your luck. Unfortunately, I'm not an artist at all so I gone full retro. Recreated vibes of overcoming 1983 crisis. Colors of NES, sounds of some ancient machine, music a-la "Mozart meets NintendoCore" and simplistic graphic. summary:
Survive, evolve, and adapt in a rapidly changing world. Survive the test of time, and become an integral part of your world's biosphere. Or play God and build a full ecosystem in seconds.

Star in your own paleontology documentary!
 Atoms and Time is an evolution survival game with a strong scientific focus, powered by new technological advances in ecosystem simulation. Unlike other evolution simulators, Atoms and Time inserts you right into this world, filled with other species that adapt just as fast as you can. The story of your organism's survival is told in a simplified format inspired by games like Oregon Trail, skipping the wilderness-wandering and throwing you right into the highlights of your creature's life. 

Advanced Evolution Prediction
Playing through one organism's lifetime is fast, but the road of evolution is a long and complex one. Atoms and Time does not ask the player to wait around for an interesting mutation to randomly appear in your simulation, or provide the player unrealistic creative tools for character creation. Instead, the algorithm of "auto-evo" calculates the selection pressures that affect your species, given the current environment and known laws of biology. As the player, you get to choose one of a few scientifically plausible pathways to pursue. After that, it's up to you to survive with the tools given to you by nature.

Alternatively, you can play Atoms and Time as a simulator, producing in seconds what other evolution simulators might take hours to accomplish. In addition, auto-evo allows the simulation to understand HOW a species is surviving, and why certain mutations were selected, providing a new window into the story of your simulated life.

Note from the developer
I'm a cross-country paraglider from Bavaria. In this game, I wanted to captue the fun of flying cross-country, accessible for a wider gaming audience.

While it does have many realistic aspects of steering a glider, thermalling, and how thermal clouds cycle on and off, I erred on the arcade rather than the hyper-realistic simulation.

Real clouds don't pop with a satisfying "bing" sound when you touch them. I've touched many.

The game also tends to have more action than a real flight, which most of the time, feels pretty zen.

If you never had the chance to fly a paraglider, it's a bit like hiking, but from the comfort of a hammock. And with the most spectacular view.

I hope this game gets some of you interested in flying. And fills some idle ground time for my fellow pilots.

Enjoy and save landings!

Delve into a dwarvish citadel full of locked doors to rescue your goblin friends imprisoned within. Relive your favorite moments from Dickens, Zola, and Marx, learn about the history of working conditions and worker rights and how they got where they are today, and think of where they could still go!

The textile industry is still one of the most exploitative industries in the world.

Magic.

name: 纽洛亚诺克
summary:
纽洛亚诺克融合了恐怖、悬疑和心理惊悚元素，提供身临其境的叙事体验。让自己沉浸在精心打造的科幻世界中，在战斗中体验令人毛骨悚然的太空殖民冒险。作为一名失意的老兵，你将追随神圣的指引，拯救生活在水深火热之中的同胞，痛击你的敌人。

故事发生在一个饱受第三次世界大战余波蹂躏的后世界末日世界中，人类的残余分子被赶出地球，在宇宙的未知领域寻求庇护。然而，他们的救赎很快就变成了一场噩梦，因为他们遇到了一系列威胁他们生存的深不可测的挑战。

你发现自己登上了一艘前往木星的巨大宇宙飞船，木星是战败国家最后的希望堡垒。但在浩瀚的太空中，你的飞船停了下来，被困在日益减少的资源和阴险的暴力邪教的魔掌之中。种族紧张局势和仇恨猖獗，将脆弱的社会结构推向极限。

作为主角，你醒来时不记得自己的过去，你的记忆迷失在深渊中。然而，一个神秘的声音在向你招手，召唤你拥抱自己的命运，成为被选中的人。在这个神秘存在的引导下，你踏上了危险的探索之路，夺回预言遗产的荣耀，同时与未知的恐怖作斗争。

探索休眠飞船的怪异走廊，那里笼罩在阴影中，回响着被遗忘的灵魂的低语。当你在一个摇摇欲坠的疯狂边缘世界中航行时，会遇到各种各样的幸存者，每个人都在与自己的恐惧和隐藏的议程作斗争。揭开深埋在飞船内部的秘密，拼凑出你过去的碎片，解开你的目的之谜。

小心行事，因为每个角落都潜藏着危险。发挥你的足智多谋和狡猾来战胜无情的对手，无论是人类还是超凡脱俗的对手。配备一系列简易武器和从船上破旧的基础设施中抢救出来的先进技术，与怪异生物进行激烈的战斗。

主要特征：

- 扣人心弦的科幻太空恐怖体验

- 一点一点揭开这艘船的神秘面纱和你自己的过去

- 与无情的对手进行激烈的战斗

- 探索一艘精心制作、充满大气细节的船只

- 遇到一群不同的角色，每个角色都有自己的故事要讲

- 沉浸在令人惊叹的视觉效果和令人毛骨悚然的音频设计中

- 揭开永恒的回声，塑造人类的命运

准备踏上一段难忘的黑暗之旅。你会夺回你的遗产并引导人类走向救赎，还是会屈服于太空中等待的恐怖？

summary:
The chess pieces you know, but with an addictive, puzzle game twist! Get the highest score possible while staying ready to capture the King. Featuring daily challenges, rogue-like elements, and more!

The Chess pieces you know, but with an addictive puzzle-game twist! You must get the highest score possible while also leaving yourself the material to capture the king.

Do I Need To Know Chess?

We hear this question a lot. The answer is simple: no! Chess Mess will teach you everything you need to know with move indicators and our tutorial system.

Puzzle Game Madness

You control both white and black pieces. Each piece moves how you would expect: knights make an L shape, rooks move in straight lines, etc. What's different is the quantity and placement of the pieces. Each level features a board featuring a randomly generated piece layout which pose a progressively harder challenge as you advance through the game.

Meet the Par Score

Each board has a Par Score that needs to be cleared in order to enter the King phase. Clear the Par Score in as few moves as possible for the most bragging rights! 

Summon The King

The King will appear on the board after the par score is met--and the King is out for blood! Use your remaining pieces to capture him and put an end to his rampage! 

Earn Cards

When you beat a level you earn cards which can buff or nerf (or sometimes both) specific pieces. Cards can stack, too! But watch out for curses, as they can add a serious wrinkle to the gameplay!

Infinite Replayability

Use a seed or start a New Game and discover a unique, procedurally generated set of boards that present their own unique challenges.

Share Boards

Boards are generated based on seeds and these seeds are shareable with your friends. Compare scores and see if you can beat the par score!

Daily Challenges

Compete with your friends with daily online challenges, leaderboards, and more!

Xenomycology is a metroidvania tower defense game. You control a colony of extra-terrestrial fungus spreading across a planet, and fighting off invading creatures. Xenomycology also offers a peaceful mode if you only want to grow mushrooms and explore the world.

A single spore floats gently to the alien earth below. It lands, and against all odds, finds the minerals and water it needs to take root. Its mycelium spreads, and a mushroom bursts forth from the inhospitable soil. This mushroom is you, and soon your colony will cover the entirety of this planet. 

Xenomycology is a city builder, tower defense, and metroidvania. You control a colony of extra-terrestrial fungus spreading across a planet. Invading aliens will attempt to wipe you out, so you will need to balance your resource gathering with defenses. 

Gameplay

Xenomycology is played room-by-room. In each room you will start with a single mushroom, and steadily build up your resources to expand your colony. Some rooms will be contested - enemies will attack after a set amount of time. Enemies will come in waves, and you will need to build defensive mushrooms to take them out. After the waves are complete, you'll be able to move on to a new room. 

Xenomycology is not linear, however. Many rooms will have multiple exits, and some of the exits will be blocked until you've unlocked certain technologies. This means you can backtrack to old rooms and improve your existing colonies. This doesn't just allow you to find new exits and explore new areas, though, existing colonies will send a percentage of their resources to new rooms. So, upgrading your old colonies will give your new colonies an advantage.

Features

Xenomycology is a city builder, but your city is a colony of extra-terrestrial mushrooms. Grow mushrooms that gather resources, or help your colony expand across gaps or up cliffs. Balance spreading your colony against the resource needs of your existing mushrooms.

summary:
This is a VR trip into the ancient world – playing Kottabos, the all-time favorite Greek party game. Prove your skill by throwing the dregs of wine from your cup at the metal disk on the pole in front of you, or fling your drops at the little cups floating in a bowl.

This is a VR trip into the ancient world – playing Kottabos, the all-time favorite Greek party game. All the items you see around you are 3D reconstructions of actual ancient furniture, pottery, and Kottabos targets from museums. This historical game is harder than it looks! 

In ancient Greece Kottabos was a popular party game in which players threw the dregs from the bottom of their cup at targets. These included a disk on the top of a pole and cups floating in a bowl of water. They competed for adoration, praise, and respect of the other party-goers.

Prove your skill by throwing the dregs of wine from your cup at the metal disk on the pole in front of you, or fling your drops at the little cups floating in a bowl. If the disk or the cups go down, your luck goes up! A round of applause, an extra dessert, or the favor of Aphrodite herself will come to the winners.

Game Features:

Physics-driven gameplay in VR.

Controller momentum and trigger button throws the dregs.

Aim at the different targets, and get higher scores based on strength of hit and placement on the target.

Three different levels of gameplay.

Tutorial level.

Track your high scores.

Educational! Learn about Kottabos, the real Greek party game.

Free! Use for classes.

name: Ayakashi Princess: Prequel
summary:
The fox princess's great adventure! A story from a little while ago. Tamamo Hime wakes up in the Ayakashi world, ``Kakuriyo.'' She makes her way home, feeling a bit uncomfortable. Explore various stages and move forward with graceful actions! Is this world a dream or...

As the title suggests, ``Ayakashi Princess: Prequel'' is the first work in the ``Ayakashi Princess'' series, and is a prequel to the next work, which is the main story.
It is a Metroidvania where you explore various stages by making full use of remaining bullet management, evasion, and "charm" that turns enemies into allies.
Story
The main character is Tamamohime, the daughter of the nine-tailed monster, Tamamo-mae.
She was enjoying her leisurely life in a huge mansion with her mother, but one day she woke up to find herself outside the mansion grounds.
As she turned towards the mansion that towered over the sky in the distance, she didn't miss the moment when the sky glowed magically.
Feeling uneasy about something, she heads home to her mother.
Is this world a dream or...?
Game features
This is a game where the player explores various connected stages and ultimately returns to her mother, Tamamomae.
The setting is the realm where the demon fox (Yoko) lives. A wide variety of demon foxes will stand in front of the player.
The main character, Tamamo Hime, has unique abilities.
She can use powerful ranged attacks, but she can only use them six times in a row at a time. Reloading is required for reuse. She can wait to reload like a normal shooter, but she can also actively reload by using "load evasion" which reloads at the same time as evasion.
Her health is only 5. However, she can recover her health by drawing enemy attacks to the limit and avoiding them.
And her illicit ability, ``Charm'', allows her to forcibly turn enemies into allies.
Use these to overcome her obstacles and lead her to her mother.

Mountable weapons (guns, machine guns, lasers, launchers), a mountable shield, ammo (torpedoes and emp torpedoes), and consumable items for heating and in-battle stats increases. You can also find weapons and other items in certain places in the map.

You must make your way through the map and the various "dungeons" to find and defeat the Red Juggernaut. There are over 30 types of enemy ships that you will encounter as you travel, with a varying degree of difficulty. In battle, once you drop their defense screens you can damage blocks individually. If you destroy a component that causes a large portion of the enemy ship to be detached from it's cockpit, those orphaned blocks will be destroyed as well. You can also evade torpedo strikes, and make yourself less vulnerable to attack by using your engines. As well, you can utilize EMP strikes to take down enemy shields, and disable enemy weapons temporarily.

Mazes and Labyrinths is a single screen puzzle game set in the fantasy world of Antinomia. Use your wits, powers, and even the enemies themselves to solve over 70 deceptively difficult mazes, or create your own levels and puzzles to challenge your friends.

Welcome to Mazes and Labyrinths, a deceptively difficult single screen puzzle game set in the fantasy world of Antinomia. Play as Will and Ari as you battle the prophet Sybilla and the invading Omniety, an alien being reshaping the planet to its whims. Use your wits, powers, and even the enemies themselves to find an exit to every maze and save Antinomia and its people from certain destruction.

Created by OnlineVideoSurfer, Mazes and Labyrinths features over 70 puzzles in the main campaign plus a robust level editor to make and play your own levels. For more dedicated players, most levels also feature a bonus medal to truly test your ability to break the game. The goal is an almost arcade-puzzle experience, with short, bite-sized levels and simple graphics that nevertheless disguise deeply complex, rule-based design. Learning the intricacies of the powerups, the enemies, and the full implications of your abilities is essential to both mastering the campaign and making your own mazes for others.

There are no pay to win mechanics, no in-game currencies, nor any other monetization features to diminish the game. This is a free game made by one person for anyone that wants challenging yet thoughtful puzzles or desires to make their own levels.

Persevere and overcome the challenges and you will hopefully find a rewarding puzzle game that, by the endgame, will push your reasoning to its limits. For everyone that tries, I wish you luck.

Mirrors of Epiphany is a puzzle game where you guide light beams to their designated goals by placing mirrors on a board.
Core gameplay
Light sources and detectors (paired up by colours) are placed around an empty board. The challenge is to place mirrors in positions and orientations so that each source and detector pair is connected.
No portals!
Portals are very cool! And for sure, portals have been used in many fascinating and clever ways in a lot of puzzle games. But they don't have to be a part of "every" puzzle game. Sometimes less is more, so Mirrors of Epiphany contains exactly zero portals. In fact it doesn't contain colour splitters, blockers or any other peculiar stuff either. There's just mirrors; two-sided mirrors behaving perfectly normal, redirecting light beams as in well-known, classic physics. But beware; you cannot always place the mirrors exactly as you would like to...
Rich in content
There are 100 unique puzzles, ranging from the simplest possible to larger boards with multiple pairs of light sources and detectors.
Choose your own challenge level
Most puzzles have a lot of workable solutions, but each puzzle has only one optimal solution (i.e. using as few mirrors as possible). Explore and play around to find solutions that just get the job done, or satisfy your puzzle solving instincts by reaching for perfection.
Unlimited number of moves
You can place mirrors, change their orientations, and remove them again as many times as you like. The number of moves are not counted. The only scoring measure is the number of mirrors placed on the board when all pairs of light sources and detectors are connected.

summary:
A physics-based roguelite where the mountain is alive, the items are cursed, and collecting Eyes only makes things worse. Swing your way to the top. It won't kill you. Probably.

This Mountain Won't Climb Itself

Eldritch Climb is a physics-based roguelite built around movement with unique controls. Swing from handholds, launch yourself across gaps, and cling to whatever you can find. The movement is raw and expressive, every run feels different as you get better. Master it, and the mountain becomes a playground. Don't, and it becomes a grave.

The More You See, The Worse It Gets

Scattered across the mountain are Eyes, a cursed currency that expands your perception. Collect enough and the world shifts. Levels mutate. Enemies evolve. Every mechanic reveals a darker variation of itself. There are three layers to everything on this mountain, and the deeper you see, the less you'll wish you had.

Something Is Very Wrong With This Mountain

Puzzles are hidden in every area, quiet and strange things that don't announce themselves. Solve them and you'll enter memories: glimpses of your character, the mountain's history, and the cults that worshipped it. The lore won't be handed to you. It's buried, like everything else worth knowing here.

Cursed Tools For A Cursed Climb

Loot corpses. Browse the shop. Equip items in each hand, but whatever you're gripping with, you can't use. That constraint is the whole puzzle. Find a combo that works, lean into it, and watch a run come together. Passive items soften the edges. Active ones create chaos. Usually both at once.

summary:
A chaotic co-op physics game where you and your friends push, pull, and reshape collapsing voxel caves to move massive objectives that no one can carry alone. Every run creates new disasters, clutch saves, and shared moments worth retelling.

Gobby Gang is a social-first physics game where you and your friends must push, pull, roll, and carry massive objectives through collapsing voxel caves.

The goal is simple. Move the object.
The challenge is everything else.

The bomb has weight, momentum, and consequences. Every push matters. Every mistake affects the group. Gravity does not forgive hesitation, and bad teamwork is immediately felt.

Reshape the World

The caves are fully destructible voxel environments. Dig tunnels, carve ramps, blast shortcuts, and build your own path forward. The world reacts to your decisions and often collapses when you need it most.

Navigate the level and reshape it under pressure!

High-Stakes Escapes

Each run features a unique cave layout and escalates toward a frantic final collapse sequence that erases your path and forces split-second coordination.

Plans fall apart. Ramps crumble. The objective rolls where it shouldn’t.
What happens next depends entirely on your team.

Every session feels different because the outcome is driven by physics, environment, and human behavior.

Built for Shared Moments

Gobby Gang is designed around communication, improvisation, and recovery.

Work together to move something that resists being moved

Adapt when small mistakes become major disasters

Turn near-failures into last-second saves

Survive chaotic collapses as a team

This is not a mastery-focused challenge. It is a shared experience engine.

The game does not hand you a scripted story. It gives you the tools to create your own with friends.

When the dust settles and someone says “GG,” you will know exactly why.

summary:
A fast paced and combat oriented 2D platformer. Use multiple weapons and create multiple elemental reactions to efficiently eliminate your enemies. Experience a short story about your origins and try getting the best score possible in the arcade mode.

SANGI is a fast paced platformer, merged with an innovative combat system. You can choose to experience a very short story, or jump into the arcade mode to get the best score that is possible. It's focus lies on it's combat systems and how every mechanic blends in with each other.
Combat System

This is the focus of the game. You have 4 different weapons, each with 3 different abilities. These abilities use their assigned color bar. Everytime you damage an enemy, there's a big chance that they will drop an orb. This orb comes in 3 colors and fills the corresponding color bar a lot and others a small amount. Here's the catch, it fills all bars and other weapons' color bars, even if its a small amount. You can activate the ability even if it has a really low ability color bar. If you activate an ability with a really low color bar, it results with it being less effective. For example, a shield ability mitigates a really low percentage of incoming damage with a low bar, and a damaging ability deals less damage with a low color bar.

In this example above, we chose to catch the particles with the first and third weapons. To do this efficiently, we chose to use the Compaction reaction, which happens when air and fire statuses cancel each other, and it spawns an orb particle that can fill the color bars. You can see how 2 and 4 weapons' color bars are similar since we didnt catch these particles with those weapons. Since every bar has some charge, you can activate every ability you have.
Combat System: Abilities

There are 12 abilities in this game. Some abilities have really unique activating conditions, and some abilities are extremely simple to use. For example, water weapon's second ability (or, it's green bar ability)

Features

Shard-Shifting Action: Each of your elemental Shards has a limited reserve of mana. To survive, you must think on the fly, switching off of depleted mana pools to engage the enemy with fresh magic, and planning out how to use your resources to succeed in each encounter.

Dangerous Encounters: The Empire's forces aren't content to simply march ahead to their doom. Demo Available

To that end you can choose from a host of vehicles but you must also build the necessary logistics to support your defense.   

     The game is single player with a campaign that sees you embark on a series of missions. Gameplay can range anywhere from idle city builder to high octane mech fighting simulation.

summary:
400年前を生きる海賊王×時を渡ってしまった撮影助手

カリブ海で沈没船引き揚げの撮影に同行していたカメラ助手の日下部一帆は、海に現れた謎の渦に呑まれ、目覚めると――海賊船の上にいた。彼を救ったのは、美しく威厳ある船長ジャン。どうやら一帆は、海賊が生きる時代へと迷い込んでしまったらしい。敵対しているという海賊フェリペに狙われながらも、現代の知識を活かしてジャンの船を助けるうち、一帆は次第に仲間として受け入れられ、ジャンとも強く惹かれ合っていくが、その想いは彼を危険に晒すことにも繋がってしまう。離れがたい想いと、元の世界へ帰りたい願いの間で揺れる一帆。一方、ジャンには決して語ろうとしない秘密があり――。

name: 祈りの盾は義兄の執愛を知らぬまま
summary:
執着を隠す義兄×義兄に憧れながらも孤独を感じる美貌の弟

グラトゥス国では、防御の力〈シールド〉と攻撃の力〈ソード〉を持つ者が国を支えている。だが二つの力は決して結ばれてはならない――国を滅ぼす災厄を生むと信じられているからだ。シールドの最高位である「国の守り手」を担うアルフは、騎士団長でありソードの頂点である「国の剣」である義兄グレンに守られて育った。しかし、アルフの婚約をきっかけに、互いに隠していた想いが溢れ出してしまう。義兄弟として、そして禁じられた力を持つ者同士として、決して許されない恋。それでも惹かれ合う二人の想いは止められず…?

name: ABC殺人事典
summary: 「D坂の殺人事件」で有名な「団子坂」で起きた奇妙な転落事故の真相とは？（「D:坂道の怪」） 「フレンチと深川の理に従いて」という遺言は、何を示しているのか。（「H:ある推理作家の遺言」） 親友からのメッセージ。語尾の「w」の使い方がいつもと違う？（「W:癖」） それぞれのアルファベットをテーマに『このミス』大賞受賞作家が描くショートミステリー26編！

name: 迷宮城砦で術士は恋夜に惑う
summary:
迷宮城砦における自警団のリーダー×異国に逃げた訳あり術士

訳あって日本を離れ、異国・天嶺國へ渡った術士・宿護玲。旅の途中で誘拐されかけていた幼い少年・阿仔に出会い、追手から逃れるため、彼とともに無法地帯〈迷宮城砦〉へと身を寄せることになる。城砦を束ねていたのは、荒々しくも義に厚い武闘派自警団のリーダー・焔鋒。玲は彼に拾われ、阿仔を狙う道士一族・莫家の脅威をやり過ごしながら、城砦での奇妙な共同生活を始める。城砦の人々の力になりたい――その想いは、やがて焔鋒との衝突を生んでしまう。それでも彼に歩み寄ろうとした矢先、玲は焔鋒に唇を奪われる。大きな戸惑いと怒りに揺れる玲。そんな中、阿仔を巡る陰謀と、玲の兄である術士の襲来が城砦を揺るがす。さらに、焔鋒が信じていた人物の裏切りまでもが明らかになり――。

name: 氷の辺境伯と生贄王子の契約結婚
summary:
人嫌いの氷の辺境伯×妖魔の生贄になる運命の王子

南国の王子ミラは妖魔の生贄になることが運命づけられていた。しかし、熱病に罹患してしまったため、北の国の魔力を体内に入れると快癒するという民間療法に一縷の望みをかけ、人嫌いと噂の北の辺境伯グラントと二年間という期限つきの契約結婚をすることになるが…?

name: 狼殿下と愛され黒猫妃の祝福
summary:
貫井ひつじ先生の大人気作品「狼殿下と黒猫」シリーズ第5弾!

互いを思いあうシェインとランフォードの前に、ランフォードの愛妾になりに来たと宣言する栗鼠王女が現れる。だがシェインは、王女の愚行に心を痛める乳母の顔色が日増しに悪くなっていることが気がかりだった。シェインもまた必死の呼び声が相手に届かない辛さを知っているからだ。一方、ランフォードは王女に付き従う猫獣人の商人から偽りの臭いを嗅ぎ取っていた。不穏な気配に、ランフォードはシェインを守ることを改めて誓うが…?

name: 狼殿下と黒猫愛妻の献身
summary:
貫井ひつじ先生の大人気作品「狼殿下と黒猫」シリーズ第3弾!

互いが唯一無二の番となった猫獣人のシェインと狼獣人の国の王弟で騎士ランフォード。シェインは失っていた声を取り戻し始めるが、まだランフォードの前以外で話せずにいた。そんな中、犬獣人の国から双子の王子がやってくる。ランフォードに憧れる兄王子は傲慢な性格で次々と問題を起こし、さらにシェインを侮辱してランフォードの逆鱗に触れる。シェインは兄王子にうまく抗議できなかったことに落ちこみ、いつも愛を与えてくれるランフォードの心を守りたいと決意するが…?

name: 狼殿下と黒猫新妻の蜜月
summary:
国一番の騎士である王弟×身代わりの花嫁のその後の物語!

声を失った猫獣人のシェインは、本物の王子の身代わりとして狼獣人の国の王弟で騎士ランフォードに嫁ぐことになる。思いがけずランフォードと心を通わし、互いが唯一無二の番となる。だが死者の魂が帰ってくる祭りを迎え、シェインは毎夜魘されるようになる。さらに狐獣人の国からランフォードを篭絡するために送り込まれた公爵・カテリーナが、声の出ないシェインを愚弄し、ランフォードの逆鱗に触れる。不安になるシェインに、「私の伴侶はシェインだけだ」と揺るぎないランフォード。だが、シェインは声を取り戻したいと願い…?

name: Elric of Melniboné
summary: For ten thousand years Melnibone ruled the world. Elric, the 428th Emperor, seemed destined to see that era come to an end. An albino, sustained by rare drugs, it fell to him to confront the rise of the Young Kingdoms and the monsters and sorceries which were threatening to overwhelm him and his ancient crown.

name: 狼殿下と黒猫妻の深愛
summary:
貫井ひつじ先生の大人気作品「狼殿下と黒猫」シリーズ第4弾!

身代わりの花嫁から狼獣人の王弟ランフォードの妃となった猫獣人のシェインは、初めての外出で『迎えに来ます』という書き置きと共に置き去りにされた赤ん坊を発見する。赤ん坊は王城で保護されるが、シェインは赤ん坊と接するうちに自分ではランフォードに子供を授けられないことを悩むようになる。赤ん坊の両親探しが続く中、シェインの元同僚であり、兄貴分のジョイスが城を訪ねてきた。予期せぬ再会にシェインは喜び、ジョイスに悩みを打ち明けるが…?

name: 六花の追憶
summary:
目覚めると病院の一室だった。
そこに現れた二人のヒロイン。なんとどちらも自分の恋人だと言う。
「女性」に関する記憶を失った主人公とヒロインの過ごす一週間。
選択肢を選びながら、徐々に記憶を取り戻していこう。
真相を知っていく中で、あなたが選ぶ結末は……？

■プレイ時間：　一周30分・コンプ一時間程度
■END数：　5種（normal 2種・happy 2種・bad 1種）

name: 狼殿下と黒猫
summary:
国一番の騎士である王弟に嫁いたのは、怯えた様子の身代わりの花嫁で!?

公爵領で働く黒猫のシェインは、ある事が原因で声を失っていたが、使用人仲間と平和に暮らしていた。
だが猫獣人の国の末王子の身代わりの花嫁に仕立て上げられ、狼獣人の国の王弟・ランフォードに嫁入りすることに。
一方、鋭敏な嗅覚で感情まで嗅ぎ分けるランフォードには、シェインの怯えと悲しみが手に取るようにわかり、噂と違う様子に疑問を抱く。
ランフォードはシェインを保護し「君が家に帰れるように尽力する」と約束するが、偽りのない純粋なシェインに惹かれ…?

name: 世界で一番君が嫌い
summary:
鳳凰大学に通う主人公は、学内の一の天才、榊原透に一目惚れ。
毎日「好き」と伝えるも、返ってくるのは「ブス」、「迷惑」という冷たい言葉ばかり。
ただ拗らせ男と恋愛するだけのゲームです
約６分ほどで遊べる、短編恋愛ノベルゲームです

name: 氷帝は香らずのオメガを寵愛する
summary:
Ω嫌いなα皇帝×発情しないΩ花嫁。孤独な魂が求めあう純愛オメガバース!

公爵の息子ながらΩのルスランは、発情しない役立たずのΩと虐げられてきた。人質として「氷帝」と恐れられる隣国の皇帝アウグストのもとに嫁ぐことになるが、Ωには反応しないアウグストから「ヒートもないオメガを抱く気はない」と言い捨てられる。けれど、皇后候補として手厚い待遇をしてくれる王宮でルスランは心身の健康を取り戻し、次第に笑顔を見せるようになる。アウグストが好きに使えと開放した書庫でルスランが歴史に興味を示したことから次第に二人の距離が近づき、アウグストがΩに反応しない自分に落伍感を感じていることを知って、さらに共感を深めていくが…?

name: Who?
summary: Martino was a very important scientist, working on something called the K-88. But the K-88 exploded in his face, and he was dragged across the Soviet border. There he stayed for months. When they finally gave him back, the Soviets had given him a metal arm... and an expressionless metal skull. So how could Allied Security be sure he actually was Martino?

name: 勅命結婚 恋と縁
summary:
婚姻により幸せな居場所を見出す和風シンデレラ・ラブストーリー!

瘴気を吸収する「吸魔体質」を持つ蓮は、伯父一家から“穢れた存在”として虐げられ、吸魔の力を搾取され、使用人としてこき使われきた。ある日、とりわけ穢れのひどい現場へ連れていかれ、瘴気を吸収すると、かつてない痛みに瘴気を吐き出してしまい、幽鬼が再生する。そこに突然ひとりの男性が現れ、再生した幽鬼を瞬時に斬り裂く。男性は幽鬼に関する任務を扱う、帝直轄の特務機関――通称S機関の制服を着た、美貌の青年将校・阿望征士郎だった。蓮の霊力の高さに目をつけた征士郎は、後日縁組を申し込んでくる。莫大な結納金と、御三家と言われる阿望家と縁ができると喜んで蓮を差し出す伯父一家。契約のような形で嫁いだものの、阿望家では伯父の家とは違い、一人の人間として扱われることが奇跡のよう。一方、打算で蓮を娶った征士郎も、元の家で酷い扱いを受けていたことを知り、彼を大切にしたいと思うようになって…?

name: 契約番の騎士は天才オメガを離さない
summary:
訳アリの用心棒アルファ×研究ヲタクな王子による契約オメガバースBL!

騎士の任を解かれて用心棒として生計を立てていたローランは、町外れにある空き家の中でとあるオメガを発見する。誘拐されてきたと思しき彼は、発情誘発剤によって発情させられており、そのフェロモンに誘惑されるローランに、カインという青年は「自分の身体を好きにしていいから、助けろ」と取引を持ち掛ける。面倒事は御免だと思うも本能には抗えず、ローランはカインを誘拐した犯人たちから逃れると、欲望のままカインを抱き――番となってしまった。 そのまま王宮に連れていかれたローランは、そこでカインが王子であること、そして護衛の騎士に裏切られて何者かに連れ去られたことを知る! カインに「番を解消して帰っていい」と言われたローランだが、アルファとしての本能で番であるカインへの強い執着が生まれていて――?

name: 聖騎士様が転生モブに執着して物語が始まらない
summary:
過保護な勇者×ラスボス討伐に勇者を旅立たせたいモブ

ゲーム世界に転生したセルジュの役割は町の遺跡に勇者を案内するモブAだ。しかし物語開始前に、なぜか勇者ライナルドが行き倒れており、セルジュは使用が禁じられた遺跡の回復アイテムでライナルドを助ける。だが村の掟に反したせいで、セルジュは村から追放されてしまう。仕方なく当てのない旅に出るセルジュだったが、ライナルドまでも後をついてきてラスボス討伐の旅に出ない。物語から外れてしまうことに焦るセルジュだったが…?

name: The Falling Torch
summary: The spaceship dropped them into the night - two men pitted against the mighty empire that held Earth as a slave planet. One was the anonymous agent of the mysterious "munitions firm" supplying weapons to Earth's Underground. The other was Michael Wireman - son of the last President of Free Earth. Their mission was simple - and suicidal - to weld the underground guerrilla fighters into a force capable of beating the most powerful army in the Galaxy. Danger and death waited for them on Earth's nightside - but within him Michael Wireman held the weapon that could conquer Earth. The only trouble was he didn't know he had it.

name: BLゲームの悪役令息なのになぜか主人公である義兄に愛されています
summary:
BLゲーム主人公・義兄×悪役令息・義弟が贈る異世界ラブ！
BLゲームの悪役令息に転生したセレスティノ。断罪されないために、主人公である義兄との関係改善に努めたところ、なぜか攻略対象を一切寄せ付けず、セレスティノべったりな攻（受だったはずが）になってしまい…？

name: 放蕩な王の予期せぬ純愛
summary:
遊び人(を装う)王×真面目な文官

王宮の閑職につくユンは、学生時代から苦手意識を抱く新王ザイから突然、王専用の庭の管理を任せられる。なぜ自分がと訝るが、「顔が好みだった」というふざけた任命理由を聞き、放蕩に耽るザイへの嫌悪感が蘇る。だがザイは急死した前王である兄が暗殺されたのではと疑っており、ユンに密かに調査をして欲しいと頼むではないか。しかも清廉な兄王と同じように、王宮に蔓延る奸臣を排除しようと考えているという。ユンは思いがけないザイの本心を知り、惹かれていくが…?

name: 主を失った騎士が現代にタイムリープしてきました
summary:
タイムリープしてきた騎士×騎士を拾った研究助手

久永凛音は大学を卒業後、研究者の叔父の手伝いをしに故郷のオーストリアを訪れていた。しかし古城の調査中、凛音が小部屋で魔法陣のようなものを見つけると、突如稲光のような閃光と共に騎士の装備をした青年が現れる。危うく持っていた短剣で斬られそうになるが、怪我をした騎士の傷の手当てするために彼を説得して叔父と共にアレクサンダーと名乗る騎士の面倒を見ることに。彼の話によると、敵襲から逃れるために転移をした際に一緒にいた主と離ればなれになってしまったらしい。主を心配するアレクサンダーのために凛音も主探しに協力をするが――?

summary:
Play as Gregg. Gather, build and destroy your slimy enemies in this thrilling pixel art tower defence!

Gregg: Tower Defence is a captivating pixel art tower defense game that puts your strategic prowess to the test. Take on the role of Gregg, a resourceful little builder, and face a relentless onslaught of slimes in epic battles. Here are some of the key features:

Six Unique Towers: Craft and upgrade six different tower types, each with its own distinctive abilities and strategic advantages. Mix and match to create the ultimate defense.

Resource Gathering: Explore the world to collect 5 different resources, the building blocks of your tower defense strategy. Each resource is vital for crafting your towers.

Day and Night Cycle: Survive the day by harvesting essential materials, and then prepare for the night when waves of slimes attack your base. Adapt to the changing conditions to stay one step ahead.

Upgrade System: Improve your towers as you advance, with five tiers available for each tower, allowing them to adapt to the ever-growing threat posed by advancing enemy waves.

Gold and Gear: Earn gold by defeating slimes, and use it to bolster your arsenal. Upgrade your axe for resource gathering, improve your speed, and expand your base to accommodate more towers.

Descent of the Hunted is a psychological horror Visual Novel where the player controls the monster stalking a poor, tormented soul to whatever end awaits her. Your choices determine the nature of the beast and its physical make up. Her fate is in your hands. 

Inspired by transgressive horror like The Babadook and The Lighthouse and taking narrative cues from story-driven classics like Disco Elysium, Descent of the Hunted explores coping with trauma in our modern world of isolation and electronic pacifiers. summary:

Mills of Morris takes you on a puzzle adventure, where storytelling is just as relevant as progression. Explore the Meadow of Riddles and find out why Morris is so eager to become a human, throwing his frog life away.
Inspired By A Classic
Every puzzle you’re seeing relies on the core rules of the antique gem, Nine men’s morris. Originally, it is supposed to be a two-player board game, but Morris was tasked to create so-called “mills” of disks that share a color.
… the Wizard Won’t Stop There!

A Non-Linear Adventure

A Visual Experience
Frogs can’t read, right? But frogs can interpret visuals. The world focuses on guiding your journey without much text, letting the world speak for itself.
You, the Creator
Step into the shoes of the Wizard and create your own levels using the Level Creator tool! Every single asset is available at your disposal - it’s time to get creative!
Share With Your Friends!

summary:
Spectral Synergy is a procedural dungeon crawler, with distinct biomes, abilities and items. It features typical RPG mechanics such as stats, buffs and equipment. 3D turn based / active time battle system.

Spectral Synergy

General Info:

Spectral Synergy : Realms Entwined (SSRE) is formerly a Dungeon Crawler Jam 2023 contestant.

The entry may be played here:

This steam release is reflective of the time spent thus far improving the game, as opposed to the 7 day window in which it was initially made.  This steam release ships with an integrated development kit.

Features:

Procedurally generated dungeon levels, with a variety of biomes and monsters.

This is done in a 'traditional roguelike' manner, generating an ASCII map

An additional system translates these maps into 3d geometry and entities

Additional elements placed in a 'greebling' pass

Procedurally generated items, with character equipment system. 

Items range from hats to potions, great care has been taken to ensure that item generation rules are as loose as possible. Items can affect almost any stat, which may or may not be beneficial. Potions confer a permanent malus or bonus. 

On reaching the blacksmith, you may combine items for a fee. There are no restrictions with this system. You may for instance combine a sword with a potion and then drink the result to gain a permanent attack bonus. 

Hybrid 3D Active Time Battle Combat.

The combat system is largely deterministic, with the exception of critical results. 

Combatant statistics are very important and weigh heavily on the outcome of battles. 

The order of turns or actions is determined by a race, every lap of the race grants a turn. 

Status effects occur during the race and not per turn, some abilities can confer a bonus for the next turn. 

Modular ability / spell system, largely inspired by morrowind.

Revised Graphics and Audio

Brand new, professionally made soundtrack for each area, combat and special scenes.

Uncompressed audio

Revised

An RPG where something is off...

Make an original character in a surprisingly in depth pixel character creator, and then choose one of three worlds to set out. Your choices are your own, but the game has it's own devious plans for you.

TeleCollision has turn based combat, with each character having a unique timing based action to master for increased damage. There's an entire catalogue of trading cards to collect through exploration, purchasing, and opening trading card packs for a random chance at rare and powerful cards!

TeleCollision's demo includes roughly 8 hours of content, and what is considered the first act of the game. Community feedback is welcome and appreciated at this stage of development as the combat is tweaked and polished.

summary:
Master the grid in Squares Proximity! ? A single-player, turn-based strategy game of precise placements and clever captures. Outsmart the AI by placing numbered squares to boost your tiles and steal theirs. Simple rules, deep decisions. Are you ready for the challenge? ?

Squares Proximity is a deceptively simple, yet endlessly deep single-player strategy game. Every turn is a puzzle of risk and reward. Your goal is to dominate the grid by making smart, precise placements.

The rules are easy to learn: place your numbered squares to buff your own territory and capture your opponents. But as the board fills up, every decision becomes critical. Will you strengthen your position or launch an attack? It's all about outthinking the AI in a pure test of tactical skill. ?

Key Features

⚔️ Intense Tactical Duels: Face off 1v1 or escalate the chaos with up to four-player 1v1v1v1 matches on a single, clean grid.

? Cunning AI Opponents: Challenge 1, 2, or 3 capable AI rivals that think ahead, prioritize high-value captures, and won't give up without a fight.

? Simple Core Gameplay: Receive a shuffled sequence of numbered squares. Place them on any empty cell to influence the board. Every placement counts!

? Power Up Your Tiles: Place a square next to your own to give every adjacent friendly tile a +1 boost. Create powerful clusters to fortify your position!

? Smart & Strategic Captures: Place your square next to an opponent's. If your number is higher than an adjacent enemy tile, you capture it and make it yours!

? Every Point Matters: Your final score is the total sum of all numbers on the tiles you control. Small captures can lead to big victories!

? Clean, Bold Visuals: With a high-contrast, minimalist design, you can read the entire state of the game at a glance, no matter how complex the board gets.

? Endless Replayability: Thanks to shuffled tile orders and unpredictable AI, no two matches are ever the same. A fresh challenge awaits you every time you play.

summary:
Galaxy Trek is a fun, simple and addictive indie game that will test your reflexes, strategy and skill. Each game you play is unique!

Remember the days when games were simple to learn and really fun to play? Experience pure joy as you blow up your enemies in real-time with phasers and torpedoes. Watch those enemy ships blow to pieces and their bits fly across your screen. Check the view screen for the status of your Starbases, open up the Galaxy Map and see if enemies are nearby, spend some time jumping to different sectors and explore anomalies, or just jump to the unknown. Each time you jump to a new sector the game will auto save (provided there are no enemies in the sector) so you can re-play should something go wrong.

Galaxy Trek lets you choose between seven levels of difficulty but the game play does not change. The enemies will not be any stronger and your ship won’t be any weaker, so what you learn at lower levels you can continue to use at the higher levels. 

Galaxy Trek was designed to let you focus on the fun, without worrying about the details. As long as your hull remains intact, everything will function. Starbases are not necessary to obtain victory, but they are needed to repair your hull, so you might want to keep one around. 

Galaxy Trek is the game for anyone who is looking for that fun and uncomplicated gaming experience. It’s a real-time strategy game, perfectly combined with a bit of Sci-Fi and a lot of exciting action. Featuring fun graphics, high-quality music, great sound effects, and easy-to-learn controls, it is a game that will keep you hooked for hours with no two games ever being the same.

summary:
Experience the magic and weirdness of the world's first home video console, the Magnavox Odyssey, lovingly recreated for modern hardware.

The Magnavox Odyssey was the world’s first video game console. It was released in 1972 and by the time production stopped several years later it had sold over 350,000 units. In total 28 games were made for the Odyssey. The most famous game from the platform is "Table Tennis" which served as the direct inspiration for Atari's "Pong". 

Not only was it the first console but the Odyssey is also a unique piece of hardware. There is no CPU or memory to emulate. Instead the Odyssey is a collection of circuit boards, each controlling a key element of the system such as the ball, the wall and each player's dot. It is a very misunderstood system!

Now you can experience the wonder and strangeness of the Odyssey with Magnavody! 

Magnavody is an open source simulator of the Magnavox Odyssey with a focus on accuracy, historical authenticity and fun. Magnavody is a homage to the games on the system in a modern package designed to be played on modern hardware. Your Steam purchase supports future development.

Magnavody has the following features:

Emulates the system design of the Magnavox Odyssey (1972) - the unit controllers, cards, spot generators, gate matrix and flip-flops

Controller support designed to best simulate the strange and awkward dial controllers of the original

Authentic 4:3 mode (see the games as they were originally presented)

Optional enhanced widescreen (16:9) mode (see the games fill the screen as they were originally designed to do)

Optional CRT overlays (add static, waves and other retro effects)

Toggle on screen elements to choose your own level of immersion

Two player support

Support for digital overlays (some games originally came with plastic overlays)

Some quality of life improvements such as "quick load" and "reset controllers" to make it easier to use.

summary:
A game of strategy and management. The Sumerian Game is one of the earliest computer games. Developed and programmed between 1963 and 1965, it was designed to teach children math, economy and ancient history. The source code was lost but now you can play it again.

Between 1962 and 1965, some classes of students in New York were involved in an innovative research project. The goal was to create a new teaching method without teachers, using powerful computers, automatic systems such as slide projectors, and the playback of recorded audio lessons.

At the conclusion of the lesson, a 300-baud modem connected a powerful mainframe, costing tens of millions of dollars at the time, to a teletype under the students' control. The teletype printed long texts on continuous paper rolls, forcing the students to make difficult decisions on how to manage scarce resources to feed the population and plant crops for the next season.

It was the Sumerian Game, the ancestor of all strategy, management, and city simulation games.

The Sumerian Game, which was lost for 60 years, has been rebuilt and is now playable. Manage your grain, store it to withstand harsh seasons and natural disasters, grow your population, and expand your settlements. Find the best balance between people and food, or between arable land and cultivated fields.

You have ten years to expand your city and save it from extinction. If the population drops to zero, the lesson is over.

Call the teacher.

summary:
Force to spend a month in a psych ward to cure your addiction, you fight yourself going through painful levels of withdrawal. To cope, you make friends with a man who helps ease your pain, in exchange for unsettling favours.

A highly stressful psychological horror game about addiction.

GAMEPLAY:
SURVIVE:
When the "Entity" closes in, the game transitions into a high-stakes chase sequence, demanding quick thinking and nerves of steel. Get in one of the rooms, shut the door behind, hide under anything you can find and pray the "Entity" doesn't find you.

BE STEALTHY:
Silence is your ally. Move cautiously, avoiding puddles and other potential sources of noise. The entity is drawn to disturbances, so stealth is your best chance at remaining unseen. Hug the shadows and tread lightly.

PREPARE:
The key to survival lies in your ability to study your surroundings meticulously. Keep an eye out for traps and identify hiding places where you can seek refuge. Each room holds secrets, and careful observation will be your greatest ally.

MANAGE:
Matches serve as your lifeline in the suffocating darkness. Explore the ward to collect matches scattered across various locations. Manage your resources wisely, as matches are limited, and the flickering flame will burn faster if you run.

TASKS:
Each night, a mysterious man will give you a task to complete. Each task unravels a piece of the sinister history haunting the ward and brings you one step closer to your Bliss. Get what you're asked for and return them quickly before getting caught.
STORY
Force to spend a month in a psych ward to cure your addiction, you fight yourself going through painful levels of withdrawal. To cope, you make friends with a man who helps ease your pain, in exchange for unsettling favours. With every passing night, the boundaries between salvation and damnation get blurier.

summary:
DOS - the album, the game, by Steve Pardo. Minimalistic isometric music-driven platformer game.

Introducing DOS (pronounced “doss”), the album, which composer for games, audio designer, and saxophonist Steve Pardo has also developed into an isometric music-driven platformer game. 

DOS, the album, is instrumental and cinematic in nature, rooted in the jazz tradition, and consisting of influences spanning indie rock, electronic music, ambient, and classical musics. It is patient, evolving, melodic, and curious. It consists of seven songs written by game composer Steve Pardo during a season of his and his family’s move from Boston to Nashville, being a season of change and with a spirit of adventure and hope. 

DOS, the game, is a single-player, beat-based platformer, with a bit of puzzle solving, adventure game mechanics, and a subtle narrative. You play as a cube with eyes that blink, where every song on the album is presented as a level of the game. It is a story told as an adventure, simple enough for anyone to pick up and play, with just a touch of reactive challenges along the way, letting the music take center-stage.

DOS is the debut project to be released by the indie game development studio The Pardo Brothers, which was co-founded by Steve and Jonathan Pardo. Steve Pardo performs on woodwinds, guitars, keys, synths, and FX, as well as Mike Baggetta on electric guitar and FX, Jon Estes on guitars and bass, and Brian Fitch on drums. Special guests include Liz Estes on violin, and Amy Pardo on flute.

summary:
An early prototype, Slime Brawly Brawl exists to scratch an itch. An itch for a simple, fast paced platformer melee game like 90s kids might have played and loved growing up.

Current build is a solo infinite run game where you battle your way up the levels against increasingly powerful opponents. There is only one attack, there is only one map, and there is only one opponent (or is there...). It is what it is: a prototype for something that could be fun in a future build.

With enough player interest to continue development, the milestones are (roughly): 

 0.0.0: initial prototype, smash attack only, solo infinite run mode only (<- you are here)

 0.1.0: in-house Slime models, refactor prefabs/code, polish UI, add Steam achievements

 0.2.0: new actions: grapple and ranged

 0.3.0: local multiplayer vs

 0.4.0: local 2v2 co-op

 0.5.0: local 2v2 vs

 0.6.0 through 0.9.0: multiple Slimes, skins, maps, potentially skill point trees, community feedback based updates, patches, and creative direction

 1.0.0: online pvp and 2v2/3v3 vs (<- a legit engineering challenge I'd love to conquer)

This game sucks, I guarantee it! That said if you can squint and see what I see, any support, wishlists and sharing to friends/communities would help grind through that list of milestones. For the moment this is a solo-dev project, so to reiterate... it is what it is, fun for the sake of itself. Enjoy!

Welcome to Supa Fly Racing, a VR Racer that delivers shots of adrenaline and fun..

Pit your VR racing skills against rival flies as you scramble through various pipe systems that serve as your race track. Begin your racing journey as a Training Fly in the Training Cup and zoom through gentler, introductory tracks, qualifying for each new, more difficult and action packed cup to work your way up to Race Fly, where all hell breaks loose.

Use your head to steer, where you look is where you go. Your throttle is controlled by moving your hands further and closer from your body.

There 4 types of Supa Fly.

TRAINING FLY

Slow to turn and not the fastest. The perfect specs for new players to become comfortable with 3D VR racing.

POO FLY

More aggressively set-up than the Training Fly, agile and performant but still very manageable.

SPORTS FLY

Ready for some serious speed? This is the one.

RACE FLY

Super fast, super agile. This is a hardcore fly to race with.

* 16 Race Pipes including circuits and point to point.

* 4 Championship Cups with a linear progression system that requires at least 3rd place to qualify for the next round.

* Single Race Mode with Pipe Tracks and Supa Flies available once unlocked in Championship Mode.

* Practice Mode with all tracks unlocked and flies available once through progression in Championship Mode.

A little RPG about a kid and their unbending will to get to the top of an infinite mountain- no matter the cost.

Opening to testers!

Even though the game is still in a rough and uncompleted state, I am opening this up for requests to play the current buggy, unfinished, and broken version of the game. Enjoy, and please email our support with detailed descriptions of any issues you have along with your crash log and any suggestions you have.

- Krispi

About the Game
A young and strange preteen aged kid with an unknown name emerges at the gates surrounding a large mostly standalone mountain known as Mt. Olzien. This mountain is mainly known for one special factor it holds: it seemingly has no summit. It is infinitely tall. Despite this claim, this kid wants nothing but to get to the top of the mountain, at any cost.

In Unsummited, pack your hikers bag and strap on your adventuring boots, 'cause you're in for a truly unforgettable adventure! Along your climb up the mountain, you will discover an engaging and thought out battle system involving fun and nostalgic arcade action mini-games, funny characters with witty dialogue, lots and lots of jokes, and a very compelling overarching narrative.

The NPCs of Unsummited consist of your run-of-the-mill humans, as well as a “race” of special creatures called “mountain dwellers”. They come in all shapes in sizes: from talking Wooden Logs to Walking Fish and Vegetables. 
Unfortunately, though, this peace-loving people have been terrorized for years by the tyrannical King Greytol, hell-bent on total enslavement of them all, and erasure of any good they hold. It’s YOUR task to choose to help the struggling mountain dwellers in their time of need, or.. perhaps put them out of their misery before the king can get his chance to do them in for good...?

Good luck, adventurer! That is, if you choose to accept this mission...!

summary:
Circle Pong is a game. A top down 2D arcade game that adds a unique circular twist to a classic, multiple game modes, and fast paced game play with a high skill ceiling.It's like pong but in a circle.

Circle Pong: The Circular Twist on Classic Arcade

Circle Pong is a game. A top down 2D arcade game that adds a unique circular twist to a classic, multiple game modes, and fast paced game play with a high skill ceiling.
It's like pong but in a circle. 

Visuals and sounds

Circle Pong combines bright vibrant colors, abstract designs, and synthwave music to create a fun geometric/synth feel. 

Gameplay Overview

Circle Pong is for the hardcore and casual gamer, whether you are looking for a challenge with an impossible skill celling or just a quick arcade fix. The gameplay is intuitive yet challenging, with a few different game modes that everyone can play but not all can beat: 

Infinite: The essence of Circle Pong, where the player must keep the ball with in the area for as long as possible. The balls speed increases with each point gained, demanding quicker reflexes. This game mode contains a shield power-up that acts as a onetime safety net until its recharged. 
Finite: Unlike Infinite, Finite has a defined beginning and end, this mode tasks players to decrease a score from 100 to 0 points. But other than that, it is very similar. 
Block Bust: Bust all blocks in each stage to win by aiming the ball to collide with the blocks. There are four unique stages each with a different set of blocks where each stage has different block behaviors. 
Double: Double the balls, double the challenge, and double the points. This mode requires players to manage two balls simultaneously, increasing both the difficulty and the rewards.

Floor it. This is hover racing at ridiculous speed — tight, twitchy handling where the track streaks past and one clean line is all that separates a record lap from a spectacular pile-up. It's fast, it's demanding, and it'll wreck you a few times before it clicks.

But raw speed only gets you so far. Every ability is a combo. Boosts, drifts, and special maneuvers all come from punching in face-button sequences on the fly — and pulling them off mid-corner, without lifting off the throttle is the whole challenge. Nail the input and you rocket ahead. Fumble it and you're kissing a wall.

Handling is razor-sharp. These machines carve, drift, and cling to the track at speeds that should throw you off — master the controls and the inputs and you'll thread corners the pack can only dream about. Wall-rides, loop-the-loops, and tracks that curl in directions they shouldn't keep every lap on a knife's edge.

A good lap is nice. A stylish one scores more. Chain combos together cleanly to build your multiplier and climb the tier ranks — but flub a sequence or clip a wall and your streak's gone. The best runs are the ones where every input lands and you never lift off the throttle.

Six drivers, six very different rides — from pure speed demons to nimble handlers to machines whose combo abilities flip the racing line on its head. Everybody's got their own reason for showing up, whether they're an underdog with something to prove or a corporate hotshot who hates to lose.

Eight environments and dozens of tracks wind through nebulae, planet rings, and stations out at the cold edge of the system. Win races to unlock new tracks, new abilities, and whatever's hiding further down the tour.

The Ancestral Tree withers, generational trauma lurking in its shadow. You must piece together a tragedy and soothe a soul-scar which refuses to heal. The Fate of the family is in your hands.

A short walking simulator game, where you interact and get help from items and NPC's in the environment to interpret the story.

The NPC's interact with you as you walk close to objects, giving you clues of what they are seeking.

Pick up items, and place them to make a choice. Your choice matters!

This game was developed as a submission for the Lv. 99 Game Jam in 2023. It was developed in the span of 10 days, and worked on further for 3 days for an update including bugfixes and a dialogue system unlocked by completing the game.

summary:
TIMEWINDER is a 2D platformer with puzzle and precision elements. Run, jump, dash and travel in time to brave the obstacles and continue on your journey, but be careful not to break the timeline continuity!

In TIMEWINDER you can travel back in time to solve the puzzle and precision platforming challenges in a unique way. Use the simple and intuitive controls to progress through three diverse chapters, overcoming every obstacle in your path. Traveling back in time is not without consequences though, if you move the wrong item or interact with the previous version of yourself you will break the timeline continuity and need to start over!
The question is not how, but when

If something is impossible now, that doesn't mean it always has been: sometimes you don't need to jump higher or run faster but see the problem in a new perspective. Travel back in time and add a new dimension to your problem-solving skills. Whether there are doors opening and closing or platforms moving away and towards you, traveling back in time at the approppriate moments will always offer a way forward.

Be careful however. Time is powerful, and when meddled with, dangerous. Breaking the timeline continuity is just as dangerous as the spiky crystals found throughout the levels: you can go back in time but not change your own history. If you used a platform to jump higher and then move that platform away, or close a door you already entered (or will enter, it's all a matter of perspective) the timeline continuity will be broken and you will need to try again in a different way.
There's always another secret

Traveling back in time to before you completed this game is sadly not possible, but after completion of all of the levels there is still enough to do. Search for every hidden star or chase the fastest times to hone your skills even further and become a true timetraveller!

Transfigured is a 2D side-scroller psychological horror game.

After falling asleep on the subway on your way to work, you wake up in a desolate metro station. But be careful - you are not alone. Humanoid monstrosities are stalking you from the dark. Armed with nothing other than a dying flashlight, it's up to you to claw your way back to the safety of civilization by heading deeper and deeper into the nightmare.

And most importantly, take care to avoid the monsters lurking just outside your sight.
ESCAPE
Figure out what's happening - where is this nightmarish place? How did you even get here? Why are you confronted with this hellscape? Were these abominations once human, and what happened to them? Unravel the mysteries of the nightmare to increase your odds of making it out alive.
SURVIVE
You are unarmed. The creatures stalking you are relentless, constantly prowling hallways on the hunt for you. Your only hope of survival is to hide before being seen, or to run and use your wits if it's already too late. Your intimate knowledge of your immediate surroundings can be the difference between life and whatever awaits you if you get caught.

summary:
Take a trip to Cheddar Beach in this interactive visual novel! Join Hamston & The Homies as they search for a crackin’ house party on a Friday night, in a world inspired by LA in the early 90’s. Let’s Chase That Cheese, Ya’ll!

Cheddar Beach is an interactive visual novel inspired by old school point-&-click adventure games. In about 45 minutes of gameplay, you’ll meet Hamston & The Homies and traverse the world of Cheddar Beach in search of a crackin’ house party on a Friday night - inspired by Los Angeles in the early 90’s.

A Message From Bryson

Yo, I’ll never forget back in high school when the homie printed out over 100 flyers for a house party that was poppin’ off that weekend. No cell phones. No social media. Hell, no internet. That was a world where you’re NOT making it to that house party on Saturday night unless you have one of those flyers. Or maybe your friend is going, but you don’t have their phone number. How do you unstuck yourself and get to the action?

In Cheddar Beach you play as Hamston, a young adult hamster. I thought about him as being my ‘younger self.’ I think back to my college days of trying to adapt to adult life, and the freedoms afforded by it, while also avoiding any adult responsibilities that I could get away with. Actually, wait a minute... I’m STILL Hamston!!! 

Well, you can be Hamston too! Kinda. Play as Hamston to be the ‘new guy in town,’ and navigate your way through “The Chedda.” Fortunately you’ve got your big cousin Gerbert on deck, pushing you forward. Hopefully in the RIGHT direction! Don’t worry though, all you have to do is page the homie Bossa and he’ll swoop in to strongarm you to safety.

Let’s get it crackin’! Where’s the party at? Who’s got the 411? Let’s get there, and have a brew. Maybe you’ll meet a nice lady-friend. Who knows what’ll happen tonight?

Welcome to Cheddar Beach!

summary:

This game is just a simple space shooty game where you use the left and right arrow keys to control your ship, and the spacebar to fire. Ever-more deadly waves of alien ships attack you in a suspiciously slow and predictable pattern, enabling your single spaceship to somehow overcome incredible odds and defeat all of them, given enough skill.

Watch out for bonuses that drop from alien ships, especially those cheeky ones that fly across the top of the screen.

At the end of each battle, your level score becomes a cash bonus, but you are penalized for every alien ship that flies off screen intact. Think of this as you paying reparations to the relatives of those whose houses are blown up by those pesky aliens who got away.

After each level you get to upgrade your ship using your bonus cash. Invest in better shields, better lasers, faster thrusters to move your ship, or a better rate of fire.

For budgetary reasons, your planet only has a budget for a limited number of ships, and for reasons that are unclear, only one can be launched at a time. If you run out of ships, you fail. Sadface.

Stellar Reflections is a short story visual novel set in a dystopian future, within a sprawling space station. In this bleak era, personal freedoms have been suppressed, and life choices are dictated by the all-powerful regime. Delve into the narrative through the eyes of the protagonist, Aurelia, a nobody spending her days at her junkyard job, in a bar, or holed up in her cabin. In the distant future, Earth and Mars are used exclusively as mining facilities, and most of human population resides in space stations around the planets and the Moon. The world is governed by a centralized, autocratic government managing most of life choices for every existing human.
The government just made a decision directly affecting the life of the protagonist - Aurelia. And she's far from being a fan. How will she handle it?

There are 16 original tracks created specifically for this novel.

Endings
The novel features a couple of choices which lead to one of three possible endings: bad, neutral, or good.

The planet/moon levels contain spaceports and other buildings that can be landed on, and some of the buildings can be entered in the first-person gamemode.  In some of the buildings you will come across NPC's, some of them may be helpful or give you optional missions.  You can also find items and spaceships of varying configuration within the spaceports.  Evil alien spaceships will be lurking in the planet levels, and in some of the building levels you will encounter the evil aliens in person.

Travelling between planets and moons is done via temporary space levels.  In these space levels you will encounter waves of evil alien spaceships until you reach the destination.  The amount of evil aliens present in the space levels are tracked; the more you destroy them the less there will be next time.  The previous planet/moon levels can always be returned back to.  Travelling is limited; you can only travel to the neighbor planets and moons, for example from Earth you can travel to Venus, Moon, or Mars.  There is no "fast travel" available, but you will be able to discover utilities to speed up the process.

summary:
Build your own deck and battle other mages in a world of fantasy and magic. Take control of the hexes on the board to gain mana and pay for spells and creatures. Quick online matches with all 100+ cards unlocked from the start!

Manahex is a fantasy-themed card and board game for 2-4 players. It is played against other players online, either in short sessions (10-45 minutes, depending on player count) or asynchronously. At its core it's an old-school trading card game where each player brings their own personal deck to the match, but the resource acquisition and fighting takes place on a board instead of through cards only.
Gameplay
Before playing, a random map of hexes is generated. Each player chooses a deck and the starting position for their mage. Then starting hands are drawn and the game begins. 

Each turn you can move your mage to an adjacent hex and take control of it. The color of each hex signifies which type of mana it produces, and you can use the mana of controlled hexes to pay for cards in hand. All your hexes replenish at the beginning of each turn so you'll be able to afford more expensive cards as the game progresses.

Some of the cards are spells, which can directly affect things in the game (e.g. deal damage to another mage). Other cards are creatures or structures, which are created next to your mage on the map. Most creatures can move around and attack enemies, and a lot of them also have magical abilities. The structures are stationary, but usually have powerful ways to boost your other units.

Each mage starts the game with 12 HP, and if that number ever reaches 0 that mage is knocked out of the match. The last mage standing is the winner!
Kinds of Mana
The game contains four kinds of mana:

 Dusk – the mana of the moon. You get this mana from Cliffs.

 Light – the mana of the sun. You get this mana from Deserts.

 Rust – the mana of the machines. You get this mana from Dwellings.

 Moss – the mana of nature. You get this mana from Forests.

summary:
A turn-based strategy game, Checkers Twist is a variant of the checkers board game, where the board is irregular and procedurally generated, offering new tactics each game.

A variant of the classic game Checkers (also called Draughts), where the grid is irregular.

On a regular grid, each cell has 8 neighbors, but in this case, they can have between 6 and 10. Therefore tiles can have 3 diagonals or 5 diagonals, which offers different moves depending on where a piece is.

This leads to more difficult games, as you can't build the same mental tricks to take over your opponent. This also makes your opponent harder to anticipate.

Procedurally generated

Grids are procedurally generated on each game, and there are hundreds of them. This makes each game unique.

Pre-selected boards

If there are no room, you can create yours:

Read the swarm, blitz the openings, and stack explosive synergies into a loadout that carves the horde apart. Where most games in the genre fire for you, this one puts the aim in your hands and the fight in front of you.

The horde shows its hand before it strikes. Warning lanes streak across the field and full-screen alerts flare up before a wave breaks, so a wall of enemies is always a threat you can see coming. Read the signs, find your gap, and dash through before it closes. And every enemy reads differently: stalkers crowd in, harassers needle you from the edges, and bulls come barreling straight through. Half of staying alive is knowing what is about to happen.

Outlasting the swarm is only the start. Between the chaos you choose upgrades that rewrite how you play: new weapons, passives that bend the rules, synergies that turn a solid run into a runaway one. Feed lightning into your chain attacks, drop explosive gifts in your wake as you dash, mark enemies and drain them to keep yourself alive. The further you push, the more the loadout becomes unmistakably yours.

Push far enough and the screen starts to belong to you. Blades orbit and shred anything that drifts close, lightning forks between a dozen enemies at once, and damage piles up faster than the horde can replace itself. Runs that opened with careful reads end as a storm you simply walk through. See how deep you can cut before the dark pulls you under.

China, 1570. China is under the reign of the Longqing Emperor, of the Ming Dynasty. He inherited a country in disarray after years of mismanagement and corruption. He resided in the Forbidden city, which was the seat of many emperors under the Ming Dynasty. Constructed from 1406 to 1420, the complex consists of 980 buildings and covers 72 ha (over 180 acres). It is also under the Ming Dynasty that the Great Wall of China was rebuilt, fortified, and expanded. Around this period, China was under heavy attack from the Mongols, so maintaining the Great Wall was essential. Most of what we now have left of the Great Wall, we owe to the Ming dynasty.

The country was already famous for its very intricate bureaucracy, but this also led to a lot of corruption. Even though the penalties for corruption were very high, the highest Officials of the Forbidden City would pretend to uphold the ban on corruption, by accepting gifts of petitioners, and returning one of seemingly lower value.

Gugong uses this extraordinary custom as its basis. Players take on the role of powerful Chinese families trying to gain influence and power by exchanging gifts with Officials. The gift cards you offer as a player have to be of a higher value than the one you receive, forcing you to make strategic choices regarding which actions you want to take each turn.
