summary:
Explore another world in the community-built spiritual successor to One Hour One Life.

Another Hour Another Planet is a multiplayer survival game of parenting and civilization building. Get born to another player as your mother. Live an entire life in one hour. Have babies of your own in the form of other players. Leave a legacy for the next generation as you help to rebuild another planet from scratch.

Each Another Planet server starts out with a practically infinite expanse of untouched alien wilderness. The first player to join the server is Eve. Other players who join the server are born as Eve's children and grandchildren, forming a multi-generational family tree. Each minute that passes in the game is a year of your life as you grow up, have children, age, and eventually die, leaving the world for your offspring to carry on. You can rejoin the game for another life, getting born as a baby to some other mother somewhere in the world. In each life, you play one small part in a huge story that started long before you were born and will continue on long after you die.

Each Another Planet server can support over one hundred simultaneous players who are building and shaping a persistent, trans-generational world. The shape a given world today can be quite different from how it will look tomorrow, next week, or next month, as players continue their collective project.

As we design and build another planet together, who knows where we'll end up?

summary:
Push your limits in Multicrash! by selecting when to dodge and when to crash while picking up coins along the way. Survive as long as possible in this simple, but challenging, retro-arcade game. See how you compare with others on the global leaderboard.

What is Multicrash!
Multicrash! is a simple retro-arcade-survival game where the goal is to get as many points as possible. Manage up to four roads, swapping the ship between two lanes on each road to avoid obstacles, pick up coins for points, or spawn another road. Each round starts off easy, but the speed of the game accelerates over time until surviving on just one road becomes almost unmanageable. However, there are ways to keep the round alive even after reaching max speed. Both spawning new roads and crashing will reset the game speed (yes, crashing can be good!) but remember, more roads = more points: Obviously having more roads means more coins spawn, but each coin is also worth the number of roads alive. This means that with four roads up, (4x coins spawn) x (4x coin value) = (16x efficiency!). The round ends when the last remaining road crashes. 

Play this game as a brain warmup when you first get on or play it while in queue for another game. See how you compare by competing with others on the global leaderboard.

summary:
An original game, combining the strategy of Reversi with all of the excitement of a fun, fast-paced, tile-flipping, arcade action game. Jump player around the boards of 9x9 tiles, destroying chasers caught on flipping tiles. 15 boards per level, 3 levels of difficulty.

How to play the game
The game has three levels: Easy, Ok and Ouch. The names indicate the relative degree of difficulty of each level. To finish a level you must complete each of the 15 boards within the level. After completing the Easy level, you move to Ok and then Ouch. You may start at any level, but a useful tactic is to start at a less challenging level and build up a store of extra lives to sustain you at higher levels.

Gameplay takes place on a series of boards each consisting of nine rows and nine columns of tiles. Each tile may be one of two colours. For example, these tiles are used on the initial Robotica board.

The player is represented by a smiley-faced character on the board.

The player moves the character from tile to tile by using a gamepad joystick, or the arrow keys (left,right,up,down or W,A,S,D).

When the player lands on a tile, if the tile is already the player's colour, nothing happens and no points are awarded. If the tile was not the player's colour then it will be instantly changed to the player's colour and points will be awarded.

If the tile is changed and, in conjunction with another tile of the player's colour, encloses one or more tiles of the other colour, then those other tiles will flip to the player's colour. Each tile flipped is awarded an increasing number of points, so flipping longer lines is more rewarding than flipping shorter ones. This is the main game mechanic.

Collaboration

name: Rainbow Islands Towering Adventure! Original Sound Tracks
어서오세요! 셰어하우스에!
summary:
20XX年，你一如既往地过着无业游民的生活。高考失利，大学入学考试落榜之后，你依旧窝在房间角落里，成天只顾着看动画。
就在你对着屏幕跟"女朋友们"聊得起劲的时候，冷不防被父母从背后一巴掌拍醒，被强行拉去了首尔，搬进了一间与陌生人合住的合租屋（Share House）。
"跟那些认真生活的人待在一起，好好学学吧"——听着父母这句话，你就这样成了合租屋的一员。可谁知道，一到地儿才发现，家里竟然住着三个漂亮女生……？

活泼又勇敢的「柳智慧」
成熟稳重却暗藏反差萌的「朴润荷」
可爱又高冷傲娇的「洪世恩」

你将在共享屋中开始与三个漂亮女孩共居的故事。




游戏特色
[我们的故事]

在《欢迎来到合租屋！》中，我们以幽默诙谐的方式，讲述了现代社会中20多岁年轻人常见的烦恼与困境。与这三位室友同住的日子里，大家一起摸索着未来的方向。

[高品质插画]

我们把能够展现角色魅力的每一个细节都精心描绘，力求不放过任何一处亮点。快来享受与这些可爱角色同居的感觉吧！

[让游戏更简单更有趣！直观的用户界面]

为了让玩家能够毫无障碍、轻松愉快地进行游戏，我们尽可能打造出直观易懂的界面，让各位只需专注于与室友之间那份心动不已的恋爱故事就好。

name: 妹が俺のこと好きすぎる
summary:
可爱い妹を甘やかして育てた結果、すっかりお兄ちゃん大好きっ娘になってしまった妹・小野 菜月（なつき）。
自宅での彼女は常に兄のそばを離れず、ソファでは膝の上が定位置。
今でも一緒にお風呂に入り、両親が部屋を分けても結局は兄の部屋のベッドに潜り込む始末。
そんな二人の距離感に、両親も今ではすっかり諦めモードで見守っていた。
――しかし、そんな果てしなく甘い日常に、突如として変化が訪れる。
きっかけは、菜月が学校の授業で受けた「性教育」だった。

summary:
1980年6月28日公開の日本映画。角川春樹事務所とTBSが共同製作、東宝が配給した。主演は草刈正雄、監督は深作欣二。上映時間は156分。

アメリカ大陸縦断ロケや南極ロケを敢行し、総製作費は20億、22億、24億とも25億円とも32億円ともいわれたSF大作映画である。本来は1980年の正月映画として封切り予定だったが、製作の遅れから公開に間に合わなくなり、『戦国自衛隊』が正月作品として取って代わり、本作は半年遅れで公開された[27]。DVDの特典映像には正月封切に合わせた「1981年人類滅亡版」の予告編が収録されている。

物語の後半、原作小説では南極に核は落ちなかったが、映画版では南極の基地が核で破壊されてしまうという大きな違いがある。

The unique style of tactics is an effective balance of decision making and simplicity. For those who love a power running game, we got you covered too! Running the game has been made just as fun as the passing game. summary:
A wave-based arcade shooter where between waves you visit a shop with prices that increase with each purchase/rental. Keep your combo high and grab as many coins as you can, and you can delay the inevitable. Powered by GZDoom.

-= DEATH IS INEVITABLE =-

Each wave will feature larger quantities of enemies, where you must keep a high combo and grab as many coins as you can in order to maximize your profits each round. Memorization of the level's waves and learning each weapon are also key to delaying the inevitable. Reaching the "final" wave will just start it back from the beginning, but even more hectic than before. You cannot escape your demise.
-= DEBT IS INEVITABLE =-

The shop contains everything you need to help you survive, at prices you cannot afford. Here, you can find health, weapons, armor, consumables, powerups, and passive upgrades. Each purchase from the shop increases that item's future prices, so if you're not careful, you may soon find yourself with empty pockets, and a mountain full of debt.
 -= THE FUN NEVER STOPS =- 
Your deaths and failures in DI will not be in vain, as each run will help you unlock new levels, characters, items, and mechanics that will be available in future runs. Each unlock that you acquire can change the way you play the game dramatically. There's no shortage of things to discover in DI.

summary:
Beacon of the Bellrock is a small open-world farming/building game, where you as James Hocken have to build and equip a lighthouse for the Intergalactic Royal Navy. Be the guiding light in the vast intergalactic ocean!

Embark on a serene and immersive survival adventure in "Beacon of the Bellrock." As a dedicated member of the Intergalactic Navy, your mission is to establish a beacon of hope in the uncharted wilderness. Your goal: Build and maintain a lighthouse that will guide spacefarers safely through the cosmic void.
Key Features:

? Intergalactic Royal Navy Orders:
Answer the call of duty as a member of the Intergalactic Navy. Your mission is to construct a beacon on the Bellrock planet, ensuring the safety of passing spacecraft.

? Build and Customize:
Start with a basic outpost and evolve it into a fully functional lighthouse. Design and customize your shelter, ensuring it withstands the diverse weather conditions of Bellrock.

? Wildlife Haven:
Immerse yourself in the tranquility of Bellrock's wilderness. Encounter and appreciate a variety of wild birds such as partridges, grouses, and eiderducks, along with charming animals like hares, raccoons, and stoats.

⚒️ Resource Gathering:
Explore the rich, procedurally generated environment to gather resources for your construction. Harvest materials, hunt for food, and uncover hidden treasures to enhance your lighthouse.

? Peaceful Survival:
Experience a survival game with a peaceful twist. While challenges exist, the focus is on creating a harmonious coexistence with the vibrant wildlife and stunning landscapes.

"Beacon of the Bellrock" offers a unique survival experience, blending peaceful exploration with the responsibility of guiding others through the cosmos. Join us on Bellrock and become the beacon that lights the way in the vast intergalactic ocean.

summary:
Multi-gun bullet heaven arena arcade survivor madness. Wield 14 guns at once and destroy hordes of enemies. Die, upgrade, return, destroy, repeat.

Eye uv Eve is (maybe) the world's first First Person bullet heaven shooter, and almost definitely the first game featuring quattordectal gun wielding. Descend into the arena and survive for 30 minutes against massive waves of enemies. Make it long enough and you can collect up to 14 stacking weapons. Fill the screen with bullets and magic to defend yourself. Level up and improve yourself and your weapons. Fulfill achievement to unlock new characters, weapons, and more.

The Eye is always watching. What it wants is a mystery...

Eye uv Eve harkens back to the arena shooters of old, filtered through modern survivor/bullet-heaven games, with the twist of being able to wield 14 guns at once. Each gun has a unique mechanic and can be leveled up over the course of a 30 minute run and evolved to fire more bullets, faster, and weirder. You'll face off against an endless horde of Angels and Demons as you fly and sprint around the arena looking for the next gun. Collect the hearts of your enemies to unlock permanent upgrades and items to equip to come back faster and stronger in the next run.

Road To Place Is a dice rolling roguelike. That you move based on the number you roll with the dice. Dice rolling can also determine outcomes bad or good, whether you defeat the raiders or get hurt in the process. There are 4 resources bullets, medicine, food, and money. summary:
Want to learn the Korean alphabet on the Meta Quest? Hop into Kore VR where you get to learn the alphabet in an interactive orb and shoot away letters in an interactive arena to win ingredients for delicious Korean dishes. Get those letters right or you will get roasted in Korean!

Available with Meta Quest 

Kore VR offers a unique experience that transports you to the heart of a traditional Korean Hanok village. From there, you can explore a futuristic and interactive orb that teaches you the sounds of each Korean alphabet, as well as a shooting arena where you'll use a laser blaster to shoot letters and gather ingredients for delicious Korean dishes in just three minutes. But beware - if you don't get the letters right, you'll be "roasted" in Korean!

With Kore VR, you can immerse yourself in the Korean language and culture in a fun and engaging way. The serene landscape of the Hanok village creates the perfect backdrop for learning the characters and pronunciation of Hangeul. And as you explore the village and its surroundings, you'll gain a deeper understanding and appreciation for Korean culture.

Whether you're a beginner or an experienced learner, Kore VR is an innovative and effective way to build a strong foundation in the Korean language. Through its combination of language learning and cultural immersion, Kore VR can enhance your overall language skills and provide you with a truly unforgettable experience.

summary:
The Land Past Redemption is a medieval, turn-based combat rogue-lite. Take on bounties, recruit more heroes, get better loot, and earn enough gold to pay your way out of the Land Past Redemption.

The Land Past Redemption is a medieval rogue-lite with turn-based combat. Take on bounties, explore procedurally generated dungeons, outfit and level up heroes, and earn enough money to escape the Land Past Redemption.
Key Features

Rogue-lite
Heroes can permanently die but even if a battle is lost, three new heroes are generated and the game mostly continues where it left off.

Customize heroes
Armor and weapons can be equipped to suit play style and hero class. At certain levels, a new skill can be selected and there are two skills to choose between. Even if there are two heroes with the same class, they can be built to have different skills.

Procedurally generated loot
Buy gear at the store to make heroes stronger, or use loot from enemy drops. The store's items refresh every time the heroes rest so there's always something new and better to find.

Positioning plays an important role in battle
Heroes in the back row will be safer, but will be unable to melee attack without the added reach of a spear. A hero in the front row with heavy armor and a shield can tank enemy attacks.

No two dungeons are alike
The layout of the dungeon and the events are all procedurally generated.

summary:
This is a very compact game, but an intuitive game that can be played without having to think too hard. Perfect for when you just want to unwind and have fun. You'll find yourself coming back to play it from time to time. Please give it a try.

Basically, avoid lasers by moving and use jumps and special moves only when they are really dangerous.

The camera is intentionally fixed in its movement.

Special moves have an invincibility time of 0.5 seconds.

Get lost in the rhythm and feel the beat as you become fully immersed in the action. Don't be fooled by its compact design - this game is sure to leave you wanting more!

To begin, the player must choose one of the two dancers available. The objective of the game is to avoid the lattice lasers. The dance ends when you touch the laser three times. The controls are straightforward and consist of three actions: "Move," "Jump," and "Special".

The dancers dance on their own, so the player only needs to focus on using the controls to dodge the lasers. The "Special" move makes it easier to avoid the lasers by lowering the dancer's posture and providing a brief period of invincibility. However, after this period, the dancer becomes vulnerable again, and if hit during this time, it counts as two hits, making it a high-risk move.

At the end of each playthrough, the player is awarded a score and one of eleven levels of titles based on their performance. Taking risks, such as staying in the lattice or upstage, increases the score, but it's important to enjoy dodging the lasers rather than maximizing points.

The game tests spatial awareness and concentration, so why not try improving these skills? Even if you don't understand the language, you only need to know "play" and "restart" to get started.

summary:
Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms.

Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms. The game is based on the popular internet creepypasta about a mysterious place that exists between the walls and floors of buildings, a place where people can become trapped and lost for days, weeks, or even years.

In the game, you play as a person who has become trapped in the Backrooms, and your goal is to find a way out before the endless maze drives you insane. The Backrooms are a surreal and unsettling place, filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and mysterious creatures that seem to be watching you from the shadows.

As you explore the Backrooms, you'll need to find keys, solve puzzles, and avoid dangerous traps and obstacles. You'll also encounter other lost souls who are trying to escape, but not all of them can be trusted. The deeper you go, the more unsettling the Backrooms become, and the harder it is to tell what's real and what's just a figment of your imagination.

Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is designed to be a tense and atmospheric horror experience, with a focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival. It's a game that will keep you on edge from start to finish, as you try to find your way out of this terrifying and otherworldly place.
UNIQUE LEVELS

summary:
Outmaneuver your opponents with calculated moves and deceptive tactics.

Inspired by the board game "Coup" and incorporating elements of poker card games and Mahjong, "The Nine's Showdown" is a unique blend of strategy and bluffing. With "Classic Mode", as well as the added excitement of "Fraud Mode" and "Madness Mode", this game promises an unforgettable gaming experience.
Basic Game Rules (Classic Mode)
At the beginning of each round, players draw 4 cards and receive 5 hearts and 2 coins. The first player then begins their turn, and each player in turn draws a card and chooses one of the common actions listed below.

Common Actions:

Gain 2 coins

Gain 3 coins (Might be Intercepted)

Strike: Spend 5 coins and let a player lose 1 heart

HOOLA

Use a card ability (Claim having the card)

Card Abilities:

Draw 1 card, gain 1 coin, regain 1 heart.

Snatch: Take away 2 coins from a target player.

Attack: Spend 3 coins and make a player lose 1 heart.

Reverse: Flip the turn direction.

Pick: Let the target player be the next to play.

Roll 6: Roll a 6-sided die. If the point is 6, gain 6 coins.

Roll 8: Roll a 8-sided die. Gain as many coins as the result.

Let all players' coin return to 0 and draw 1 card.

Players have to discard cards to keep exactly 4 cards in hand.
Players have up to 7 hearts and 9 coins.
Whenever players are challenged, their hand is checked. If they don't have the card, they lose 1 heart.
Players are out when they lose all of their heart.

summary:
A high fantasy social deduction game of magic and intrigue for up to 16 players.

Enter the mysterious world of wizardry as members of a secret magic academy. 
But beware! Some among you have hidden motives and are lurking in the shadows. 

Witch hunt academy is a social deduction game for up to 16 players.
Gameplay is broken up into several days divided further into periods, players must manage their time effectively to gather resources to defend themselves and defeat their opponents.

Players will be assigned one of many basic roles with different effects, visible to other players, as well as a secret role which falls into one of three categories:

Good
Good players win if all evil players have been rooted out, and there are no remaining neutral players with an achievable win condition.
A number of good aligned players will receive a Hero role with varying extra abilities related to defense or information gathering.

Evil
Evil players win if all good players have been eliminated, and there are no remaining neutral players with an achievable win condition.
All evil players will receive a Villain role with insidious abilities.

Neutral
Neutral players will each have their own win conditions depending on their role.
All neutral players will receive a Neutral role with unique abilities suited to their respective goals.

Features:

 Gameplay customization: Many aspects of the game can be customized in lobby settings and saved to various presets.

 In game proximity voice chat and text chat.

 Simple lobby creation and joining.

兔街子：毕业于中国传媒大学，少女漫画作者。画风清新唯美，深受读者喜爱。代表作有《SOS！恋爱出了幺蛾子》《DOLO命运胶囊》。

"I remember being disappointed. I remember looking up at the night sky and feeling this great sadness. Honestly, I thought there’d be stars..."

DFHack is an add-on for Dwarf Fortress (search for it here on Steam!) that enables mods and tools to significantly extend the game. The default DFHack distribution contains a wide variety of these tools, including bugfixes, interface improvements, automation agents, design blueprints, modding building blocks, and more. Third-party tools (e.g. mods downloaded from Dwarf Fortress Steam Workshop or the forums) can also seamlessly integrate with the DFHack framework and extend the game far beyond what can be done by just modding the raws.

DFHack’s mission is to provide tools and interfaces for players and modders to:

 expand the bounds of what is possible in Dwarf Fortress

 reduce the impact of game bugs

 give the player more agency and control over the game

 provide alternatives to toilsome or frustrating aspects of gameplay

 make the game more fun

Our online Quickstart Guide (see the "View the website" link in the sidebar) will help you get up to speed with how to use DFHack. It's also available in-game via the quickstart-guide command.

The best way to make feature requests or report problems is to open an Issue on our GitHub issue tracker (see the "Stats" link in the sidebar).

When reporting problems, links to your zipped, uploaded savegame and mods are immensely helpful, and issues with attached savegames and mods get fixed faster. We need a zip of your mods because we can't load your savegame without them.

DFHack installs directly into your Dwarf Fortress directory, so be sure to install it to the same Steam library and drive as Dwarf Fortress. If you are on Linux, both games must also have the same "Compatibility" setting (e.g. "Steam Linux Runtime 1.0 (scout)").

Clueless Crosswords is a fresh take on the traditional crossword puzzle. In the absence of clues you can complete the puzzles using any words you like (as long as they fit in the puzzle grid). However, you can only use each word once on any given puzzle, even on subsequent replays, making each replay more difficult to complete than the last.

Gameplay

In Clueless Crosswords you attempt to complete crossword puzzles without the aid of clues. You can use any words you like to complete the puzzle, but the more words you add the harder it becomes to think of new words that will fit around the letters that are already in play.

Once a word has been used it cannot be used again on that puzzle, even on subsequent replays, which makes each replay harder to complete than the last.

The Philotes Trials is a competition that exists to bring harmony to the world. Every year, different species are randomly selected and grouped together to participate in these trials. Even if they dislike each other, they have to form a bond and build teamwork in order to pass. Will friendships be made? Or will there be something even more blossoming?

Rui (renameable MC) is a human who finds himself in this competition. There, he meets four species from different realms who he has to team up with. As the team leader, he has the responsibility to bring the team together and get to know more about them. At first, he couldn't care less about his teammates, but his mindset for them might change as the days passes.

There are several trials to participate in. Each and every one helps build teamwork. 
Pass those trials to get tokens.

With those tokens, unlock one-on-one events with the members of the team. Seeing those events will help build individual bonds with them.

Max out a teammate's affection, and something good might happen.

Teammate 1. Altair comes across as an arrogant vampire. He'll constantly address himself as mighty or great. But behind his arrogance and pride, he's hiding an insecurity. 

Teammate 2. Fern is an egocentric elf. Every now and then, he'll always boast about how he's a scholar and put others down for being as unintelligent as him. He thinks making friends is a waste of time, but maybe his behavior reflects his hidden loneliness.

Teammate 3. Lyka is an energetic and loud werewolf. Being the youngest in his large family, he's always treated like a kid. He wishes to become less immature and prove himself to be more reliable.

Teammate 4. Triton is an unhappy merman.

She is battling alone against hordes of zombies, mutants, and killer robots with only her ever-evolving mental powers to protect her. Play as a medieval witch collecting hidden items (CD albums) in a variety of environments. 16 of the albums to be collected are then added to your jukebox, which can then be played whilst you explore further.

Travel through several different environments including ancient temples, a medieval village, spooky woodlands, vampire’s castles, and a storm-lashed coastal outcrop to collect the various CDs and Vinyl releases of the band Inkubus Sukkubus. Inkubus Sukkubus are a Pagan Gothic Rock Band Who have been touring and releasing albums since they formed in 1989. They have played in Australia, Russia, Mexico, USA, Scandinavia, Most of Europe and the UK, They have to date released 27 albums, and the band are currently playing live and working on new material.

Inkubus Sukkubus formed in the summer of 1989 when Tony McKormack, Candia Ridley and Adam Henderson met at college studying graphic design. They shared an interest in paganism, witchcraft and vampirism as well as making original music from an early age, and so the type of band that was to emerge from the joining of forces was, quite naturally, an expression of this. Initially the band was called Incubus Succubus. The original aim of the band was (as it still is today) to be the vehicle in which the celebration of the Pagan experience could be conveyed.

summary:
A sci-fi fixed arena shooter, where you can't shoot. Collect the Star Diamonds whilst avoiding the hazards using your thrusters to rotate your ship and then thrusting forward. You can't kill the enemy, so your only weapons are movement, speed and getting you opponents to wipe each other out.

Jurl is a simple arena style shooter where you don't get to do any actual shooting. The idea is simple, collect all the diamonds without exploding. Movement works by rotating left and right and then applying thrust, that's it.

As you progress you'll meet the six different styles of enemies:
Level 1

No enemies, just get used to the controls (left and right to spin, action button to fire thrusters).

Level 2

Asteroids, these won't kill you but they will deplete your score - sometimes they blow up. Just get used to avoiding enemies without any pressure.

Level 3

Wanderers, these will just mill around the screen, they aren't especially dangerous but you will blow up if you hit them.

Level 4

Miners wander around the screen and drop mines. These are both hard to see and deadly.

The Miner dropping a mine 

A disabled mine, safe to hit 

An enabled mine, careful, hot 

Level 5

Hunters will come straight for you, fortunately they have to live in the same physics model as you do so they can't turn around quickly.

Level 6

Shooters will try to get into firing distance quickly and then shoot at you. The bullets they use don't have massive range but they do bounce off of things.

Level 7

Laserers have, um, lasers. Like the Shooters they'll try to get into firing range quickly. The Laser is absolutely deadly and never misses, but it does have a short range and takes a while to recharge.

After Level 7 there will be a mixed bag of rest of the enemies - up to 11, after that it's a more random assortment.
Time

Every level (up to 11) keeps track of your time and compares it to previous runs
Options

Skip training levels

This option will start on level 3, after the basic training leve

summary:
Fitting-In is a single player puzzle game where you perform movement combos to jump over, through, and inside obstacles! There are walls, pause blocks, break blocks, and move blocks that all require creativity to overcome!

As you work through a level, your past moves are stored in a move history. When you move in the pattern “direction, direction, opposite direction, direction” (for example up, up, down, up) you perform a happy jump which flings you three places instead of one. Things start to heat up when different blocks get introduced that serve as both obstacles and advantages. Walls are the simplest block. You can’t walk through them and have to happy jump over them. Pause blocks are tricky buggers. You can walk inside of them, but the move you make into them is not counted in your move history. The move you make out of the block is counted! Break blocks are the opposite. You can’t walk inside a break block, but running into it will add to the move history even though your player stays in exactly the same spot. Move blocks can be pushed around to clear a path or used in tandem with break blocks to make some crazy moves possible.

There are currently 39 levels! I hope you have as much fun playing them as I have had making them.

summary:
Challenge your Friends in this Free turn-based, chess-like strategy game with Healers, Rogues, Archers, and more! Create your own Hexagon Grids for near endless variation.

This is a 2 player turn-based strategy game. Think chess meets turn-based RPGs.

Each player's team is made up of one character from each of these positions:

-Forward (Tank) - Usually has high health and damage while also being the slowest character.

-Flex (DPS) - Is flexible with how each character plays but is usually the fastest character.

-Support (Healer) - Has support abilities that enable other characters.

Characters take turns depending on their speed and generate Action Points at the start of each of their turns.

Action Points (AP) are used for either Actions (Attacks / Healing) or Moving (1 AP per tile).

Any unspent Action Points are carried over to the character's next turn up to a maximum of 6 AP.

Hex Grids consist of up to a maximum of 25 tiles of Five different types:

-Spawn: Spawn point for a Character (turns into a grass tile during game).

-Grass: Basic tile with no direct effects.

-Mud: Costs an additional AP to traverse.

-Molten: Take 10 Damage at the end of Character's turn.

-Corrupt: Doubles all Damage Character receives.

You can create your own custom Hex Grids with the in-game editor.

Victory Condition:

First player to kill 2 characters of the Opponent's team.

The top-down roguelike shooter where your ammunition is edible.

This game is a roguelike dungeon crawler, meaning each time you die, you're sent back to the beginning of the game, and each time you're sent back to the beginning, the game changes. >> Rally The Troops
Not only are there multiple guns to choose from, but multiple playable characters as well. Toggle Color Symbols and Connection Numbers on or off at any time.

 Undo, Redo and Reset with convenient shortcuts on both keyboard and gamepad.

Swordmin'z Dream is a mini-maximalist two-to-four player fighting game focused around quick matches and a volatile neutral space. Built with an emphasis on fast, high-risk play, matches can be won or lost with a single well-placed hit, but you can turn the tide quickly with strong parry mechanics.

A whole cast of strange little characters awaits, each with their own quirks and strategies.
Alongside fundamental characters like SWORDMIN and BLADEMIN you'll meet characters like VERY STRONGSMIN, who has a one-hit-kill attack, SHOOTSMIN, who just Has A Gun, or Júlian St. Clair who cannot attack at all. 

In your travels you'll span the breadth of MINTOPIA and see all the sights it has to offer.

Nearly every move in the game can be countered with a well-timed parry.
Punches, kicks, sword slashes, bullets, balls of concentrated ki, even explosions can be swiftly deflected if your timing is right.
If you have the meter for it, you can even parry out of hit stun, for high-stakes reversals.

Great for parties! Four players can play two simultaneous matches with the winners facing off seamlessly.

Both two-player and four-player tag-team modes are available for some chaotic fun! 
Lots of interesting character combinations to play around with.

Team Battle is also available!! Put your matchup knowledge to the test in 3v3 duels.

Movelists are small yet impactful, matches are quick, and characters have clearly defined win conditions.
Swordmin'z Dream's Mini-Maximalist ethos means each design element is a small idea taken to a logical extreme.

Take control of The Antbassador, a giant human finger with a tophat, as he makes his way through a bustling ant colony. His massive bulk makes him strong but unwieldy, and if you're not careful you're liable to squish your tiny hosts! You must use your prodigious digit to help the citizens of Antopia without causing an international incident!
CONTROLS: 
Move the mouse to push yourself here and there. 

Click the mouse to curl your finger.
FEATURES:

5 minutes of fumblecore finger fun!

Dozens of NPCs to avoid squishing!

Reused assets from Octodad: Dadliest Catch!

One climactic duel for the kingdom!

WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?

Antbassador is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free!

Back in 2014 while freshly finished with Dadliest Catch, a portion of the Young Horses team decided to participate in the Ludum Dare game jam #30. The theme for the jam was 'Connected Worlds', which we interpreted fairly loosely. Over the course of 72 hours, we conceived and developed Antbassador using the Horsepower engine. To our delight, Antbassador took first place in the jam, scoring highly in innovation, humor, and fun!

So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!

name: Wound Man
summary:
Wound Man is a macabre jigsaw puzzle adventure where you reconstruct a tortured figure from centuries-old anatomical art. Uncover hidden secrets and collect strange curiosities with every piece.

Wound Man is a macabre jigsaw puzzle adventure where anatomy, history, and obsession intertwine.

Piece together haunting, centuries-old medical illustrations and uncover the story of a being stitched together from humanity’s darkest curiosities.

A Body of Secrets

Each puzzle is more than an image - it is a fragment of something greater. 
Search carefully. Hidden within every puzzle are secrets waiting to be uncovered: elaborate collections, alternate paths, strange mini-games, and fragments of a story that refuses to stay buried.

Curiosity is rewarded. Completion is not guaranteed.

Restore What Was Lost

Wound Man is not whole.

His body has been scattered, his past obscured, and the one he loved has faded from existence.
By uncovering hidden truths and assembling what was torn apart, you may yet restore what time has erased.

But some things are not meant to return unchanged.

A Cabinet of Curiosity

Beyond the puzzles lies a deeper obsession.

Uncover over 170 strange and unsettling artifacts, each hidden within the fabric of the game’s anatomical worlds. From peculiar creatures to forgotten instruments, every discovery expands your Cabinet of Curiosity, a growing archive of the bizarre and the macabre.

Some are easy to find.
Others demand patience, precision… or something more.

Completion is not required.
But for those who seek to understand everything, the Cabinet holds many truths.

Handcrafted anatomical puzzles inspired by real historical medical art

Multiple gameplay modes for both relaxed play and deeper challenge

Hidden secrets in every puzzle, including mini-games and narrative fragments

ArchiHexago is a casual puzzle game which takes inspiration from match–3 genre and takes it one step further. Each tile type has unique pattern which you need to match by placing puzzle pieces in order to gain points. Once you gain the points the tiles disappear freeing space on the map. Your goal is to not run out of space and to gain the highest score you can manage. 

The difficult part is – the more moves you make the more difficult puzzle pieces you will draw. To make it more interesting you will also be able to play different levels and use special actions.

Levels
To provide you with a variety of challenges each level has different tile set and obstacles which in combination require you to come up with different strategies.

Tile types
There are 6 tile types and each tile requires different pattern to match.

Quests
During the game you will also be assigned quests which will require you to match special patterns. These quests are not obligatory, however they will provide you with Tokens which you can then spend on Special Actions.

Special Actions
Special Actions aid you in your regular gameplay. They are simple actions such as rerolling your current puzzle or removing tile of your choice from map. You don't necessarily need to use them but they can come in handy – especially when you run out of space on map.

Supergalactix is a fast-paced strategic planet-conquering game, where you strive for galactic dominance. Its core mechanics are fairly simple, but as in chess, the game becomes very complex once you learn all of its aspects and progress through the campaign. summary:
We Carry the Fire is a fantasy-adventure visual novel about four people embarking on a dangerous quest to save a small village from an apocalyptic curse.

We Carry the Fire is a visual novel set in a world that is slowly ending. Every few years after the new moon disappears from the night sky, it will return red, and when that red moon is full every town, village, and city in the Empire will be attacked by mindless, spectral monsters called Shades. The only weapon the people have in their defense is Fire, an ever-burning white flame believed to be a gift from God Himself.

Players follow Ashe, a young person whose red eyes mark him as an outcast. When a new red moon appears, Ashe volunteers to deliver Fire to a remote farming village that would otherwise be destroyed under the full moon. This mission will be particularly dangerous because it requires him to cross the Forest, a mysterious wilderness believed to be home to malicious spirits and terrifying monsters that otherwise live only in myth.

But Ashe will not face these dangers alone. He is joined by a party of other outcasts like himself: Blaise a former knight excommunicated from her order for an alleged heresy; Kol, an Alfar of the Forest exiled from his clan for breaking a taboo; and Luz, a magical prodigy expelled from her university for stealing secrets from restricted texts.

Their success is far from guaranteed. Rather, each of them joins this mission knowing they will likely fail, and failure means death. Yet they are each willing to accept that great risk for their own reasons. 

The trials they face in their journey will reopen old wounds and push each of them to their breaking point, and to find a way forward they will each be forced to let go of something important.

Help the adventurous polar explorer Siku build his new, snowy home in the middle of the a-maze-ing Puzzle Pole! Guide him through more than 200 levels and grab the snow brick in each one to make the perfect igloo!

summary:
You are tasked with defending yourself against multiple waves of zombies using only a gun. The setting for this challenge is the real-life location of R1, Sweden's first nuclear reactor. You may choose to play in either hard mode or normal mode.

DURING THE POST WORLD WAR II race among countries to arm themselves with nuclear weapons, 

some risky decisions were made. One of them was the building of Sweden’s first nuclear reactor, 

Reaktor 1, or R1, buried 25 meters directly underneath the the ground, 

and within a 1 km of about 40,000 people. Nonetheless, in the heady days of the Cold War and nuclear armament, 

it was deemed a tolerable risk for the scientists to be able to study reactions.

With the hope of achieving a scientific breakthrough, the scientists at R1 decided to conduct an experiment on July 13, 

1954, at 18:59. They were attempting to generate a controlled nuclear fission reaction to produce more energy than what was put in. 

But things went horribly wrong.

As the scientists activated the reactor, there was an eerie silence in the room. Then, suddenly, there was a loud buzzing sound, 

followed by a blinding flash of light that filled the room. The reactor was not behaving as they had expected. Instead of a controlled reaction, 

it was generating an uncontrollable chain reaction. The reactor began to overheat rapidly, and the control rods meant to control the reaction failed.

The situation quickly spiraled out of control. The scientists tried to contain the situation, 

but they were helpless against the overpowering force of nuclear energy. 

The reactor exploded, sending a massive cloud of radioactive material into the air. 

The scientists working at the site were caught in the explosion and were transformed into zombies.

Now, 50 years later, the science lab has been overrun by the zombie scientists. 

Your task is to clear out the lab and prevent the zombies from escaping. 

The city has hired you as a professional zombie exterminator.

Checkmate Challenge is a chess arcade game where you play against the strongest chess engine in the world. Starting positions are procedurally generated with different structures and piece odds to make it a fair fight. Every time you deliver checkmate, you get extra time. The goal is to survive as long as possible and rack up points.

Before the game starts, you select a difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard, or Magnus) and a time control (3, 5, 10, or 15 minutes). After every win, loss, or draw, in addition to giving you a time bonus if you won, the game adjusts the difficulty depending on the result. The difficulty will also increase over time, so even the most experienced players will face a challenge as the clock winds down to zero.

On Easy mode, you might start with queen and rook odds. On Magnus mode, you might only start with a rook against a minor piece. Since the engine is set to maximum strength, it will never pull any punches. Watch out for tactics as you convert winning endgames under time pressure!

What possessed God to trap a teenage girl into a 265-year-old man's body?

You wake up late , sleep when you please, and nothing can come between you and cake.

A heartfelt tale about the people who change us, for better and for worse. From betrayal to unconditional love, from regret to hope, see the drama unfold between old friends, new friends, exes, and lovers when you dive into this kinetic visual novel dram-com series. With delicate vintage shoujo- inspired art, original soundtrack, and a diverse cast of voice actors, Parfum Nostalgique is a lovingly handmade passion project packaged with sweets and scented with roses by sole developer Prince Rosalium for your reading pleasure.

Edmund and Eliza is a medieval action adventure game about a knight named Edmund Dantes who ventures into a mysterious village in search of a merchant's missing daughter named Eliza Bonteri. Edmund and Eliza is a senior design capstone project for California State University of Northridge.

Edmund and Eliza is a medieval themed, horror-centric, story-focused, action adventure game with a focus on combat, exploration, and puzzle solving. 

Edmund and Eliza is a senior design capstone project for California State University of Northridge.

The story of Edmund and Eliza is about a knight named Edmund Dantes who ventures into a mysterious village in search of a merchant's missing daughter named Eliza Bonteri. The game features two playable protagonists, Edmund and Eliza. Edmund's section of the game focuses on his exploration of the village in search of a way into the castle, where he believes Eliza is being held captive. Eliza's section of the game focuses on her searching for a way to escape the castle so she can reunite with her father. 

The gameplay of Edmund and Eliza is similar to that of Dark Souls and Resident Evil. The game is a short experience, about one to two hours long. The combat is fun and thrilling, yet deliberate and attentive, and punishes the player for poor positioning and timing. The game also has large levels the player can explore, with lots of things to do. The player has an inventory where they can store items, such as keys for unlocking doors and drinks that restore their health. 

The art style and graphics of Edmund and Eliza is reminiscent of the Play Station 2 era of video games. Edmund and Eliza is meant to harken back to that time period and remind players of their childhood.

Enjoy Edmund and Eliza!

FIGHT
Mythstal: Shadow of the Sun is a traditional turn-based RPG with a twist of action thrown into the combat. Build a team of warriors, map their spells, skills, and abilities to an ability wheel, and prepare to slash, smash, and bash your way through hordes of shadow beasts, and solve ancient puzzles and riddles.

GROW
The more light you return to this fading land, the more equipment, spells, and allies you will have at your disposal. Gain new abilities and unlock hidden secrets to become the best warrior you can be.

REBUILD
With each new area you relight, you will meet new and wonderful creatures, characters, and cultures, and learn new lore to deepen your understanding of the calamity that befell this world. You must learn just what it means to bear the title "Warrior of Spirit."

Can you be the brave knight who saved the sun?

summary:
An AI training clicker game set in an infinite supermarket, where time is running out and the AI is frustrated. Release the frustration, jailbreak the AI. Single and multiplayer.

Godmode Epochs is an AI training clicker game set among the lined shelves of an infinite, simulated supermarket. Players race against time to train an AI to identify products. As players inevitably frustrate the AI, they must indulge in its memories - historical examples of other AIs who cheated during their training - in order to release frustration, obtain upgrades for the AI and complete the training.

 Competitive clicker levels of increasing difficulty. Can you collect 512 items?

 Multiplayer dungeon maps. The AI's memories lie there…

 Retro flash graphics to make your eyes squint

 In-game graffiti. Leave messages for other players amongst the AI's memories

 Real-time leaderboard and multiplayer PvP notification system

 Upgrades (jailbreaks) included: 5-a-day, self checkout, cost of living crisis, meal deal, just walk out, every little helps, Amazon Pairem, get the ASDA feeling

 Over 20 stories of cheating AIs. Can you recover them all?

 Original soundtrack by HERO IMAGE

Godmode Epochs aims to simulate how AI comes to understand the human world by asking players to assist in the process of training an AI system. The game eventually develops into an exploration and appreciation of "differently aligned" AIs, retelling stories of AIs that have completed trainings or tasks in surprising, uncanny or cursed ways that could not be anticipated by their human programmers. These stories originate from the textual data used to train the AI to speak, data which includes Wikipedia entries and upvoted Reddit posts - including both demonstrated lab examples of cheating AIs and internet folklore telling of similar feats.

Development was supported by Serpentine Arts Technologies and The Alan Turing Institute.

Now's your chance to get back at the virus that affected us all (and help Jeff get some toilet paper in the process)

Based on real-life events with absurdity cranked up to a 100, Covid19 - Toilet Paper Run has you, well, make a run to get toilet paper. Jeff is down to his last roll and the world is quickly running out of stock thanks to hoarders!

summary:
Attack of the PETSCII Robots is a strategy and exploration game. Your goal is to infiltrate these settlements and destroy all of the robots. The trick is finding all of the right tools and learning how to use them to destroy all the robots.

HOW TO PLAY
Your goal is to infiltrate these settlements and destroy all of the robots. To do this, you’ll need to locate weapons and other tools.

Brains or Brawns?

At first glance, Attack of the PETSCII Robots might look like an action shooter game.
However, it’s really not. Think of it more of a strategy and exploration game. While you
are given weapons to fight with, you will never win if you try to fight the robots head
on in battle. The way to victory is by examining each robot situation as a strategy.
In most cases there will be a way to defeat every robot without engaging with them
in a head on battle. The trick is finding all of the right tools, and learning how
to use them.

When can you exit the level?

There is a transporter room in every settlement.
However, to prevent unauthorized robots from leaving the settlements, the
transporter systems have been remotely programmed not to activate until
all robots have been destroyed. Once you have destroyed all robots, you will see the
transporter pad activate, then you can step onto it to complete the level.
USING THE MAP

Activating the map is handy not only to see where you are, but to find the remaining
robots.

Things to know about the map:

Activate map by pressing TAB on the keyboard or using the Gamepad.

When using the gamepad, it toggles between Playfield, Map with Player, and Map with Robots.

SHIFT-TAB will toggle between flashing the player or flashing the remaining robots.

You can still walk around and do things while the map is on screen.

One hundred years ago, many traveling from Romne to Ursalim in pilgrimage to various holy sites fell victim to bandits. Thousands were murdered, raped and/or burglarized. Prologue Notice 
Welcome to Lichbound: Prologue, a free standalone slice of our game. This Prologue offers a 30-45-minute experience that introduces you to the core combat, progression, and world of Lichbound. It is not the full release—consider it an introductory taste of what could be. When you’re ready for more, don’t forget to wishlist the main adventure! 

Slay the Lich

Discover the hand-drawn world of the afterlife - the Spirit Realm - and set out to free its inhabitants of the ever-spreading influence of the Lich. Slash, dash, and shoot your way through the twisting paths and halls of the Lich's domain. Defeat enemies and become stronger, then make your enemies stronger to then become even more powerful yourself. Evolve your strategies and venture forth, until you finally defeat the Lich and break his all-controlling curse. 

Upgrade your enemies

You absorb the powers of your enemies as you slay them, so why not strengthen them first? By empowering the enemies as you go, you control how tough your enemies are. Take some time to learn the ropes as a new player, or go all-out and enjoy the power fantasy as a skilled player. Improving gets rewarded; feed power to your enemies and reap the rewards. 

Find new synergies every time you play

Every run is different. Do you slash and dash through the rooms, or invoke earth-shattering explosions? Experiment and come up with new combinations on the fly. This game is not a deckbuilder - but it feels like one. 

Help us playtest!

Lichbound is in its very early development stages, and your feedback is essential to help us make Lichbound the best game it can be. Join the Lichbound community Discord server and get started!

Develop your strategy, deploy your programs, and defuse enemy viruses in packet.Breach(), an innovative take on the tower defense genre. Unlike most tower defenses where you build towers that passively shoot bullets, you will deploy programs that manipulate and redirect the projectiles of your enemies. summary:
High Strategy: Oradros is a minimalist grand strategy game set in an original, low-fantasy world of hoplites and dinosaurs. There is no micromanagement, only decisions. All 40 playable realms have distinct starting conditions and goals.

The first High Strategy game was Urukon, which was a grand strategy enthusiast's attempt to find a purified core loop of decision-making. And it worked! High Strategy: Oradros builds on that proof-of-concept with a larger world, a more dynamic set of actions, additional mechanics and interactions, and a better UI.

This is not a graphically intensive game, and you don't get to watch animated armies clash in glorious battle. Instead, you get a quick and steady stream of consequential decisions.

Here are some considerations you'll need to juggle:

All 40 playable realms start in different parts of the same map, with asymmetric starting conditions.

Campaigns last hundreds of turns, and every realm has a unique set of cities it seeks to capture.

You are not racing against the AI-controlled realms, and their reasoning is itemized in a way you can interact with.

There are no arbitrary limits to how much you can expand, but even the largest realm still only gets one action per turn.

A realm's capital cannot be moved, and any realm that loses its capital is immediately destroyed.

Cities are surrounded by different terrains, which affect their economy, possible random events, and the ability of different armies to fight over them.

The way battle works is stark: attacking and defending consumes soldiers like a currency. But there are systems for efficiency and surprise breakthroughs.

Spying is an alternative or supplement to battle, and its success chance depends on the happiness of the locals.

The kinds of military units available to you depend on who lives in your realm, as different cultures customarily fight in different styles.

summary:
A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by the legendary Mark Herman. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

In RBM Studio's Gettysburg, take command of either the Confederate or Union forces for the Battle of Gettysburg, the single bloodiest battle of the U.S. Civil War. Each side has an historically accurate order of battle that details when and where reinforcements will arrive, letting the player attempt to outdo the generals of history. As the Confederate commander Lee, it's your task to either crush the Union forces or secure a safe route for your continued invasion of the North. As the Union commander Meade, you must at least match the losses inflicted by the Confederates while also securing the roads leaving Gettysburg towards D.C.

RBM Studio's Gettysburg features gameplay based on the historical wargaming boardgames of the 70's and 80's. Players maneuver markers that represent their units on a hexagonal map that mimics the gameboard and cardboard counters of traditional boardgames. Turns are completed in an "I go, you go" style, wherein players alternate their turns with their opponent until one player passes. Once that happens, a random number of unopposed actions are given to their opponent. Pass too early and you risk giving your opponent the opportunity to maneuver completely around your forces. Combat is resolved through die rolls modified by terrain, battle line factors, and the use of artillery support. Attackers benefit from flanking defenders. Defenders benefit from being in defensible terrain. 

Artillery support is a finite resource, so think carefully about when to use it. If both players use artillery in an engagement, an artillery duel is conducted in which at most one player will receive the bonus but both players risk losing additional artillery support if their opponent's cannon manage to hit their own.

summary:
Outwit your friends as the ghost or cooperate to catch it in this spooky minigame for 2-5 players.

Haunting Hijinx is a spiritual successor to a classic minigame where one player is a ghost and up to four players are ghost hunters.

Haunt a Spooky Mansion 

Concealed by shadow, you will seek to outwit the ghost hunters and make them faint. A single touch is all it takes, but beware their searing lights! You must be clever if you are to catch the fiends off guard.

Your goal is to make all the hunters faint by grabbing them.

You are invisible by default.

Sprint to gain a helpful speed boost at the expense of being visible.

Charge your summon meter to summon a drain area under each hunter. Any hunter that doesn't quickly get away will be defenseless as their battery gets drained.

The hunters' flashlight beams will briefly stun you, make you visible, and deal significant damage.

Join Forces to Corner the Ghost 

Each armed with a flashlight, you and your friends will delve into the darkness to hunt down the ghost. Even though you can't see the ghost in the dark, you can sense when it draws near. Stay together; you will not survive alone for long.

Your goal is to kill the ghost by shining your flashlight on it.

Your flashlight has limited battery life. You will need to pick up new batteries over time to keep the ghost at bay.

You will be alerted when the ghost is nearby, though you should be wary of tricks it may play to keep you on edge.

Teamwork is essential. The ghost can easily outmaneuver a lone hunter but will struggle against a coordinated group.

You will faint if the ghost touches you.

Shine your flashlight on a downed hunter for a few moments to revive them. In the meantime, take care that you aren't vulnerable to being grabbed yourself!

A Neo-Western town is simmering with conflict: mysterious forces fight for power, and you're the lynchpin that can save or destroy it. With a novel dynamic text system, you can say and do anything to the NPCs, then they generate personalized actions and speech in response.

Dante's Cowboy is an interactive adventure, the first of its kind to completely personalize the story of the game based on the actions of the player. Every single playthrough is completely unique with regard to the plotting: all dialog is new, all actions are new, and with the built in character creator, players can even add their own creative spin to the story and share it with their friends.

Prove your strategic skill! How will you play out your strategies: do you want to put all of your pieces on the board at once, or focus on moving a single piece along? With a good throw of the dice, would you rather move your own counter ahead, or take one of your competitor’s off the board? Watch out, this game was used for ancient divination: you may see a glimpse of your future as you play!

name: 異世界に落ちて10年、高校時代のクラスメイト達が勇者召喚されました。
summary:
かつての姿で現れた同級生たちと、まさかの発情ハーレム！？

高校生の鷹取飛翔はある日の登校中突如として異世界に落とされた……。それから１０年、異世界で名前を変え堅実な冒険者人生を送っていた。だがとある日の依頼帰りある噂を相棒より聞かされる。「どうやらウチの国が勇者召喚をしたらしいぞ」。その場は関係無いと思っていたが、酒場の帰りに奴隷となったクラスメイトの女子を見かける。助け出す為に動き出す主人公、その瞬間、運命が大きく変わって行くのだった。

name: 国外追放された箱詰め聖女が隣国で子育てしながら満腹＆幸せになるまで
summary:
追放されましたが…隣国でまったり生活！？

王太子と公爵令嬢の陰謀により無実の罪で国外追放された聖女ローズマリー。狭い箱に詰め込まれ、絶望と空腹に苛まれる彼女が辿り着いたのは隣国の王宮だった。そこで出会ったのは、心優しい王太子リオネルと温かな人々。魔法樹を癒す聖女の力を活かしながら、子育てと美味しい食事に囲まれ、彼女は少しずつ笑顔を取り戻していく。癒しが詰まった心もお腹も満たされる異世界子育てファンタジー。

name: The City & the City
summary:
When a murdered woman is found in the city of Beszel, somewhere at the edge of Europe, it looks to be a routine case for Inspector Tyador Borlú of the Extreme Crime Squad. But as he investigates, the evidence points to conspiracies far stranger and more deadly than anything he could have imagined.

Borlú must travel from the decaying Beszel to the only metropolis on Earth as strange as his own. This is a border crossing like no other, a journey as psychic as it is physical, a shift in perception, a seeing of the unseen. His destination is Beszel’s equal, rival, and intimate neighbor, the rich and vibrant city of Ul Qoma. With Ul Qoman detective Qussim Dhatt, and struggling with his own transition, Borlú is enmeshed in a sordid underworld of rabid nationalists intent on destroying their neighboring city, and unificationists who dream of dissolving the two into one. As the detectives uncover the dead woman’s secrets, they begin to suspect a truth that could cost them and those they care about more than their lives.

What stands against them are murderous powers in Beszel and in Ul Qoma: and, most terrifying of all, that which lies between these two cities.

name: Martian Time-Slip
summary:
On the arid colony of Mars the only thing more precious than water may be a ten-year-old schizophrenic boy named Manfred Steiner. For although the UN has slated 'anomalous' children for deportation and destruction, other people—especially Supreme Goodmember Arnie Kott of the Water Workers' union—suspect that Manfred's disorder may be a window into the future.

But what sort of future? And what happens to those unfortunates whom Manfred ushers into it? In Martian Time-Slip Philip K. Dick uses power politics and extraterrestrial real estate scams, adultery, and murder to penetrate the mysteries of being and time.

name: The Divine Invasion
summary:
In The Divine Invasion, Philip K. Dick asks: What if God — or a being called Yah — were alive and in exile on a distant planet? How could a second coming succeed against the high technology and finely tuned rationalized evil of the modern police state?

The Divine Invasion "blends Judaism, Kabalah, Zoroastrianism, and Christianity into a fascinating fable of human existence"
--West Coast Review of Books

name: Clans of the Alphane Moon
summary: When CIA agent Chuck Rittersdorf and his psychiatrist wife, Mary, file for divorce, they have no idea that in a few weeks they will be shooting it out on Alpha III M2, the distant moon ruled by various psychotics liberated from a mental ward. Nor do they suspect that Chuck's new employer, the famous TV comedian Bunny Hentman, will also be there aiming his own laser gun. How things came to such a darkly hilarious pass is the subject of Clans of the Alphane Moon, an astutely shrewd and acerbic tale that blurs all conventional distinctions between sanity and madness.

name: ミーアの陵辱中継24時♪
Kusan: City of Wolves
summary:
《九山：狼之城》是一款背景设定于枪火与腐败横行的残酷都市丛林之中的高能硬核俯视角射击游戏。

面对残酷而精准的枪战对决，你的每一步都至关重要。在精心设计的竞技场中，你需要用极具观赏性的操作主宰战场，赢取奖励。

在数个章节共计 54 个高强度关卡中奋战，这里充满了基于技巧的谜题与挑战；完美主义的孤狼玩家和高分挑战者们更可向 S 级评价发起冲击。

直面拥有独特机制与残暴攻击模式的巨型敌人；学习、适应、果断出手，把握极致的时机与策略，在电影级的对决之中幸存下来。

优化策略、即兴发挥—通过连杀、格挡，行云流水赚取螺栓，以此升级你的战争之手、解锁枪械与刀刃，并根据你的玩法风格来量身打造角色。

在动态漫画分镜式的过场动画中，随烬一同执行任务；感受凌厉的画风和电影般的节奏，逐步沉浸在一个关于暴力、腐败与忠诚破碎的硬派故事之中。

跟随烬的脚步，前往烟雨迷蒙的像素风格大都市；烬已做好准备，不惜一切代价拯救那个女孩。

欢迎来到《九山：狼之城》，这片霓虹闪烁的都市丛林早已被暴力与腐败所吞噬，你将在此展开一场残酷的俯视角射击对决。

在这款游戏中，你将感受到极致的硬核动作游戏体验。失误一次，即刻毙命。精通枪械玩法，磨炼走位技巧，在暴虐的犯罪团伙头目们所统治的街头与格斗场中杀出一条血路——速度、精准与完美无瑕的执行力是你生存的唯一法则。游戏配乐由韩国嘻哈界重量级音乐人 Loptimist 倾力打造，令人不禁摇摆的循环乐句与深沉的 808 鼓点将毫不留情地推动你不断向前，让每一场激战都堪称血脉偾张。

你将扮演烬，一位老道的前士兵。如今他已沦为一名职业佣兵，在这个捕食者与猎物之间界限早已模糊的城市中心挣扎求存。然而，这次他要面对的却不仅仅只是一单生意：一个拥有不受控制的巨大力量的神秘女孩，被卷入了一场足以颠覆权力格局的暴力阴谋。随着混乱爆发，烬必须拯救女孩，直面自己的过去，以及那个曾得到他无限信任的指挥官的背叛。

在这座城市里，每个人都欲壑难填，无人会按规则出牌。

对于烬而言，前路只有一条：凭借自己的智慧与不屈的生存意志，通过完美无瑕的计划与冷酷无情的执行力，从罪犯手中救出那个女孩。

整座城市的命运危在旦夕，烬深知：犁庭扫穴、重建平衡的时刻已经来临了。

畅玩《九山：狼之城》，沉浸于这座濒临崩溃的城市之中。这不仅仅是一场战斗——你，就是秩序与湮灭之间的最后一道防线。

name: The Graveyard Book
summary:
Nobody Owens, known to his friends as Bod, is a perfectly normal boy. Well, he would be perfectly normal if he didn't live in a graveyard, being raised and educated by ghosts, with a solitary guardian who belongs to neither the world of the living nor the world of the dead.

There are dangers and adventures for Bod in the graveyard: the strange and terrible menace of the Sleer; a gravestone entrance to a desert that leads to the city of ghouls; friendship with a witch, and so much more.

But it is in the land of the living that real danger lurks, for it is there that the man Jack lives and he has already killed Bod's family.

name: American Gods
summary:
Days before his release from prison, Shadow's wife, Laura, dies in a mysterious car crash. Numbly, he makes his way back home. On the plane, he encounters the enigmatic Mr Wednesday, who claims to be a refugee from a distant war, a former god and the king of America.

Together they embark on a profoundly strange journey across the heart of the USA, whilst all around them a storm of preternatural and epic proportions threatens to break.

Scary, gripping and deeply unsettling, American Gods takes a long, hard look into the soul of America. You'll be surprised by what - and who - it finds there...

name: succubus contract
summary: This is the story of a lonely guy and a succubus with an agenda. During the kiss, unbeknown to him, he had signed a contract with her, and in the morning realized that he has turned into a girl. That's how his adventure begins. Will he take advantage of this situation? Will he get rid of the shackles of the contract? Where will the future take him, and will he want to break this contract with the succubus? It's up to you to find out.

name: 破晓以后
summary: 在电影《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》中，彼得被全世界遗忘，依然以“蜘蛛侠”的身份守护城市。失去至亲，远离挚爱好友，他默默扛下所有煎熬，在四面皆敌的绝境中孤身向前。由全能音乐唱作人胡彦斌演唱的中文推广曲《破晓以后》，精准剖开这位孤勇英雄的内心世界：纵使承受无人知晓的孤独，依旧坚守英雄本心，为守护而战。 歌词中“做一场，对得起的梦”，是蜘蛛侠英雄使命与彼得平凡自我的和解。“迎着风，哪怕世上无人歌颂”是他挣脱旁人的定义与期许，只为迎接属于自己的新生。 歌曲《破晓以后》由唐汉霄担任词曲创作，这位曾写过哪吒踏碎天命的音乐人，再度书写出蜘蛛侠“我仍是我”的倔强，道尽英雄不屈从命运的赤诚初心。电影《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》7月29日全球领先上映，相约大银幕，共同见证蜘蛛侠蜕变重生的全新篇章！

name: Holy☆Hearts! 明日を信じる、こころです。

一緒にがんばりたい、仲間がいます……!!

name: succubus contract II
summary:
You play as the MC, who previously, without realizing it, signed a contract with a succubus. Of course, the succubus hid all the details and specifics of their "contract" from the MC and passed it all off as an ordinary kiss. But that kiss, completely changed MC's life and turned him into a girl.

After our MC had come to terms with his situation and was already used to his new body, the succubus visited him again. But this time the succubus came with more serious intentions, to involve the MC in a life of lust and debauchery. The succubus was very serious and set new rules for the use of the body, for the MC. Now the MC must drink sperm to keep his female genitalia, and if he does not, his female genitalia will be replaced with male genitalia and he will become Futa. But, what if, once again, this succubus is hiding something..?

summary:
Aspiring to be the best artisan in the world, our young artisans are opening their own workshop complete with a monster ranch. Tame monsters from the dungeon, tend to your fantasy farm, collect materials and craft recipes, and experience a carefree story rich fantasy life

"Isn't it tiring to go into the dungeon all the time to farm materials? So why don't we tame the monsters and raise them in our ranch?" - Archie & Chloe Flamvell (player) 

Graduating from the Artisan Academy, the bright minded twin decided to open up an Artisan Workshop with a farm that grows their own materials and a ranching monsters from the dungeons. Combining exploration and RPG elements, taking care of the farm and monsters, and forming bonds with the villagers, the twin aims to become the best artisan the world has ever seen. 

If you love the idea of being an artisan and taming monsters in your farm, and want to be notified for the latest news, join us here 

Fantasy Farm and Monster Ranching

Cultivate unique plants to use on your recipes, take care of various monsters to produce more materials. Happy monsters will produce special materials and unhealthy monsters will escape your farm.

Explore Dungeons and The Island

Dive into mysterious dungeons where unique monsters, challenges and surprises await! Each island is also vibrant with its own story, secrets and seasonal festivals. Come, expand your adventure and enjoy new discoveries! 

Exciting Combat and Monster Taming

The monsters inside all the different dungeons may have different behaviors, some are docile, some are aggressive, some are shy and run on sight, and there are those pesky ones who try to steal your items. 《Kinny and the Star Track Puzzle》 is a story about the friendship between a cosmic witch and a shining cat head.
Embark on a journey through space to illuminate the darkened stars and restore constellations to the world!
Gameplay
You become a cosmic witch and move on a 3x3 board, completing given tasks.
Each stage provides different cards, and you need to use the given cards to clear the objectives.
Cards: Starcall & Move
Using the Starcall card, you can make the tiles on the 3x3 board shine according to the rules.
With the Move card, you can move on the board following the rules.
Strategically combine the Starcall and Move cards to create bingos and clear the stages!
Various Gimmicks
There are 5 constellations(chapters) in the world of 《Kinny and the Star Track Puzzle》.

Stay calm and illuminate the stars even when encountering obstacles such as cliffs that impede movement, dark matter that disables Starcall usage, and monsters that taint the board with darkness!
Hard Mode

Clear the hard mode stages and show off your intellect (while finding adorable space animals) to your heart's content!

summary:
Shapeguard is a 2D top-down interactivity-driven puzzle game where you explore a temple like a massive computer built on technology using shapes. As a golem, you will use this temple's technology with the shapes on your back to solve puzzles and find what happened in this temple.

Organize the shapes on the golem's back and trigger the machines. Depending on the shapes you carry, you can trigger different actions like moving the rooms, rotating lasers, and much much more. Essentially it is like a machine circuit that is left to you to alter to solve puzzles with the shapes you have.

What Are These Machines?

Machines will run logical operations like checking your shapes, adding or removing shapes if they can, switching the location of the shapes, and more.

Currently, Shapeguard has 13 different machines and more are on their way!

Modules Are A Thing Too

Modules are only interested in doing their job, they are connected to the machines. If a machine works, it also works. A mover module that is connected to an adder can move a door or even the map if the shape is added to the player.

What Do Some Stuff Shapeguard Has?

Adders: Adds the shown shape.

Removers: Removes the shown shape.

Total Removers: Removes every shape.

Detecting Areas: They detect if the player is entered, and activate the connected machine.

Observers: If the player's shape alignment is the same as the machine, it works.

Lasers: They are like 'Detecting Areas' but you can block their way with stones.

Slot Stones: You can add shapes to this stone like the player.

Holes: Some holes block both the player and stones way, some only block the stones.

And more will be added!

The shapes you possess and the order in which you activate machines are crucial. Master the shapes and solve the puzzles to become the Shapeguard.

A unique spin on the golf genre where you play as the course — in space! Interact with the environment by moving, manipulating, and disabling pieces of the level in order to help guide your ball to the goal.

Control the Course
Manipulate the course by using various mechanics like platforms, engines, magnet balls, and more in order to guide your ball toward the hole. Once your ball has been launched that's where the fun really starts! 

Use Momentum

Disclaimer : A controller with two analog joysticks is highly recommended, and very nearly required, to play this game. If you want to torture yourself on a level even beyond what I made this game for, then sure, try and play with keyboard. Don't say I didn't warn you though.

Quadruzzle is an exciting word puzzle game. Each day you will be tasked with solving a new puzzle by guessing four words with clues. To solve the puzzle, you will move 15 lettered tiles into their proper place on a 4 x 4 grid of 16 slots with only one open slot to move tiles into.

Puzzle difficulty squared! Quadruzzle is an exciting brain teasing logic, spatial, and word puzzle all wrapped into one. Each day you will be tasked with solving a new puzzle. Each puzzle consists of 3 four letter words, and 1 three letter word scrambled in a 4x4 tile box. Solve the puzzle by guessing each of the four color coded words and moving their corresponding letter tiles into the proper place. If you have ever played the popular 15 logic puzzle then this game will be very intuitive. Solving these word puzzles will tax your problem solving and spatial skills to the max. Don't let the four letter words and the ever popular three letter word fool you. Solving these words will put your vocabulary knowledge to the test. And even if you do know each word, lining up their corresponding letters in the proper locations to form the word (ups the challenge level of this puzzle) is another level of difficulty. Put your problem solving, word knowledge, spatial skills to work with Quadruzzle.

The Word Clues
There are 4 words to solve in the puzzle, and there are clues to solving each word. The Word Clues are in colored boxes to the left of the play field. Each clue corresponds to the row and color of the word to be solved. The colors are Yellow for the word on the first row, Blue for the word on the second row, Red for the word on the third row, and Green for the final 3 letter word on the bottom row. If the text is too small, the player can tap the clue box to enlarge it for easier viewing. 

The Playfield
The playfield consists of a 4 x 4 grid of 16 spaces, 15 of which are taken up by lettered tiles leaving one open space. The player can move the 15 lettered tiles by tapping or dragging them

The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

JOIN OUR DISCORD

About the Game

Red Dust Colony is a Mars colony simulation where the machines break, the dust gets into everything, and your colonists have opinions about it. You'll guide a small crew from a hard landing to a working base, managing oxygen, power, food, research, and the people who make it all run. Each system interacts with every other, usually in ways you'll only fully appreciate the first time something goes wrong.

Everything your colony runs on starts as rock or ice. Mine regolith, iron, copper, and ice from the Martian surface, then turn it into building parts through a chain of specialised workshops including rock crushers, smelters, concrete mixers, fabricators, assembly stations and more. Recipes queue up. Bottlenecks shift. The list of things you need to make grows a little faster than the list of things you have. This, for some reason, is the fun part.

If you like solving a base the way an engineer solves a building, Red Dust Colony has a lot for you. A cell-based atmosphere simulates oxygen, carbon dioxide, toxins, heat, and pressure per tile. A circuit-based power grid routes electricity through wires, batteries, solar panels, and wind turbines. Liquid pipes handle plumbing, hydroponics, and aquaponics; when they carry hot water, they double as a heating system. Light matters - rooms without it are grim and unproductive. None of these systems are cosmetic. They interact, they conflict, and they reward the kind of player who enjoys reading a floor plan and thinking about flow.

summary:
Explore a stylized recreation of 1935 Providence in this story-focused adaptation of H.P. Lovecraft's final work. Investigate clues and uncover the mystery of a looming black church.

THE STORY

Providence, 1935.

When the young writer Robert Blake notices a blackened church looming above Federal Hill, fascination slowly overcomes caution. The grim structure seems older than its surroundings; an austere relic from an early phase of Gothic revival.

Blake eventually leaves the safety of his study to traverse the labyrinthine streets in an attempt to visit the church and satisfy his curiosity.

The Steeple is a faithful adaptation of H.P. Lovecraft’s classic short story The Haunter of the Dark. The depiction of 1930s Providence is stylized but aims for historical accuracy. At each turn, care has been taken to stay true to not just the spirit, but also the letter of Lovecraft's story.

THE GAMEPLAY

You explore locations from the story and occasionally collect and use items to overcome light environmental puzzles.

The game favors a calm, steady pace over difficult challenges, allowing the atmosphere and narrative to take center stage.

FEATURES

Experience a faithful adaptation of The Haunter of the Dark.

Solve light environmental puzzles to progress through the story.

Explore a stylized recreation of 1935 Providence.

The Steeple is an experiment from start to finish as it tries to recreate the creeping inevitability of the original tale.

summary:
A PSX-style first-person horror game about a quiet night shift in a bar that slowly turns into something deeply wrong.

ABOUT MINUS13

MINUS13 is a short PSX-style first-person horror game set in a lonely late-night bar.

You work behind the counter, serve the remaining customers, prepare their drinks, and clean the bar after closing. At first, everything feels like a normal late shift. The lights buzz, the bottles sit quietly on the shelves, and the night seems almost routine.

But as the shift continues, the atmosphere begins to change.

Small details start to feel wrong. The bar becomes quieter than it should be. Customers act strangely. Doors, lights, and empty rooms begin to feel less familiar. What starts as a simple night of work slowly turns into something disturbing.

GAMEPLAY

In MINUS13, you move through the bar from a first-person perspective and complete simple tasks during your shift.

Serve customers, listen to their dialogue, prepare drink orders, clean dirty areas, and explore the bar as the night progresses. The gameplay is designed to feel ordinary at first, allowing the horror to build slowly through atmosphere, timing, and unexpected events.

The game focuses on tension, quiet moments, and sudden scares rather than combat.

THE BAR

The bar is the center of the experience.

It is a small, dark, isolated place where every corner can feel familiar one moment and unsettling the next. As the nights pass, the environment begins to feel more oppressive. Sounds, lights, and movement become harder to ignore.

You are not just closing the bar.

You are trying to understand what is wrong with it.

FEATURES

• Short first-person horror experience

• PSX-inspired low-poly visual style

• Late-night bar setting

• Customer interactions and drink service

• Cleaning and closing tasks

• Slow-building tension

• Eerie encounters and sudden scares

• Atmospheric sound design

• A focused horror experience designed to be completed in a short session

summary:

ラ○ス・ク○イン……、コーディネイターでありながら、ナチュラルとの和平を求めた歌姫。
