Diverse Game Modes: Challenge yourself with tougher foes, unravel a linear story in "The Runs," or engage in frantic battles in the BETA multiplayer mode.

Ongoing Development: Dedicated to enhancing the experience with new game modes, increased difficulties, and innovative weaponry.

Pressure Within offers a unique blend of zombies, humor, and survival, and it's all crafted by a passionate solo developer. Get ready for a gaming experience like no other, where entertaining you and giving you a few laughs are top priorities.

Are you brave enough to tackle the undead and your own inner demons? Enter the world of Pressure Within and find out.

In the year 2000, you're newly entering high school. Trouble is, with your inexperience, everything out of your mouth is stupid, rude, or corny. Regardless, you've gotta put yourself out there, stumble around, and make things happen.

Every floor is randomly generated, so you never really know what’s waiting—other than more enemies and more panic.

Simple to play, hard to survive 

Find the white door to escape the dungeon.

Each door you enter spawns another enemy.

No fighting. No items. Just pure running for your life.

Bugs included

This is one of my first solo games, so expect glitches. Enemies might do something stupid. Things might break. That’s kind of the fun of it.

Why play this?

Because it’s free, it’s quick to pick up, and it’ll either make your heart race or make you rage.

summary:
A roguelike deckbuilding card game where you control, and buff your objects to defeat all kinds of funny sci-fi enemies.

Other games you would love

About the Game

Card games and roguelike deckbuilding card games have been here for quite some time and have proven to be very fun and addictive to play. As a huge fan of the genre, I always wanted to make a game of my own someday. And here it is, Overwritten: Defeat The Net is my take, which combines elements from the two games I like the most: Slay the Spire and Hearthstone.

FEATURES

 Roguelike Deck Building: Build your perfect deck one card at a time! Make every decision carefully as the offers are different every run.

 Control your "minions": Most of the cards in the game are cards that put an object in the playfield. You control those objects, buff them and turn them into powerful sources of damage or blocks, to defeat the enemies.

 On-screen calculator: The first game to give you more focus on planning your strategy by taking care of the chore of counting and calculating numbers for you. Just drag a rectangle on the screen to select things you want to calculate, and the game will show you how many HP, Attacks, Blocks, RAM Cost,... they have in total.

 Cyberpunk theme: In this game, you're an entity living in the digital space, you go through nodes to reach the center of the Net and defeat it. All cards and items in the game are computer programming-related.

summary:
Of Moons and Mania is an interactive psychotic break, based on lived experience. It uses elements of its design to explain the struggles of psychosis, and tells a personal story about mental illness.

Of Moons and Mania is my account of experiencing a psychotic break, in game form. Inhabit my mind as I lose my grasp on reason. Attempt to piece together cogent responses to questions from doctors, friends, and family as psychosis takes over, and ultimately try to get back to stability.

Key Features

Inhabit the developer's mind and build your own responses to dialogue.

 Experience an Autobiographical story detailing the experience of a psychotic break.

 An hour of gameplay.

Developer Statement

I started making this game several years after being hospitalized for a manic episode. I was fixated on the experience for the whole time. Trying to piece together what was real and what was dreamt, trying to even remember the sequence of events in chronological order, and every so often when I thought I had shaken the grip of obsessing about the hospitalization, I would have flashbacks that opened up my freshly healed wounds.

As a game developer, I was fascinated by some of the systems of thought that were going on in my head, and that gave me the idea for this game. I designed game mechanics and systems to tell the story of my psychosis in a different way than I have seen it expressed before.

Making the game really helped me with my flashbacks and organized the way I thought about my illness, and the experience of my hospitalization. I hope that it gives other people some insight into my brain and also into the nature of psychosis and manic depression.

Each player controls a robot to explore the mysterious ruins.

The structure of the ruins changes with each play, as well as the location of items and treasures.

From 2 to 10 players can play at the same time in one game.

summary:
? A non-standard chess game in which kings have magical powers. The player needs to cut down the enemy king, building a victorious tactics by combining the queue of moves and magical abilities.

? Chess Royale ?
Is a non-standard chess game in which kings have magical powers. The player needs to cut down the enemy king, building a victorious tactics by combining the queue of moves and magical abilities.

Pieces

The Pawn. It is the most numerous and weakest piece in the game. It can move one cell horizontally or vertically.

The Knight. It can move two cells vertically and one cell horizontally or two cells horizontally and one cell vertically, jumping over other pieces.

The Bishop. It can move diagonally without jumping over intervening pieces.

The Rook. It can move any number of cells horizontally or vertically without jumping.

The Queen. It is the most powerful piece in the game, able to move any number of cells vertically, horizontally or diagonally, combining the power of the rook and bishop.

The King. It is the most important piece in the game. It may move to any adjoining cell. The player who loses the king loses.

Magic Abilities
When the player's turn comes, he can use magical abilities using the accumulated elixir:

Obstacle. Blocks the movement of pieces in selected cell. Added to the turn queue. Destroyed at the onset of the move.

New Pawn. Summons a new pawn to a free selected cell.

Piece Change. Changes one selected piece (except king) to another.

summary:
A top-down psychological horror adventure. After a letter from a lover thought long-lost, a man takes a job as a research scientist in a city torn apart by a strange disease.

The year is 1981. Seven years since some strange disease ripped through the city of Sennenmoor, a quarantine cutting it off from the world. Seven years that have seen it forgotten, left to rot amongst the moorland. Five years since you last saw him. Five happy years together and then, suddenly, five years apart. No warning. One day he was just gone.
Three weeks since the letter. Written in shaking hand, though undeniably his. Still the smell of him hanging a little on the paper, still the letters slanting more as they went on, rushed and desperate. 
Two weeks since you took a job as a research scientist in a dead and broken city, for you knew where the letter came from, though you didn't know how, nor how he'd gotten back. The city of his birth, the city he often said he wanted to go back to, one day, to stay, to live out your lives there.
Two hour since you took a military train southbound from Glasgow towards Sennenmoor. A letter in your breast pocket. On it, written in scrawled hand, the words;
We're going home, Elias.

Now You Would Destroy The Earth is a top-down psychological horror narrative adventure about a man seeking answers from a lover he thought long gone, across the backdrop of a city torn apart by a strange disease. With multiple endings, paths and secrets to find, converse and navigate your way through the broken streets of Sennenmoor to find the truth about the man you once loved, and the nature of the disease itself.

The game is focused on exploration, patience, and efficient usage of your equipment to accomplish your objective. The gameplay is not story driven nor linear but rather driven by adventure. The Rake

The first of the creatures to make an appearance in Something's Out There is The Rake.

Tales exist dating back to the 1600s of a pale skinned human like figure that stalks humans not for a source of food but rather to instill horror merely by its presence. There does not exist any believable video or photographic evidence of the fabled creature, only fireside stories passed through the generations. Some stories claim it crawls on all four limbs like a dog, others say it walks upright. Some picture the being as a vicious beast hunting for game while others state that it merely watches. Bodies, both human and critter, have been found with claw markings that match the description of the creatures hands, but no other evidence exists of its existence.

Recent sightings of the creature have been reported in the Aposta Forest nearby, venture with your team for your chance to prove its existence.

Empire management in Stellar Sovereigns is all about its population of which size and approval directly affects its wealth, military, industry and its political power. 

Population growth dependent on the empire's ability to cater for their needs, while effected by environmental, social and political factors.

The player can finance the development of colonies to accommodate the needs of its population or can delegate its development to one of four governor types with a set budget.

summary:
Efpiyes is a multiplayer first-person shooter with a built-in map editor that anyone can use.

Efpiyes was inspired by the venerable shooters of the 90s: an era of straightforward, fast-paced action, LAN parties and creative tools you didn't need a gamedev degree to use. It's about fun with friends and running, jumping, shooting mayhem.
Multiplayer

Host and join games over Steam. Choose good old-fashioned Deathmatch or change it up with some King of the Hill or Tag.
Game Modes Currently Implemented:

 Deathmatch: Kill other players. Player with highest kills minus deaths wins.

 King of the Hill: Occupy the hill and fight off other players. Player with most time on the hill wins.

 Tag: First player to die becomes It. Whoever is killed by the It player becomes It. Player who spends the least time It wins.

 Anti-Tag: First player to get a kill becomes it. Whoever kills the It player becomes It. Player who spends the most time It wins.

 Steal the Bacon: A ball spawns somewhere on the map. The ball can be picked up and will be dropped when you die. Player with the most time carrying the ball wins.

 Grim Piñata: Same as Steal the Bacon, but more balls keep spawning over time. Each ball carried counts additively towards your time.

Bots

Add bots to your game for solo practice or to add extra spice to multiplayer games. The bots know how to play all game modes, and can be adjusted to a wide range of difficulty levels.
Map Editor

Design your own maps with the built-in map editor and share them with your friends. Maps are voxel-based for simple, intuitive editing.

Every early December another kid from your school goes missing, and rumors on the playground have circulated that it's related to Krampusnacht- the night that a half-goat half-demon named Krampus comes and steals away naughty children and spares the good. World
The world is made up of Floors and Areas. These Floors and Areas are the essential life of Dwarves Mining Idle, well, besides the Dwarves of course! Areas are infinite and Floors can be leveled and upgraded to become more powerful.
Floors
Floors are costly, but they are valuable! A Floor is made up of types: Mineable, Combat, Liquid and Loot. Each Floor type has its own value to material farming. Starting out you will have a free choice for any Dwarf with any special stat and ultimate ability you'd like. After purchasing a Dwarf with materials, you can choose to keep your Dwarf "benched" or spawn him in the World to work.

Cloning a Dwarf
Cloning Dwarves together is simple. Choose which ones you'd like to Clone and tada! The stats will merge together and any stat the Dwarf didn't have before will learn the one from your second or first Dwarf you chose to clone together.

Skills
Once your Dwarf is ready, unlocking its Skill Tree can open a whole new world to what your Dwarves will be able to do.

Placeables
A placeable, once available, is a crucial part of continuing the material grind! Furnace, Crusher, Bottler and more! Smelt, Crush and Pump your way up to the top. Using fuel that Dwarves gather from Mining and other sources will allow you to create many more items with placeables!

QLewds is an upcoming Free-to-Play 3 vs 3 online multiplayer clash in a large 2D arena. The game aims to bridge aspects of MOBAs, Metroidvanias, 2D Platformers, and Brawlers into a novel gaming experience. The game has just entered Early Access and its beta phase.

Victory is achieved for one team by destroying the enemy's throne. Thrones are invulnerable until the opposing team collects enough Ether. Ether is gained in a variety of ways, including destroying enemy team's flowers, killing enemy players, and other unique in game objects. 

Gameplay is split between day and night cycles. During daytime players can focus on the lanes, where the flowers are active. At night the game opens up, with the flowers sleeping and neutral enemies spawning throughout the map. 

Basically, you begin the game weak and pathetic. Through superior performance you end a match like a boss by leveling up, earning gold, buying upgraded skills, passive upgrades, and active upgrades, beating scary bosses, making sick plays, discovering hidden secrets, sniping some queeps, laughing at a scrub, and probably some other stuff.

One of the reasons that Idle Drift Kings stands out from other idle games is because of its Physics Based Drifting mechanics. This makes earning points and watching those numbers rise even more satisfying.

EARN REPUTATION ACTIVELY OR PASSIVELY
In Idle Drift Kings you can upgrade both your active and passive playstyle through many upgrades, including Tandem Drifters for both the players car and the automatic RC drift cars to earn much more reputation.

CLIMB THE RANKS
When it comes to the drift scene in Idle Drift Kings, there are 6 ranks with upgrades for each rank respectively. summary:
There's been a murder in Moontropolis, and it's up to Sergeant Squidley to solve it! In this retro roleplaying/adventure hybrid, you’ll spend a week as Squidley trying to crack the case. But between family troubles and saxophone practice will you even find the time for detective work?

The best cop in town has been murdered, and there's only one man who can solve the case: Sergeant Squidley, Space Cop!

Hastily promoted from traffic duty, Squidley must use all his Strength, Investigation, and Handiness as he travels around Moontropolis searching for evidence to solve the case. But there are stronger forces than just the criminal underworld at play: an ex-wife who hates him, a young son to take care of, and a dark secret held by pretty much everyone in town. 

A decision-based RPG that lets you steer the story as you wish! Want to be a dutiful police officer? Or maybe you want to indulge your criminal side? Perhaps you want to ignore policework altogether and work on your side-hustle as a jazz saxophonist? Or take a few days off to reconnect with your estranged son? There are hundreds of choices to make, from the heartfelt, to the ridiculous, to the downright nasty, and each of them impacts how the story unfolds. 

Sergeant Sqiudley is a love letter to the text-based DOS games of the late 80s and early 90s. You’ll guide Squidley around the city of Moontropolis, making decisions that impact the direction of the story. Follow the plot as intended, or go off on any number of tantalizing tangents, derailing the narrative to all sorts of wacky ends. 
The objective of the game is to solve the murder of Detective Dex Beeglor, and Squidley has one week to complete this task. But there are so many things to do around the city, it's going to be impossible to fit them all in. Investigate the crime scene, interview the victim's family, and ask around town to identify suspects… or don’t. You're completely free to ignore the case, and simply live out a week in Squidley's shoes.

summary:
Animal Across: Afrika is a puzzle game set in an African biome. Here you must feed endemic animals to this biome with their natural food.

WELCOME TO AFRIKA!!

With an indie and artsy visual, Animal Across: Afrika promises to be a light and fun game, set in Africa with endemic animals from there. The game is set up similar to Tetris, where pieces are falling and you have to match them in order to eliminate them. The differences are that here the pieces always come in sets of two horizontal blocks and, in addition to the colors, they match the animal with its food. In this game there is no time to complete the puzzle, only the score matters. This game features five gameplay modes between singleplayer and local multiplayer:

- Singleplayer:
In this mode you play by your own, trying to eliminate the pieces through combinations. If the board is full, you lose.

- Multiplayer 1:
This mode is perfect for spending time with a friend. A clash in which each player has their board and both receive the same pieces and need to allocate them. There's only one winner here!

- Multiplayer 2:
Here, everyone also has their board and only one wins, the difference is that each player gets their own pieces, in other words, they are different pieces.

- Multiplayer V:
In this mode, both players have the same board, which is presented in a V format, but each one has their own side. You must use the best strategies to beat your opponent, and you can even play pieces on your opponent's side to harm him and get away with it.

- Multiplayer Co-op:
For those who want to play with a friend, but don't like competition, we have that option too! In this mode there is only one board, a bigger one, where your partner and you must help each other to win the game.
Features:

5 modes of gameplay.

Singleplayer and local multiplayer.

Play in beautiful environments of Africa!

Originally composed soundtracks.

A puzzle game focused on fun, alone or with a friend.

summary:
Guess the random sequence of glyphs with optional hints and alternate symbol sets.

One evening, my 5 year old son asked me to "guess my letters". It turns out he was thinking of three letters that didn't make a word. Just three random letters. It was kind of fun!

Glyph Guesser is a little program I made that builds on this idea. You can adjust the difficulty by setting the size of the pool of characters, the length of the random sequence, and the kind of hints you get about how close your guesses are. The hints are all togglable independently, so you can choose to see:

* No hints at all, just guess randomly.

* How many of the glyphs are somewhere in the sequence.

* Which of the glyphs are in the sequence

* Which of the glyphs are in the correct locations.

Because glyph guesser supports 860 glyphs from the UTF-8 character set, you can generate an arcane set of glyphs to guess from, and if you choose a glyph set of 10 or less, you can reference them with the numerals 0-9. Otherwise, you'll need to copy-paste the glyphs from the library printout.

Enjoy guessing!

Casmir, the Soldier, excels in ranged attacks, using his advanced weaponry to deal damage from afar. Each character, despite sharing the same mechanics, plays differently: the Rogue must always be on the move, weaving behind enemies with flashy moves; the Knight must always maintain aggro, perfectly countering attacks to stay alive; the Mage must always manage his mana, switching between melee and magic constantly; and the Soldier must always position carefully and manage his ammunition.

Welcome to the wonderful world of Let's Pet Pets™! 

This is a game where you pet pets to gain Pet Points. Pet Points can be used to purchase Helping Hands. Helping Hands will give you more Pet Points automatically every second (even while you are away). Each Helping Hand can be individually upgraded to give you even more Pet Points. You can also use Pet Points to purchase Items. Items are unlocked through reaching milestones and progressing through your Let's Pet Pets™ journey. These Items have a multitude of effects. The Pet Time Bonus is a window of time which will multiply your Pet Point production across all sources. This Pet Point production multiplier will remain active for the duration of the Pet Time Bonus. As you pet pets, upgrade Helping Hands, purchase Items, and play Let's Pet Pets™ you will complete Quests. Quests will earn you Heart Points. Heart Points are a very valuable resource because they let you get new eggs from the Pet Shop. Eggs can hatch into a new pet or upgrade a pet you already have. These Eggs hold a variety of cute animals ranging from Anteaters to Zebras. Each pet has its own unlockable Items, Quests, and even its own Helping Hands. You continue to gain Pet Points from other pets you have bought even while you are petting a different pet. If you feel progress slowing down and need a boost, you can prestige. Activating prestige will reset all your Helping Hands and Items, but you will keep your Eggs, Pets, Quests, and Upgrades. As you can clearly see, petting pets is going to be quite the adventure.

summary:
Duplicado is a soothing yet challenging puzzle game with unique avocado-themed mechanics. Journey across a serene avocado orchard, planting trees as you slide and solve your way through a nearly endless number of satisfying puzzles.

GAMEPLAY
Use the 4 avocado pieces and their unique sliding mechanics to plant all of the seeds into the soil and water tiles. Order of operations is key, and using the pieces in clever ways is often the only way to solve the puzzle. Some seemingly easy levels will have you completely stumped until you get a very satisfying 'Aha!' moment where you see the solution.
EXPERIENCE
After a short collection of tutorial levels, the game loads you immediately into an endless landscape of procedurally-generated puzzles that flow beautifully into each other upon solving. As you complete levels you will unlock three additional difficulty tiers that offer much more challenging puzzles.
UI

We hope this game offers peaceful little moments when you need them most. 
Happy puzzling :)

Pyreside Waltz is a fantasy-romance visual novel set in a fictional kingdom inspired by Russian fairytales. The story follows Motya, an artificial doll who awakens after an accident without their memories. As they try to figure out who they are and what they are meant to do, they encounter a cast of inhuman denizens, each with their own unique motivations and relationships to explore. 

The player can pursue one of five different suitors, each with unique Live2D models and animations (which can be exchanged for static sprites if desired). Though the game will include some light body horror imagery and dramatic elements, it is a romance at its core, with a focus on getting to know the various characters and seeing how their lives intertwine.

summary:
Survival and Increment game. The cat should survive in the field and collect TAIYAKIs.

Survival and Increment game.

TAIYAKI means fried fish. Instead of clicking your mouse, you have to be a wanderer to collect and raise TAIYAKI on the field.

The background and basic environment are like the following.

The feline protagonist discovers that upon awakening, his primary objective is to gather "TAIYAKI," a commodity that he has deemed essential to his existence. He understands that collecting and accumulating TAIYAKI is his purpose and goal, with the ultimate aim of welcoming the deity who created him to the earth. Since birth, the cat has been plagued with existential questions but has yet to find a satisfactory answer. 

To resolve these issues, the cat collects TAIYAKI found in the world and acquires various "amplifiers" and upgrades to accelerate the process of gathering TAIYAKI, and by saturating the world with his creed, he hopes to resolve his personal and global issues. The cat believes that by fulfilling this purpose, he will be able to welcome the deity who brought him into existence.

The cat must also attend to the basic necessities of survival in the world, such as satisfying hunger and quenching thirst. These basic needs are met by procuring food and water from the world, however, resources may be limited. The cat's lifespan is also consumed by the depletion of resources in the world. The fact that survival is a prerequisite to collecting TAIYAKI, means that the cat's purpose is doubled, creating a dichotomy between simply living and living with purpose. Navigating this duality is a skill that must be practiced in the world.

Eating more TAIYAKI is said to bring happiness, but the task of collecting TAIYAKI is arduous. The cat must explore and traverse a world filled with obstacles to find every TAIYAKI. This process can be seen as a form of training. Additionally, there are special items that can be acquired by utilizing materials found in the world.

As you navigate through the dream world, you must avoid being seen by The Man and manipulate objects and creatures around you to keep the dream looking normal and mundane. However, be prepared for the unexpected, as strange and surreal monsters may appear at any moment.

summary:
Shoot! VR is a first-person shooter simulation game using virtual reality. The game simulates the environment of an indoor shooting range. The game has different modes and offers a choice of different weapons.

Shoot! VR is a first-person shooter simulation game. The game simulates the environment of an indoor shooting range. The game has different modes and offers a choice of different weapons. 

In time mode, the player tries to get the best score possible within the time limit. Random targets will be generated in the scene. Players must shoot as many targets as possible during the countdown to get a higher score. When the player shoots, there is a virtual sign on the side in front of him/her indicating the score obtained and the time left to remind the player. When the time is up, the player quits the game and the page displays the score.

In level mode, the difficulty of the level changes from easy to hard over time. Each level has a preset score and players must achieve a score greater than or equal to the preset score before the countdown ends before entering the next level. As the player progresses through the level, the difficulty becomes higher and higher. The difficulty of the level is determined by the speed at which the target disappears and the score that must be achieved to advance to the next level. If the score obtained by the player before the end of the time is lower than the predefined score, the game is over and the virtual screen (panel) will display the final score obtained by the player.

In training mode, players can shoot freely with different weapons. This mode is the default mode when a player enters a scene, i.e. the player does not choose to start a game in time or level mode. Players have no time or score limit, they can shoot freely. Players can also choose the difficulty they want, which means the different time interval between the appearance and disappearance of targets.

In a peaceful yet broken-down world, you discover a myriad of wildlife and peoples. Collect materials, learn recipes, restore your surroundings, and cultivate foods, all while helping those you encounter. Perhaps you can uncover what’s happening in this strange land—and your role in it all.

A look into... is just that, a look into a calm, peaceful, open-ended game created to feel like you are looking into a world that only exists in the confines of your computer.

A mysterious force has emerged from ancient grounds. While it seems to be harmless, it is certainly impeding the locals from living their lives freely. Discover a myriad of wildlife, from the birds and the bees to critters and fish, collect materials and recipes to help the communities you encounter, find new skins for yourself and maybe figure out what is going on in this strange land, and your role in it all.

There are minigames when you gather wood or ore, or when you observe the life surrounding you. Research items to gain recipes and agency to be more capable in the world around you, craft more items to help you in your tasks, and at the end of the day, know that you've helped all those you encountered.

While many would this call a passion project, I call it a painting; an expression of who I am and what I cannot express otherwise, and just maybe it can evoke something unexpected in you.

summary: TikTok フォロワー82 万人を超える女の子担当「りみー」と、YouTube フォロワー44 万人を超える女の子以外担当「とくみくす」の男女2 人組ユニット「ASOBI 同盟」。YouTube などで多くのオリジナル曲、カバー曲を発表し、Z 世代を中心に人気を博す中、2023 年4 月より放送されたTV アニメ『天国大魔境』エンディングテーマに大抜擢。同楽曲「誰も彼も何処も何も知らない」は全世界で1000 万回以上再生された。2024 年7 月にはTV アニメ『夜桜さんちの大作戦』( 第2 クールエンディングテーマ) を担当。さらには2024 年10 月放送のTV アニメ「合コンに行ったら女がいなかった話」のエンディングテーマを担当するなど、様々な話題作、注目作の主題歌を担当するASOBI 同盟が、2025 年7 月から放送中の大人気TV アニメ「ぐらんぶる2」の挿入歌に抜擢。同楽曲「地球滅亡」の配信リリースシングル。物語の進行に寄り添いつつ、聴く人を一瞬にして虜にしてしまうテーマとフレーズでASOBI 同盟らしさ全開の一曲。

name: 寻找陈雨彤
summary:
《寻找陈雨彤》不同于常规的网页解谜游戏有很强的逻辑链条，
它的重点是信息收集，采用沉浸式游玩机制，轻解密，
请在确认无可点击信息后再进行搜索。游玩时长大约2h左右，整体难度适中。

你的任务：
1. 找到陈雨彤
2. 登陆自己和陈雨彤的账号
3. 还原当年的真相

◯ 引言
【网站解谜】求助，我感觉家里多了一个人
大家好，这是一个求助贴。
先自我介绍一下，我叫林秋，今年41岁，
03年的时候家里父母去世，后来我就出国留学了并且在外长期工作定居，
直到今年收到了老小区的通知，说是要拆迁，我就回国了。
事情就发生在我回国的那天，
我印象里从我出国后家里一直是没人的，我也没有亲戚，
但自从我踏进老房子的那一刻开始就有强烈的预感，我能感受到屋子里是有人的。
我印象里的房子是三室一厅，但现在书房里却多出来一张床和一个衣柜。
接着是书柜，我印象里书柜上都是我小时候看的漫画书和言情小说，
结果现在多了很多我根本不会去看的散文和悬疑小说。
这太诡异了，好像有一个人一直生活在这里。
最吓人的地方来了，我在整理这些书的时候，发现了一本小说，
小说里夹着一张我的照片。这简直让我毛骨悚然。
我发誓我活到四十岁了从来没这么害怕过，我甚至回头看了眼打开的房门，
静悄悄的屋子里仿佛随时要进来一个我完全不认识的人咧开嘴朝我笑。
然后我在书的书封上发现了一个网站，出于好奇我启动了尘封已久的老头电脑，
居然真的能登录，我登上了网页，发现了一个让我更毛骨悚然的事情。
有人在找陈雨彤，她好像消失了。
但这个名字现在就躺在我的通讯录里。
这个事情要追溯到2006年底，那年我在国外出了一次严重的车祸，
昏迷了很久，醒来后医生说我有严重的脑震荡，
担心我有后遗症强迫我休息了近大半个月，期间朋友也都来看过我。
车祸损坏了我的手机，手机修好后也只剩下了通讯录的号码，
我查看了一下，基本上这里的人名都有印象，除了一个叫做陈雨彤的人。
我也试着打过电话，是空号，所以我也没多在意，可能是不太熟的朋友。
直到我今天在这个网站上又一次看见了这个名字。
如果你认识陈雨彤，或者你也有关于她的记忆，请联系我，万分感谢！

summary:
★ 欢迎来到有缘闺蜜手拉手聊天室 ★
※ 为保证游玩过程顺利，建议单开一个网页来进行搜索

◯ 引言
你见过最细思极恐的聊天室内容是什么?

我曾经是一个聊天室的网页管理员，
在中途接手管理了一个从2014年到2023年的一个小众聊天网页。

在那段日子里，有一个持续了很久的聊天室。
直到网页彻底关停的那一刻，里面依然还有活跃的用户。
但是，随着时间的推移，
我逐渐发现里面的每一个用户都陷入了某种难以言说的麻烦之中。

由于整个网页采取的是全匿名的性质，我无法追踪他们，
也无法确定他们的真实身份，更无法通过现实手段去帮助这些可怜的孩子……

这些年我一直备受煎熬。于是，我把部分相关的聊天内容与讨论整理了下来。
有些事情我至今没有想通，希望大家可以帮着解密。

name: 神户女高神隐事件
summary:
一段关于消失与真相的探索之旅

游戏背景
    你与在日本留学的沈心洁曾是无话不谈的挚友。
    她总是兴致勃勃地与你分享神户生活的点滴——
    校园趣事、街角咖啡馆、神社的晨钟暮鼓。
    直到那个寻常的午后，她的消息戛然而止。
    你发送的关心石沉大海，微信被拉黑，朋友圈只剩一条意义不明的动态。
    那不像赌气，更像某种无声的求救。
    不安驱使你登入她学校的官网，却发现更大的谜团：
    她所在的女子高中，档案显示已在去年合并为男女共校。
    那些她曾描述的纯女生校园生活，仿佛从未存在过...

游玩须知
    这所学校的网站因合并而仓促搭建，安全防护存在诸多疏漏。
    尝试搜一下有关毕业生的内容？
    敏锐的你会发现两个关键入口：学生入口与搜索引擎
    它们或许能带你穿透表象，触及被掩埋的真相
    本作包含三种截然不同的结局——两个普通结局，与一个深藏的真相
    有些真相，知晓本身即是代价。最深的黑暗往往披着光明的外衣，
    而众人渴求的答案，或许正是最不愿面对的深渊。

Claw Machine Pro (CMP) is the physics-based claw game you’ve been waiting for! Spot the prizes you’d like to grab in one of several different machines. Like physical claw machines, you control the claw to move it, drop it down, and - fingers crossed - it’ll grab the prize. If it does, lucky you! Next just guide it back to the drop chute—BE CAREFUL! If the prize isn’t firmly in the claw’s grasp, it might fall out before you get there…

Choose from six machines in a variety of locations. Each one has a different theme and its own difficulty level: Chill, Challenge or Frustrate. With three games each, featuring different challenges and prizes per machine, you get a total of 12 different claw game experiences!

All games feature multiple modes, including:

One Strike - Are you really sure you’ve got the claw lined up right? Make one mistake and your game is over.

Infinite - Are you looking for the freedom to try, try, try (and try, and try, and…) again? In Infinite mode, play as long as you want. You’ll get that bear eventually!

Limited Mistakes - It’s countdown time. Your game starts with a limited number of permissible mistakes. Each mistake reduces that count by one until you run out and the game ends.

Limited Attempts - Countdown time continues. This time you begin with a limited number of attempts. Each drop of the claw deducts one from the count until you run out so make sure every drop counts!

Timer Mode - Capture as many prizes with the claw as you can before the timer runs out. Each successful attempt returns some time for you to continue.

Please let us know what you think about Claw Machine Pro in the discussions, we'd love to include ideas from our players!
